name: Explore South Africa
metaTitle: South Africa Tour Package | Cape Town & Safari with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore South Africa with Duniya Dekho. Visit Cape Town, Table Mountain, Cape of Good Hope, and experience a thrilling safari at Kruger National Park.
description: Embark on an unforgettable 10-day adventure through South Africa, exploring its stunning landscapes, vibrant culture, and incredible wildlife. Begin in breathtaking Cape Town, where you'll spend three nights discovering iconic landmarks like Table Mountain and Cape of Good Hope. Next, travel to Oudtshoorn, the ostrich capital of the world, and Knysna, a charming coastal town on the scenic Garden Route. Then, head to Sun City, a luxurious resort nestled in the Pilanesberg Game Reserve, where you'll enjoy thrilling game drives and stunning natural beauty. Continue to Pilanesberg for two nights of safari adventures, before ending your journey in vibrant Johannesburg, where you'll spend one night exploring the city's rich history and culture.

Travel along the stunning Garden Route, visit Stellenbosch & the Winelands, and enjoy the vibrant city life in Durban and Johannesburg. Experience the thrill of a safari in Kruger National Park, spotting Africa's Big Five in their natural habitat.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Located at the southern tip of Africa, South Africa boasts a diverse geography, with a range of ecosystems, from the majestic Table Mountain to the scenic Garden Route, and from the arid Karoo desert to the subtropical coastlines. The country's varied landscape is home to some of the world's most unique and breathtaking natural wonders, including the iconic Cape of Good Hope, the stunning Pilanesberg Game Reserve, and the majestic Drakensberg Mountains. South Africa's climate is equally diverse, with Mediterranean, subtropical, and desert climates all present. The western coast is generally cooler and wetter, while the eastern coast is warmer and more humid, with summer temperatures often reaching the mid-30s (°C) and winters ranging from mild to chilly.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cape Town International Airport, where you'll be warmly greeted by a representative. Enjoy a seamless transfer to your hotel, where you can freshen up and get settled. Spend the rest of the day exploring Cape Town at your own pace, discovering its vibrant culture, stunning natural beauty, and world-class attractions.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town

itinerary.title: Cape Town City Tour & Table Mountain
itinerary.description: Embark on a half-day tour of Cape Town, exploring its iconic landmarks, rich history, and vibrant culture. Begin with a scenic drive to Table Mountain (weather permitting), taking in the breathtaking views of the city and Atlantic Ocean. Next, visit notable attractions such as the South African Museum, Company Gardens, Parliament buildings, Castle of Good Hope, and bustling Green Market Square. Wander through the colourful streets of Bo-Kaap, discovering its unique cultural heritage and admiring the picturesque homes.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town

itinerary.title: Full Day Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable full-day adventure to the Cape Peninsula, where stunning landscapes, diverse wildlife, and rich maritime history await. Visit the iconic Cape Point and Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve, where the Indian and Atlantic Oceans converge. Witness the charming colony of African penguins at Boulders Beach and pass through picturesque towns like Simons Town and Kalk Bay, experiencing the local culture firsthand. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views from Chapman's Peak Drive and explore the Cape Point Nature Reserve, taking a funicular tour to the top. Additional highlights include visits to Simons Town, Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the stunning Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Oudtshoorn
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Cape Town and transfer to Oudtshoorn, the ostrich capital of the world, nestled in the heart of the Klein Karoo. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring this charming town's unique attractions, such as the ostrich farms, Cango Caves, and scenic landscapes.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Oudtshoorn

itinerary.title: Oudtshoorn to Knysna
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure today, exploring the natural wonders and unique attractions of Oudtshoorn. Cross the majestic Outeniqua Mountain Pass and visit the breathtaking Cango Caves, a stunning limestone cave system. Get up close and personal with wildlife at the Cango Wildlife Ranch, and learn about the fascinating world of ostrich farming at the Safari Ostrich Showfarm. Later, transfer to the picturesque town of Knysna, nestled on the scenic Garden Route. Overnight in Knysna.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Knysna

itinerary.title: Knysna to Sun City
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Knysna and transfer to George Airport for your flight to Sun City (flight details to be advised). Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel, nestled in the heart of the Pilanesberg Game Reserve. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the resort's many attractions, including its stunning pools, beautiful gardens, and exciting entertainment options.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Sun City
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxing day at leisure in Sun City, free to explore and indulge in the resort's many attractions and activities. Take a thrilling game drive, try your luck at the casino, or simply unwind at the Valley of Waves. You can also treat yourself to a rejuvenating spa treatment, play a round of golf, or enjoy the resort's many dining and entertainment options. Overnight in Sun City.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Sun City

itinerary.title: Sun City to Pilanesberg
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Sun City and transfer to the nearby Pilanesberg Game Reserve, a malaria-free zone renowned for its incredible wildlife and stunning natural beauty. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, preparing for an exciting safari adventure tomorrow.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Pilanesberg

itinerary.title: Pilanesberg Safari
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable safari adventure today in the Pilanesberg National Park, one of Africa's most renowned game reserves. Set out on a thrilling game drive, guided by an expert ranger, and get up close to an incredible array of wildlife, including the Big Five: lions, leopards, rhinos, elephants, and Cape buffaloes. Enjoy the stunning scenery and take in the sights and sounds of the African savannah.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Pilanesberg

itinerary.title: Pilanesberg to Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Pilanesberg and transfer to Johannesburg, the vibrant economic hub of South Africa. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city's many attractions, such as the Apartheid Museum, Nelson Mandela Bridge, and the lively neighborhoods of Braamfontein and Maboneng.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Johannesburg.

itinerary.title: Departure from Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to South Africa and transfer to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your incredible 11-day adventure.

name: Egyptian Getaway
metaTitle: Egyptian Getaway Tour Package | Cairo, Luxor & Nile Cruise with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Egypt with Duniya Dekho. Visit Cairo, Giza Pyramids, Luxor, Valley of the Kings, and enjoy a luxurious Nile Cruise.
description: Explore the ancient wonders of Cairo, a city steeped in history and mystique. Discover the Pyramids of Giza, the last of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and the majestic Sphinx. Visit the Egyptian Museum, home to the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, including the golden treasures of Tutankhamun. Wander through Islamic Cairo, exploring the Mosque of Muhammad Ali and the vibrant Khan el-Khalili bazaar, one of the oldest markets in the Middle East. Unravel the secrets of Cairo's rich past and immerse yourself in the city's vibrant culture.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Egypt's geography is characterized by its diverse terrain, featuring deserts, mountains, and coastal plains, with the Nile River running through the country. The climate is hot and desert-like, with very little rainfall and high temperatures during the summer months, reaching up to 40°C (104°F), while winter temperatures can drop to around 10°C (50°F). Rainfall is scarce, averaging 20-50 mm (0.8-2 in) in the north and less than 25 mm (1 in) in the south, with low humidity levels, especially during winter.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cairo International Airport, where you'll be greeted by our representative and transferred to your hotel in a private vehicle. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and acclimating to your surroundings.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Pyramids, Museum, and Bazaar
itinerary.description: Embark on a fascinating exploration of Cairo's iconic landmarks. Visit the majestic Great Pyramids of Giza, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and marvel at their sheer scale and history. Next, discover the treasures of the Egyptian Museum, home to the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts, including the golden treasures of Tutankhamun. End the day with a vibrant visit to Khan El Khalili Bazaar, one of the oldest markets in the Middle East.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay in Cairo

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxing day at leisure in Cairo, free to explore the city's many wonders on your own. Take a stroll along the Nile River, visit the Citadel of Cairo, or explore the city's many mosques and churches. Alternatively, indulge in some retail therapy at one of Cairo's modern shopping malls or traditional markets.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Cairo and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your incredible Egyptian adventure.

name: Wildlife Wonders of Kenya
metaTitle: Kenya & Victoria Falls Tour Package | Safari & Waterfalls with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the wild beauty of Kenya and the majestic Victoria Falls with Duniya Dekho. Go on thrilling safaris, explore wildlife, and witness the spectacular waterfalls.
description: Experience the ultimate African adventure on this unforgettable 6-day journey through Kenya's breathtaking landscapes and incredible wildlife. Witness the majesty of Africa's iconic animals, explore vibrant cultures, and marvel at the natural beauty of this captivating country. From the flamingo-filled Lake Nakuru to the Big Five of the Masai Mara, experience the thrill of Africa's incredible wildlife in their natural habitat.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Kenya, located in East Africa, is a country of diverse geography and climate. The country's terrain ranges from the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kenya, the highest mountain in the country and the second-highest in Africa, to the arid deserts of the north and the low-lying coast along the Indian Ocean. The Great Rift Valley, which runs from Lebanon to Mozambique, passes through Kenya, creating a series of valleys, lakes, and mountains that dominate the country's landscape.Kenya's climate varies greatly depending on the region. The coastal regions are generally hot and humid, with temperatures ranging from 22°C to 30°C (72°F to 86°F) throughout the year. The central highlands, where cities like Nairobi and Kisumu are located, have a more temperate climate, with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 25°C (50°F to 77°F). The northern regions are arid and semi-arid, with very little rainfall and high temperatures. Kenya has two rainy seasons, the long rains from March to May and the short rains from October to December.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, you'll be greeted with a warm welcome by our driver guide. You'll then be transferred to The Concord Hotel & Suites Nairobi, where a comfortable night's stay awaits on a half-board basis.Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing after your journey.
additionalInfo: Dinner and overnight at The Concord Hotel & Suites Nairobi.

itinerary.title: Ol Pejeta Conservancy Adventure
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a leisurely breakfast, then depart for Ol Pejeta Conservancy, renowned for its groundbreaking conservation efforts and the Jane Goodall Chimpanzee Sanctuary.Savor a delightful lunch amidst the stunning scenery, followed by an exhilarating game drive. Explore the conservancy's vast plains, teeming with an incredible array of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffalo, and numerous antelope species. If fortune favors, catch a glimpse of the elusive leopard.
additionalInfo: As the day draws to a close, retire to the luxurious Sweetwaters Tented Camp for dinner and a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Explore the Great Rift Valley Lakes
itinerary.description: Option 1: Lake Naivasha Adventure
additionalInfo: After a hearty breakfast, depart for Lake Naivasha, a stunning freshwater lake in the Great Rift Valley, renowned for its incredible birdlife, with over 400 species documented. Arrive at Lake Naivasha Country Club in time for lunch. In the afternoon, embark on a relaxing boat trip to spot hippos and an array of bird species.
Dinner and overnight at Lake Naivasha Country Club.

Option 2: Lake Elementaita Getaway Alternatively, after breakfast, head to Lake Elementaita, a picturesque soda ash lake in the Great Rift Valley, famous for its vibrant flamingo populations. Arrive at Sentrim Elementaita Lodge in time for lunch. Spend the afternoon at leisure, relaxing by the pool, taking a refreshing swim, or strolling along the lake's shoreline.Dinner and overnight at Sentrim Elementaita Lodge.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara National Reserve Adventure
itinerary.description: Following a hearty breakfast, depart for the world-renowned Masai Mara National Reserve, a vast and iconic wildlife sanctuary. Part of the greater Serengeti ecosystem, the reserve is famous for its awe-inspiring great wildebeest migrations and is home to the majestic Big Five: lions, elephants, leopards, buffalo, and rhinos.Arrive at your lodge in time for lunch, then embark on an exhilarating afternoon game drive, venturing into the heart of the savannah to witness the incredible diversity of wildlife that calls the Masai Mara home.
additionalInfo: Dinner and overnight at Mara Simba Lodge.

itinerary.title: Immersive Masai Mara Experience
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a leisurely breakfast, followed by a full-day game drive adventure in the Masai Mara National Reserve. Enjoy a picnic lunch amidst the stunning savannah scenery, as you explore the reserve's incredible diversity of wildlife.As Kenya's premier game sanctuary, the Masai Mara offers unparalleled opportunities to spot the iconic Big Five: lions, leopards, buffalo, rhinos, and elephants.In the afternoon, visit a local Maasai village, where you'll gain insight into the traditional customs and ways of life of this ancient and fascinating culture.
additionalInfo: Dinner and overnight at Mara Simba Lodge.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, bid farewell to the Masai Mara and embark on the return journey to Nairobi. Arrive in the capital city in the early afternoon, with a brief stop for lunch at a local restaurant (payable directly).
additionalInfo: After lunch, you'll be transferred to the airport for your departure flight, marking the end of an unforgettable safari adventure with us.

name: Wilds of Tanzania: An Unforgettable Journey
metaTitle: Tanzania Tour Package | Serengeti, Ngorongoro & Zanzibar with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Tanzania with Duniya Dekho. Witness the Serengeti wildlife, Ngorongoro Crater, and relax on the beaches of Zanzibar.
description: Tanzania is home to some of Africa's most breathtaking landscapes and wildlife reserves. In the north, Arusha serves as a gateway to several national parks, including Lake Manyara, known for its tree-climbing lions and stunning lake views. Seronera, located within the Serengeti National Park, offers unparalleled opportunities to witness the Great Migration. The Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, boasts the world's largest intact caldera and an incredible array of wildlife. Tarangire National Park is famous for its majestic baobab trees and large elephant herds. Further east, Kiwengwa, on the island of Zanzibar, showcases pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant coral reefs, making Tanzania a paradise for nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Tanzania's diverse geography spans from the snow-capped peaks of Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest summit, to the vast expanses of the Serengeti plains and the tropical islands of Zanzibar. The country's terrain includes mountains, forests, savannas, and coastal regions, with notable features like the Rift Valley and Lake Victoria. The climate varies from tropical in the coastal regions to temperate in the highlands, with a dry season from June to October and a wet season from November to May. The northern regions experience a bimodal rainfall pattern, while the southern areas have a unimodal pattern, resulting in a range of ecosystems that support an incredible array of flora and fauna.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where you'll be greeted by the warm Tanzanian hospitality. Transfer to Arusha, the vibrant 'Safari Capital' of northern Tanzania. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring this charming town on your own. Enjoy the local markets, cuisine, and scenic views, or simply relax at your hotel. Overnight in Arusha,
additionalInfo: ready to embark on your Tanzanian adventure

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Arusha and transfer to Lake Manyara National Park, renowned for its stunning scenery and diverse wildlife habitats. Arrive in time for lunch and check-in to your hotel. In the afternoon, embark on a thrilling game drive within the park, exploring its lush forests, grasslands, and alkaline lakes. Keep an eye out for over 400 species of birds, as well as the park's famous residents, including:
additionalInfo: Large troops of baboons
Large troops of baboons

Return to your hotel in the evening, surrounded by the park's breathtaking natural beauty. Overnight at the hotel in Lake Manyara National Park.

itinerary.title: Seronera, Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel at Lake Manyara National Park and transfer to Seronera, a prime location in the central Serengeti. This region is renowned for its exceptional wildlife viewing opportunities, particularly during the Great Migration.Arrive in time for lunch at your camp and check-in to your hotel. In the afternoon, embark on a thrilling game drive within the Serengeti National Park, where you may witness:
additionalInfo: The Great Migration in all its glory
Large herds of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles
Predators like lions, leopards, and cheetahs
Elephants, giraffes, and other iconic African wildlife
Return to your hotel in the evening, surrounded by the Serengeti's breathtaking landscapes. Overnight at the hotel in Seronera.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drives in Serengeti
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on an early morning game drive in the Serengeti National Park, where you'll have the opportunity to spot an array of wildlife, including:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros
Large herds of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles
Cheetahs, hyenas, and other predators
Enjoy a thrilling morning of safari adventures, taking in the stunning scenery and unforgettable wildlife encounters.
In the afternoon, enjoy another game drive, with a break for lunch at a scenic spot. Continue your safari adventures, spotting more wildlife and taking in the breathtaking views of the Serengeti.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with the memories of an incredible day in the wild. Overnight at the hotel in Seronera.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Seronera and transfer to the Ngorongoro Crater, a breathtaking natural wonder and one of Africa's most popular safari destinations. This UNESCO-listed site is home to an incredible array of wildlife, including:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros
Large herds of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles
Cheetahs, hyenas, and other predators

Arrive in time for lunch and check-in to your hotel, situated within the crater. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the crater's stunning landscapes and diverse wildlife on your own. Take in the breathtaking views of the surrounding highlands and enjoy the tranquility of this unique natural wonder.
Overnight at the hotel in Ngorongoro Crater, surrounded by the crater's majestic scenery and abundant wildlife.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drive in Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day game drive in the Ngorongoro Crater, with packed lunch boxes to fuel your adventure. Spend the day exploring the crater's diverse landscapes and spotting an incredible array of wildlife, including:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros
Large herds of zebra and wildebeest
Cheetahs, hyenas, and other predators
A variety of bird species and other wildlife

Enjoy a thrilling day of safari adventures, taking in the stunning scenery and unforgettable wildlife encounters. Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with the memories of an incredible day in the Ngorongoro Crater.
Overnight at the hotel in Ngorongoro Crater, surrounded by the crater's majestic scenery and abundant wildlife.

description: Embark on an unforgettable journey along the USA's stunning East Coast, exploring three iconic destinations. Spend two nights in vibrant New York City, taking in the bright lights of Times Square, strolling through Central Park, and visiting world-class museums like the Met. Next, head to our nation's capital, Washington DC, where you'll spend two nights discovering historic landmarks like the White House, Lincoln Memorial, and Smithsonian Institution. Finally, venture to breathtaking Niagara Falls, where you'll spend a relaxing night taking in the majestic views and scenic beauty of this natural wonder. This 5-night adventure offers a perfect blend of city excitement, history, and natural splendor, showcasing the best of the East Coast.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The East Coast of the United States, encompassing New York, Washington DC, and Niagara, boasts a diverse geography and climate. The region's terrain ranges from the rugged Niagara Escarpment and the Appalachian Mountains to the coastal plains and urban landscapes of New York City and Washington DC. The climate is characterized by humid continental conditions, with cold winters and warm summers. Niagara experiences a more pronounced seasonal variation, with snowy winters and mild summers, while New York City and Washington DC have milder winters and hotter, more humid summers. The region's geography and climate support a wide range of ecosystems, from forests and wetlands to urban oases and coastal areas.

name: Best of Canada
metaTitle: Canada Tour Package | Toronto, Niagara Falls, Montreal & Vancouver with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Canada with Duniya Dekho. Visit Toronto, Niagara Falls, Montreal, and Vancouver, experiencing stunning landscapes, iconic landmarks, and vibrant cities.
description: Experience the best of Canada on a journey through vibrant cities and breathtaking mountain landscapes. Explore Vancouver's Stanley Park, Granville Island, and scenic mountains, then head to Revelstoke for outdoor adventures like skiing and whitewater rafting. Discover Canmore's scenic trails and hiking routes in the Canadian Rockies, and visit Jasper National Park for stunning landscapes and wildlife viewing. Stop in Kamloops to enjoy the waterfront and outdoor activities, and visit Whistler's famous ski resort and pedestrian-friendly village. Finally, explore Victoria's historic Fairmont Empress Hotel, Butchart Gardens, and vibrant arts scene, showcasing the diversity and natural beauty of Canada.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Canada boasts diverse geography and climate, featuring majestic Rocky Mountains, vast forests, and scenic coastlines. From Vancouver's mild Pacific climate to the snow-capped peaks of the Rockies in Jasper and Canmore, and the semi-arid desert landscapes of Kamloops, the region's varied terrain creates unique ecosystems and weather patterns. Whistler's mountainous terrain offers world-class skiing, while Victoria's mild climate and coastal location make it a haven for outdoor enthusiasts. Revelstoke's mountainous terrain and snowy winters attract skiers and snowboarders, showcasing Western Canada's incredible geographical and climatic diversity.

itinerary.title: Vancouver Adventure
itinerary.description: Upon arrival, meet your tour manager at Vancouver Airport or designated sightseeing spot. Explore Stanley Park, a 405-hectare green oasis featuring stunning gardens, coastal areas, and towering trees. Discover Vancouver's vibrant cityscape, visiting Chinatown, trendy Robson Street, and the iconic Capilano Suspension Bridge. End the day in historic Gastown, marveling at the whistling Steam Clock and soaking up the area's charm.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vancouver hotel

itinerary.title: Vancouver to Revelstoke
itinerary.description: Depart Vancouver and head to Revelstoke, a charming town in interior British Columbia. Enjoy scenic views along the way, passing by Bridal Veil Falls, the fertile Fraser Valley, and the historic Town of Hope. Explore the Othello Tunnels, a series of historic tunnels carved through the mountains. Arrive in Revelstoke, ready for big mountain adventures and small-town charm.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Revelstoke

itinerary.title: Revelstoke to Canmore
itinerary.description: Start the day with an orientation tour of Revelstoke, exploring its charming downtown and scenic surroundings. Then, head to Canmore, a picturesque town in the heart of the Canadian Rockies, known for its stunning mountain vistas and proximity to Banff National Park. Enjoy the scenic drive and breathtaking views as you arrive in Canmore.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Canmore

itinerary.title: Banff National Park Adventure
itinerary.description: Explore Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Canada's oldest national park. Experience the thrill of White Water Rafting on the Kicking Horse River, followed by scenic stops at Bow Falls and Surprise Corner for breathtaking views of the Bow River and Mount Rundle. Take a panoramic gondola ride for stunning views of the surroundings. Return to Canmore and unwind at a local Craft Beer Brewery, savoring the flavors of the region.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Canmore

itinerary.title: Columbia Icefield and Jasper
itinerary.description: Drive to the Columbia Icefield, one of the world's largest non-polar ice fields. Stop at stunning Lake Louise, Crowfoot Glacier, and Peyto Lake, taking in the breathtaking scenery. At the icefield, ride a Snow Coach to the Athabasca Glacier, exploring the ice and filling bottles with fresh glacier water. Continue to Jasper, a charming alpine town in Jasper National Park, surrounded by majestic mountains and natural beauty.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Jasper

itinerary.title: Jasper National Park Adventure
itinerary.description: Explore Jasper National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Canadian Rockies. Visit Pyramid Lake, nestled at the base of Pyramid Mountain, offering scenic views. Discover Maligne Canyon, known for its limestone walls, waterfalls, and unique wildlife. Take a scenic cruise on Maligne Lake, admiring the azure waters, towering peaks, and glaciers. Enjoy the majestic views of Spirit Island, a highlight of the lake.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Jasper

itinerary.title: Kamloops
itinerary.description: Drive to Kamloops, a vibrant city in British Columbia, with stunning views of Mount Robson, the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies, along the way. Arrive in Kamloops and enjoy free time to relax, explore the city, and take in the surroundings.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Kamloops

itinerary.title: Whistler Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic drive to Whistler, Canada's favorite year-round destination nestled in the breathtaking Coast Mountains of British Columbia. Upon arrival, experience the thrill of the PEAK 2 PEAK Gondola ride, connecting Whistler and Blackcomb mountains, offering unparalleled perspectives of towering volcanic peaks, ancient glaciers, and lush coastal rainforests. Explore the vibrant Whistler Village, capturing memorable photos with the iconic Olympic Rings as your backdrop. Visit the Britannia Mine Museum, where you'll discover a fascinating world of mining history. Ride the Mine Train, rumbling through a haulage tunnel to gain insight into the lives of miners at one of the world's largest copper mines. Be mesmerized by the BOOM! show, a spectacular display of light, sound, and special effects in Mill No. 3, bringing the mill's story to life. As you journey back to Vancouver, take in the stunning views along the famous Sea to Sky Highway, a scenic route that showcases the natural beauty of British Columbia's coastline.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vancouver hotel

itinerary.title: Victoria Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic ferry ride to Victoria, the vibrant capital of British Columbia, sailing through the serene beauty of the Gulf Islands. Arrive at Swartz Bay Terminal and drive to the world-famous Butchart Gardens, a National Historic Site of Canada boasting 55 acres of breathtaking floral displays across various gardens, including the Sunken Garden, Rose Garden, Japanese Garden, Italian Garden, and Mediterranean Garden. Capture stunning photos amidst the beautiful landscapes, bronze statues, and charming birdhouses.Next, visit the Royal BC Museum to uncover the rich history of British Columbia, from the Jurassic Era to the present day. Experience immersive exhibits featuring authentic specimens and highly realistic settings, such as the Woolly Mammoth in his icy world and the diverse sea life at Ocean Station.Explore Victoria's iconic attractions, including the majestic Parliament Buildings and the stunning Craigdarroch Castle. Stroll around the picturesque Inner Harbour, home to colorful floating homes and fishing boats. Admire the iconic Fairmont Empress Hotel and visit Fisherman's Wharf, taking in the sights and sounds of this vibrant waterfront area. After a day of discovery, return to Vancouver, filled with unforgettable memories of Victoria's natural beauty and cultural charm.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vancouver hotel

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Western Canada as you depart, carrying memories of breathtaking mountains, serene lakes, vibrant cities, and warm hospitality. Your tour manager will ensure a smooth transfer to the airport for your onward journey.

name: Australia — Adventure
metaTitle: Australia Tour Package | Sydney, Melbourne & Great Barrier Reef with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Australia with Duniya Dekho. Visit Sydney, Melbourne, the Great Barrier Reef, and experience iconic landmarks, wildlife, and vibrant cities.
description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure through the breathtaking landscapes of Australia, exploring the charming city of Melbourne, the stunning Great Ocean Road, and the majestic Grampians National Park. Begin in Melbourne, Victoria's vibrant capital, before winding your way along the iconic Great Ocean Road to Apollo Bay, with its pristine beaches and lush rainforests. Continue to Warrnambool, renowned for its whale watching opportunities and historic landmarks, and then on to Halls Gap, nestled in the heart of the Grampians National Park, where towering mountains, sparkling waterfalls, and an abundance of wildlife await. Return to Melbourne for a final night, reflecting on the unforgettable experiences and memories made during your journey through one of Australia's most stunning regions.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Australia, the world's sixth-largest country, boasts a diverse geography, ranging from the red sands of the Outback to the lush rainforests of the north and the snow-capped mountains of the southeast. The country's climate varies greatly, from tropical in the north to temperate in the south, with the central desert region experiencing extreme temperatures and low humidity. The northern states, including Queensland and the Northern Territory, have a wet and dry season, while the southern states, such as New South Wales and Victoria, have a more moderate climate with four distinct seasons.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne and Yarra River Cruise
itinerary.description: Welcome to Melbourne, the vibrant cultural capital of Australia! Begin your journey by delving into the city's rich First Nations heritage. Make your way to South Wharf, where you'll embark on a scenic 1-hour Yarra River Cruise. As you glide along the river, take in the stunning city skyline, picturesque gardens, and historic landmarks, setting the tone for an unforgettable adventure in Melbourne. Overnight at your hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Melbourne City Tour and Skydeck Experience
itinerary.description: After breakfast, start your day with a comprehensive Look Around City tour, showcasing Melbourne's iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Visit the legendary Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) and take an insider's tour, exploring the stadium's historic pavilions, player facilities, and the hallowed turf. In the evening, head to the Melbourne Skydeck, located on the 88th floor of the Eureka Tower. Enjoy the thrilling Edge Experience, a glass cube that extends 3 meters outside the building, and take in breathtaking 360-degree views of the city. Additionally, explore the Voyager Theatre, featuring a unique, interactive experience that tells the story of Melbourne's history and culture. Overnight at your hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Melbourne to Apollo Bay via Great Ocean Road
itinerary.description: Pick up your rental car and embark on an epic journey along Victoria's stunning Great Ocean Road. Your first stop is Bells Beach, a world-renowned surf spot and home of the Rip Curl Pro surfing competition. Visit the Great Ocean Road Chocolaterie & Ice Creamery for a sweet treat.Continue driving to the charming beach towns of Anglesea and Aireys Inlet. Take a scenic walk to the Split Point Lighthouse in Aireys Inlet, offering breathtaking views of the coastal cliffs. Next, head to Lorne, a picturesque seaside town with unique shops, cafes, and scenic waterfalls, including Erskine Falls and Sheoak Falls.In the afternoon, drive to Apollo Bay, a quaint fishing town surrounded by the majestic Great Otway National Park. Check-in to your hotel and stroll along the town's beautiful beach. Explore the national park's scenic trails, visit the Otway Fly Tree Top walk, or discover the Wild Life Wonders of the region. Overnight at your hotel in Apollo Bay.

itinerary.title: Apollo Bay to Warrnambool via Great Ocean Road
itinerary.description: Depart Apollo Bay and continue along the stunning Great Ocean Road, stopping at one of its most iconic attractions: The Twelve Apostles limestone rock pillars. Take an optional helicopter ride for a thrilling bird's-eye view of these natural wonders. Visit Loch Ard Gorge, a picturesque cove with a tragic history, and marvel at the dramatic London Arch, a popular natural landmark. Nearby, explore the Grotto sinkhole, where you can peer into the void and witness the ocean's fury.In the afternoon, arrive in Warrnambool, a charming coastal city steeped in history. Visit the Flagstaff Hill Maritime Village, where you'll discover a recreated 19th-century port village. Be mesmerized by the Shipwrecked Sound and Laser Show, and explore the Shipwrecked Museum, showcasing the region's rich maritime heritage. Overnight at your hotel in Warrnambool.

itinerary.title: Warrnambool to Halls Gap via Grampians National Park
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic two-hour drive to the breathtaking Grampians National Park, one of Australia's most spectacular nature reserves. Explore the park's rugged sandstone ridges, visiting iconic attractions like MacKenzie Falls and the Brambuk Cultural Centre, which showcases the region's rich Aboriginal heritage. Indulge in a wine tasting experience at a local vineyard estate, such as Pomonal Estate or Great Western Estate. Keep an eye out for the diverse wildlife that inhabits the park, including deer, foxes, hares, and even dingoes.As you journey through the Grampians, marvel at the dramatic mountain landscapes, with smooth slopes on the west and rugged crags on the east. Arrive in the charming village of Halls Gap, nestled in the heart of the national park, where wild kangaroos roam freely. Overnight at your hotel in Halls Gap.

itinerary.title: Canoeing and Exploring the Grampians
itinerary.description: Embark on a serene canoeing adventure in the breathtaking Grampians National Park. Depart Halls Gap and head to a stunning lake, such as Bellfield or Fyans, where you'll meet your local guide. Paddle leisurely across the lake, taking in the picturesque surroundings and spotting native wildlife, including black swans, cormorants, and ducks.After your canoeing excursion, return to Halls Gap and spend the afternoon at leisure. Optional activities include guided hikes to scenic mountain lookout points and waterfalls, or visiting a First Nations cultural center to delve deeper into the region's rich Aboriginal heritage. Overnight at your hotel in Halls Gap.

itinerary.title: Return to Melbourne via Stawell and Ballarat
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the Grampians and embark on a scenic drive back to Melbourne. En route, stop at the Black Range Scenic Reserve to visit the Bunjil Shelter, featuring ancient First Nations rock art. Take a short walk to the shelter and marvel at the thousands-year-old artwork depicting Bunjil, a revered creator deity.Next, head to Ballarat, Victoria's largest inland city, and indulge in its vibrant arts scene, diverse cuisine, and rich history. Visit Sovereign Hill, a living museum that recreates 1851 Ballarat, complete with costumed characters and historic architecture. Try your luck at gold panning, explore underground mine tours, and relive the excitement of the gold rush era. After a fascinating day in Ballarat, depart for Melbourne, reflecting on the unforgettable experiences and memories made during your journey. Overnight at your hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Departure from Melbourne
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure, exploring Melbourne's vibrant streets, revisiting favorite attractions, or discovering new hidden gems. As your journey comes to a close, make your way to Melbourne Airport, returning your rental car to the depot.Bid farewell to Melbourne and Australia, carrying memories of your unforgettable adventure. Depart from Melbourne Airport, heading home or to your next destination. Safe travels!

name: Discover New Zealand
metaTitle: New Zealand Tour Package | Auckland, Rotorua & Queenstown with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore New Zealand with Duniya Dekho. Visit Auckland, Rotorua, Queenstown, and Fiordland National Park, experiencing stunning landscapes, adventure activities, and Maori culture.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through New Zealand's diverse landscapes and cultures. Begin in Auckland, the City of Sails, where you'll spend a night surrounded by the harbor's stunning vistas. Next, travel to Rotorua, a geothermal wonderland, where you'll spend two nights immersed in Maori traditions and marveling at the region's unique landscapes. Then, fly to Queenstown, the Adventure Capital of the World, where you'll spend two nights surrounded by the majestic Southern Alps and pristine Lake Wakatipu. Finally, travel to Christchurch, the Garden City, where you'll spend a night exploring the city's vibrant arts scene, scenic parks, and historic landmarks, bringing your New Zealand adventure to a close.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: New Zealand, an island nation in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, boasts a diverse geography characterized by rugged mountains, pristine fjords, and stunning coastlines. The country's landscape is dominated by the Southern Alps, which stretch along the western edge of the South Island, while the North Island is marked by volcanic plateaus, scenic lakes, and picturesque harbors. New Zealand's climate is generally mild and temperate, with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 25°C (50°F to 77°F), influenced by its maritime location and the prevailing westerly winds. The country experiences four distinct seasons, with summer (December to February) being the warmest and winter (June to August) being the coolest, making it an ideal destination for outdoor enthusiasts year-round.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Arrive in Auckland, New Zealand's largest city, and transfer to your hotel. Auckland is nestled between two stunning harbors, boasting gentle sandy shores on the east coast and rugged, black sand beaches with wild surf on the west coast. The city's picturesque landscape is dotted with beautiful emerald islands, sheltered by sparkling blue waters. Consider exploring the harbor or taking a ferry ride to nearby islands to make the most of your time in Auckland.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Auckland to Rotorua via Hobbiton Movie Set
itinerary.description: Embark on a guided coach tour through New Zealand's picturesque countryside to the world-famous Hobbiton Movie Set. This iconic destination is a must-visit for any Lord of the Rings and Hobbit fan. As you explore the Movie Set, your knowledgeable guide will share fascinating behind-the-scenes stories and anecdotes. Discover the charming Hobbit Holes, the historic Mill, and the lively Green Dragon Inn, and learn how a picturesque farm was transformed into a breathtaking Middle-earth setting. Enjoy a delicious lunch at The Green Dragon Inn, savoring the flavors of the Shire. After lunch, continue your journey to Rotorua, a city steeped in Maori culture and natural wonders.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Explore Rotorua's Geothermal Wonders & Maori Culture
itinerary.description: Discover the natural wonders and rich cultural heritage of Rotorua. This afternoon, visit Te Puia, a premier Maori cultural center, where you'll embark on a guided tour. Explore the Maori Arts and Crafts Institute, the Kiwi Conservation Centre, and the breathtaking geothermal valley, featuring unique steam vents, spouting geysers, and bubbling mud pools. As the sun sets, indulge in a traditional Hangi Dinner overlooking the valley and geyser, followed by a captivating 40-minute cultural performance. The evening concludes with a sweet treat – hot chocolate and pudding on the geyser terrace, surrounded by the serene natural beauty of Rotorua.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Rotorua to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Depart Rotorua on a domestic flight to Queenstown (airfare not included). Upon arrival, immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this compact alpine resort town. Surrounded by majestic mountains and picturesque vistas, Queenstown is aptly known as the Adventure Capital of the World. With its stunning natural setting and plethora of outdoor activities, Queenstown is the perfect destination for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a breathtaking journey to Fiordland, one of the world's most pristine and remote wilderness areas. Travel past serene mirror lakes and cascading waterfalls to Milford Sound, a majestic fjord carved by ancient glaciers and renowned as the 'Eighth Wonder of the World.' Board your vessel for a scenic cruise, surrounded by towering mountains and cliffs that plunge dramatically into the sea. Get up close to stunning waterfalls and feel the mist on your face as you glide across the tranquil waters. After an unforgettable day, return to Queenstown by coach, reflecting on the lifetime memories you've created.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Christchurch via Mt Cook
itinerary.description: Depart Queenstown and embark on a scenic journey with your knowledgeable driver guide, who will bring the region's history and stories to life. Travel through the breathtaking Kawarau Gorge, the picturesque towns of Cromwell and Lake Dunstan, and the dramatic Lindis Pass. Enter the stunning Mackenzie district, where you'll marvel at the majestic turquoise lakes, Aoraki Mt Cook, and the Southern Alps. Stop at Mt Cook Village, with some free time to explore. As you continue, your driver guide will point out iconic Lord of the Rings filming locations. Visit Lake Tekapo, with a stop near the picturesque Church of the Good Shepherd, before arriving in Christchurch in the evening.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Christchurch.
Please Note: Mt Cook tours may not operate daily. Depending on your travel dates, an itinerary adjustment may be necessary.

itinerary.title: Departure from Christchurch
itinerary.description: This morning, check out of your hotel and proceed to Christchurch Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your unforgettable New Zealand adventure. Bid farewell to the Land of the Long White Cloud, carrying with you the stunning landscapes, rich culture, and warm hospitality that have left a lasting impression on your heart.

name: Best of Europe
metaTitle: Best of Europe Tour Package – 13 Days | Paris, Amsterdam, Switzerland & Italy | Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Embark on a captivating 13-day Best of Europe tour with Duniya Dekho. Explore Amsterdam, Paris, Lucerne, Venice, Florence, and Rome, experiencing Europe’s rich history, iconic architecture, scenic landscapes, and diverse cultures.
description: Embark on a captivating 13-day journey through Europe's most enchanting cities. Discover the charming canals of Amsterdam, the romantic elegance of Paris, the breathtaking scenery of Lucerne, the majestic beauty of Venice, the artistic treasures of Florence, and the ancient grandeur of Rome.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: This 13-day Europe tour spans across six countries, each with unique geography and climate. Amsterdam, Netherlands, is situated near the North Sea, with a temperate maritime climate and mild winters. Paris, France, lies in the north-central part, with a temperate oceanic climate and cool winters. Lucerne, Switzerland, is nestled in the mountains, with a temperate climate and cold winters. Venice, Italy, is built on islands in the Adriatic Sea, with a humid subtropical climate and hot summers. Florence and Rome, Italy, are located in central Italy, with Mediterranean climates and mild winters. Overall, the climate varies greatly, with temperatures ranging from 3°C (37°F) in winter to 32°C (90°F) in summer, making it essential to pack accordingly.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amsterdam
itinerary.description: Arrive in Amsterdam, the charming Dutch capital, and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. Known as the 'Venice of the North,' Amsterdam delights visitors with its picturesque canals, rich history, and vibrant culture. Spend the day exploring the iconic Canal Ring, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and discover the city's unique blend of traditional and modern charm. Uncover the Netherlands' fascinating history, innovative spirit, and artistic heritage, all in the captivating city of Amsterdam.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Amsterdam.

itinerary.title: Dutch Countryside Tour
itinerary.description: Venture into the picturesque Dutch countryside on a 5.5-hour coach tour from Amsterdam. Discover the iconic Zaanse Schans windmills, a quintessential symbol of Holland's rich heritage.Visit the Volendam Cheese Factory and indulge in a tasting of authentic Dutch cheese. Watch artisans at work as they craft traditional wooden shoes using an antique steam engine.
additionalInfo: Return to Amsterdam in the evening and enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Amsterdam to Paris
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Amsterdam and travel to the enchanting city of Paris by train. The City of Lights is famous for its stunning artistic heritage, iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, and the historic charm of Montmartre.Spend the evening strolling along the picturesque Seine River or exploring the vibrant streets of Le Marais, where art, fashion, and cuisine blend together in perfect harmony.Experience the spectacular Moulin Rouge show, a world-famous cabaret that embodies the essence of Parisian nightlife.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour
itinerary.description: Discover the eternal charm of Paris on a 4-hour coach tour, exploring the city's iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Enjoy a scenic Seine River Cruise, admiring the city's majestic architecture from a unique perspective.Visit the iconic Eiffel Tower, ascending to the second floor for breathtaking panoramic views of the city. Take in the stunning vistas and capture unforgettable memories.
additionalInfo: Louvre Museum: Delve into the world's largest art museum, housing an impressive collection of art and artifacts, including the Mona Lisa.
Paris Montmartre Food Tour: Embark on a culinary adventure, sampling the flavors and delicacies of Montmartre, one of Paris' most charming neighborhoods.
Overnight stay in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Paris and board the train to Basel or Zurich, marking the beginning of your Swiss adventure. Upon arrival in Switzerland, take advantage of the convenient Swiss Travel Pass, which grants you unlimited travel on trains, boats, trams, and buses across the Swiss Travel System.Use your pass to continue your journey to the charming city of Lucerne, nestled in the heart of Switzerland. Enjoy the scenic views of the Swiss countryside as you travel to Lucerne.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis and Lake Lucerne
itinerary.description: Make the most of your Swiss Travel Pass and embark on an unforgettable alpine adventure to Mount Titlis. Enjoy breathtaking views, indulge in snow activities, and experience the thrill of the revolving Titlis Rotair gondola.In the afternoon, unwind with a serene Lake Lucerne Cruise, surrounded by picturesque landscapes and tranquil waters. Take in the majestic scenery, relax, and recharge.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Explore Switzerland at Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a day of unrestricted exploration in Switzerland, courtesy of your Swiss Travel Pass. Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Grindelwald and Interlaken, two picturesque towns nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps.
additionalInfo: Optional: Enhance your experience with a visit to Grindelwald First, where you can indulge in thrilling activities and marvel at panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Choose any two activities, such as the First Cliff Walk, First Glider, or First Mountain Cart, for an unforgettable adventure.
Overnight stay in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Venice
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Lucerne and embark on a scenic train journey to Venice Mestre with convenient interchanges along the way. Upon arrival, be mesmerized by Venice’s breathtaking beauty—picturesque canals weaving through the city, iconic gondolas gliding effortlessly on the water, and the enchanting architecture of St. Mark’s Square and the Doge’s Palace.Immerse yourself in the romantic allure of Italy's floating city, where elegance and charm await around every corner.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Venice Mestre.

itinerary.title: Discover Venice
itinerary.description: Unravel the mysteries of Venice with a guided Small Group Walking Tour. Embark on a fascinating journey through the city's narrow streets, ornate palaces, and captivating churches.Begin at the iconic Piazza San Marco, where you'll uncover the secrets and history of:
additionalInfo: St. Mark's Basilica, with its breathtaking Byzantine architecture.
Doge's Palace, the former residence of the Doge of Venice
Bell Tower, offering panoramic views of the city
Your tour will also take you through:
Campo SS. Giovanni e Paolo, a picturesque square with stunning architecture
Marco Polo's House, a nod to the famous explorer's Venetian heritage
The Mercerie, a historic shopping district filled with charm and character
Optional: Experience the quintessential Venetian charm with a 30-minute Gondola Ride, gliding through the city's serene canals. Overnight stay in Venice.

itinerary.title: Venice to Florence
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Venice and travel to Florence by train, arriving in the city known as the 'Cradle of the Renaissance.' Florence is renowned for its incredible art, architecture, and cultural heritage.
additionalInfo: ODiscover the city's iconic landmarks, including:
The majestic Duomo, a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture
The medieval stone bridge Ponte Vecchio, lined with shops and boutiques
The vibrant streets of Florence, filled with charming piazzas, cafes, and art galleries
Immerse yourself in Florence's rich artistry and history, exploring the city's many museums, galleries, and historic sites.
Half-Day Pisa Excursion (5.5 hours): Visit the famous Leaning Tower of Pisa, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and explore the charming town of Pisa.
Half-Day Chianti Vineyards Excursion (5.5 hours): Discover the rolling hills, charming villages, and renowned vineyards of the Chianti region, sampling some of the area's finest wines.
Overnight stay in Florence.

itinerary.title: Florence to Rome
itinerary.description: Travel from Florence to Rome by train, arriving in the 'Eternal City,' renowned for its ancient history, architectural landmarks, and vibrant culture.
additionalInfo: Discover Rome's iconic treasures, including:
The beautiful Trevi Fountain, where legend has it that tossing a coin ensures your return to Rome
The majestic Spanish Steps, one of the city's most famous landmarks
The ancient Colosseum, a testament to Rome's rich history and architectural prowess
Vatican City, the center of the Catholic Church, featuring numerous iconic landmarks, including St. Peter's Basilica and the Sistine Chapel
Immerse yourself in Rome's timeless allure, exploring the city's ancient ruins, historic landmarks, and vibrant neighborhoods.

Vatican Museums Walking Tour (Small Group, 3 hours): Delve into the Vatican's vast art collection, featuring works by Michelangelo and Raphael, and explore the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica with a knowledgeable guide.
Overnight stay in Rome.

itinerary.title: Colosseum and Roman Forum Walking Tour
itinerary.description: Step into the ancient heart of Rome on an immersive walking tour, exploring the iconic Colosseum and Roman Forum with a knowledgeable local guide
additionalInfo: Unravel the captivating history of Rome, uncovering stories of:
Powerful emperors who ruled the empire
Brave gladiators who fought in the arena
A city that once was the epicenter of civilization
Visit the monumental Colosseum, an awe-inspiring symbol of ancient grandeur, and wander through the evocative ruins of the Roman Forum, where the echoes of a glorious past still linger.

Vatican Museums Walking Tour (Small Group, 3 hours): Explore the Vatican's vast art collection, featuring works by Michelangelo and Raphael, and visit the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica with a knowledgeable guide.
Overnight stay in Rome.

itinerary.title: Departure from Rome
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Rome and bring your unforgettable journey through Paris, Switzerland, and Italy to a close. Enjoy a convenient private transfer from your Rome hotel to Rome airport, ensuring a stress-free departure.Reflect on the incredible experiences and memories you've made during your travels, from the City of Lights to the Swiss Alps and the ancient ruins of Italy.
additionalInfo: Safe travels, and we hope to see you again soon!.

name: Best of Turkey
metaTitle: Turkey Tour Package | Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale & Antalya with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Turkey with Duniya Dekho. Discover Istanbul’s historic sites, Cappadocia hot air balloons, Pamukkale travertines, and Antalya’s Mediterranean coastline.
description: Embark on an unforgettable 8-day journey through Turkey, exploring the country's vibrant cities, ancient ruins, and breathtaking landscapes. This comprehensive itinerary takes you to the bustling streets of Istanbul, the ancient city of Ephesus, the natural wonders of Pamukkale, and the surreal landscapes of Cappadocia.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Turkey's diverse geography spans across Western Asia and Southeastern Europe, bordering eight countries and featuring mountains, plains, coastlines, and islands. The country's terrain includes the Pontic and Taurus Mountains, Anatolian Plateau, and Aegean and Mediterranean coastlines.Turkey's climate varies greatly, with Mediterranean, continental, oceanic, and semi-arid climates present across different regions. The Aegean and Mediterranean coasts experience hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters, while the Anatolian Plateau has cold, snowy winters and warm, dry summers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Istanbul Airport, where you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel. Check-in and freshen up, then spend the rest of the day exploring this vibrant city at your own pace.Discover the bustling streets, historic landmarks, and vibrant markets of Istanbul. Get a taste of the local cuisine, visit the famous Taksim Square, or take a stroll along the Bosphorus Strait.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Classical City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a comprehensive Full Day Istanbul Classical City tour, exploring the iconic landmarks and historic treasures of this ancient city.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Blue Mosque: Marvel at the stunning architecture and beautiful blue tiles of this magnificent mosque.
Hippodrome: Explore the ancient heart of Istanbul's sporting and social life.
St Sophia Museum: Discover the rich history and stunning architecture of this former Byzantine church and Ottoman mosque.
Topkapi Palace: Uncover the secrets of the Ottoman Empire's primary residence, featuring stunning gardens, kitchens, and treasure houses.
Grand Bazaar: Get lost in the vibrant stalls and shops of one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Istanbul's classical treasures.
Overnight at the hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Fly to Izmir and Explore Kusadasi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to Istanbul and proceed to Istanbul Airport for your domestic flight to Izmir.Upon arrival at Izmir Airport, transfer to your hotel in Kusadasi, a charming coastal town on the Aegean coast.Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Kusadasi's picturesque streets, vibrant markets, and stunning beaches. You can also visit the nearby ancient city of Ephesus or take a relaxing stroll along the marina.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Explore Ephesus and its Ancient Wonders
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a fascinating full-day tour of Kusadasi, exploring the ancient ruins and historical landmarks of the region.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Ephesus Ruins: Walk through the ancient streets of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved archaeological sites in Turkey, featuring the impressive Library of Celsus, the Great Theatre, and the Temple of Hadrian.
Artemis Temple: Visit the remains of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
Virgin Mary Church: Explore the historic church where the Virgin Mary is believed to have spent her final days.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Ephesus and its ancient wonders
Overnight at the hotel in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Discover the Natural Wonders of Pamukkale
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Kusadasi and embark on a fascinating Full Day Pamukkale tour.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Karahayit Red Spring Water: Witness the stunning red-colored thermal waters, a result of the high iron content.
Hierapolis Cotton Terraces: Marvel at the breathtaking travertine formations, resembling cotton or snow, created by the natural hot springs.
Ancient City of Hierapolis: Explore the ruins of the ancient city, featuring:
Domitian Gate: One of the main gates of the city.
Latrina: The ancient public toilets.
Oil Factory: Where ancient oil production took place.
Agora: The heart of the ancient city, where commerce and social life thrived.
Byzantium Gate: A well-preserved gate from the Byzantine era.
Triton Fountain: A beautifully preserved ancient fountain.
Apollon Temple: Dedicated to the ancient Greek god Apollo.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Pamukkale's natural wonders.
Overnight at the hotel in Pamukkale.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cappadocia
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Cappadocia, a region renowned for its breathtaking landscapes, unique fairy chimneys, and honeycombed hills.Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the charming town of Goreme or the surrounding landscapes.Take a stroll through the picturesque valleys, visit the local shops and cafes, or simply relax and enjoy the serene atmosphere of this natural wonderland.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia North Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a fascinating Full Day Cappadocia North Tour, exploring the unique landscapes, ancient ruins, and traditional villages of the region.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Devrent Valley: Marvel at the stunning landscapes and unique fairy chimneys of this picturesque valley.
Avanos Village: Visit a traditional handmade pottery making workshop, where you can learn about and witness the ancient art of pottery making.
Goreme Open Air Museum: Explore the ancient cave churches and monasteries, featuring stunning Byzantine frescoes and intricate stone carvings.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Cappadocia's natural wonders and rich cultural heritage.
Overnight at the hotel in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Cappadocia and bid farewell to this enchanting region.Proceed to Kayseri or Nevsehir Airport for your departure flight, carrying with you unforgettable memories of your Turkish adventure.We hope you had a wonderful time exploring the vibrant cities, ancient ruins, and breathtaking landscapes of Turkey.
additionalInfo: Safe travels, and we look forward to welcoming you on another journey soon!

name: Paris & Swiss Delight
metaTitle: Swiss & Paris Tour Package | Zurich, Lucerne & Disneyland Paris with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Witness Alpine beauty in Switzerland and experience iconic Paris landmarks with Duniya Dekho. Includes Mt. Titlis, Jungfraujoch, Seine Cruise and Disneyland.
description: Experience the best of Switzerland and Paris on this 7-night journey! Discover the romance and charm of Paris (3N), with its iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Louvre Museum. Then, travel to Lucerne (3N), a picturesque Swiss city nestled between mountains and lakes, where you can admire the stunning Chapel Bridge, visit the Lion Monument, and take a scenic boat tour on Lake Lucerne. Finally, visit Zurich (1N), Switzerland's largest city, known for its sleek architecture, vibrant cultural scene, and stunning lake views, and explore its historic Old Town, famous Bahnhofstrasse shopping street, and diverse culinary offerings.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Switzerland is a landlocked country located in Western Europe, bordered by Germany to the north, France to the west, Italy to the south, and Austria and Liechtenstein to the east. The country's geography is characterized by the Swiss Alps, which cover nearly two-thirds of its territory, as well as numerous lakes, rivers, and valleys. The climate varies greatly depending on the region, with cold winters and warm summers in the north, and Mediterranean-like conditions in the south. Overall, Switzerland's unique geography and climate make it a popular destination for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in the City of Light
itinerary.description: Bonjour! Welcome to Paris, the enchanting French capital famous for its stunning architecture, art museums, fashion, and romantic ambiance. Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be greeted with a private vehicle transfer to your hotel. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, soaking up the city's magical atmosphere.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Discover the Timeless Charm of Paris
itinerary.description:
Start your day with a delicious breakfast, followed by a captivating 4-hour coach tour of the City of Light. Explore the iconic landmarks, historic bridges, and picturesque neighborhoods that make Paris so unforgettable.

Next, embark on a scenic 1-hour Seine River cruise, offering a unique perspective on the city's majestic architecture. Admire the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and other iconic sights while learning about their history and significance.

The highlight of your day is a visit to the Eiffel Tower, where you'll ascend to the second floor for breathtaking panoramic views of the city.

Optional: Visit the world-famous Louvre Museum, home to the Mona Lisa and many other artistic treasures.

Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of your Parisian adventure.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: A Day to Indulge in Parisian Delights
itinerary.description:
Savor a delicious breakfast, and then enjoy a leisurely day to explore the City of Light at your own pace. Delve deeper into Paris' iconic attractions, wander through charming neighborhoods like Montmartre or Le Marais, and soak up the city's vibrant atmosphere.

Optional Experiences:

Disneyland Paris: Treat your family to a magical day at Disneyland Paris, with a 1-day, 1-park ticket and shuttle coach transfers. Enjoy thrilling rides, spectacular shows, and meet your favorite Disney characters.
Lindt Home of Chocolate Factory: Indulge your sweet tooth with a visit to the Lindt Home of Chocolate Factory. Discover the art of chocolate-making, sample delicious treats, and take home some sweet souvenirs.

Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your Parisian adventure.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Journey to Lucerne, Switzerland
itinerary.description:
Bid adieu to Paris and embark on a new adventure in Switzerland! After breakfast, check-out of your hotel and board the train to Lucerne, a charming Swiss city nestled between mountains and lakes.

Upon arrival in Switzerland, take advantage of your Swiss Travel Pass, which grants you unlimited access to the Swiss Travel System. Enjoy seamless travel on trains, boats, trams, and buses, exploring the country's breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities.

Arrive in Lucerne and transfer to your hotel, where you'll check-in and freshen up. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Lucerne's picturesque old town, scenic lakefront, and iconic landmarks like the Chapel Bridge and Lion Monument.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis Adventure and Lake Lucerne Cruise
itinerary.description:
Start your day with a delicious breakfast, followed by a scenic train ride to Engelberg, using your convenient Swiss Travel Pass. Visit the majestic Mt. Titlis, a paradise for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

Experience the thrill of the Ice Flyer, a chairlift that soars over the glacier, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. Take in the stunning scenery and enjoy the crisp mountain air.

Return to Lucerne in the afternoon and head to the pier, conveniently located next to the train station. Embark on a relaxing cruise on Lake Lucerne, using your Swiss Travel Pass. Admire the picturesque landscapes, charming villages, and majestic mountains that surround the lake.

After the cruise, return to your hotel, filled with wonderful memories of your Mt. Titlis adventure and Lake Lucerne cruise.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Lucerne
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxing day at leisure in Lucerne, exploring the city's charming streets, picturesque alleys, and scenic lakefront. Visit the iconic Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument, and Jesuit Church, or stroll through the beautiful Old Town.

Optional Experience:

Grindelwald First: Take a day trip to Grindelwald First, a breathtaking mountain resort in the Swiss Alps. Choose any two activities from the following options:
First Cliff Walk: A thrilling walkway with stunning views of the surrounding mountains.
First Glider: A scenic glider ride offering breathtaking views of the Alps.
First Mountain Cart: A fun and exhilarating ride down the mountain on a specially designed cart.

Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your day in Lucerne.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Zurich, the Vibrant Financial Hub
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, board the train to Zurich, Switzerland's financial capital and a city that seamlessly blends tradition with modernity. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in.

Spend the rest of the day exploring Zurich's eclectic mix of attractions, from world-class museums like the Kunsthaus art museum to the picturesque Old Town, with its narrow streets, charming squares, and colorful buildings.

Optional Experiences:

Rhine Falls Boat Ride: Take a thrilling boat ride to the Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall, and enjoy the stunning scenery and spray of the falls.
Lindt Chocolate Museum: Indulge your sweet tooth with a visit to the Lindt Chocolate Museum, where you can learn about the history of chocolate-making and sample some of Lindt's delicious creations.

Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your day in Zurich.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Zurich.

itinerary.title: Departure from Zurich
itinerary.description:
After a delicious breakfast, check-out of your hotel and bid farewell to Zurich. Transfer to Zurich Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your wonderful journey through Paris and Switzerland.

We hope you had an amazing trip and look forward to welcoming you again soon!
