name: Royal Britain & Enchanting Ireland
metaTitle: England, Scotland & Ireland Tour Package | London, Edinburgh & Dublin
metaDescription: Explore London, Edinburgh and Dublin with Duniya Dekho. Includes London city tour, Edinburgh Castle, Scottish Highlands and Dublin attractions.
description: This carefully curated 15-day journey offers an immersive exploration of the United Kingdom and Ireland, combining historic cities, royal landmarks, dramatic coastlines, and breathtaking countryside. The itinerary is designed to balance guided sightseeing with scenic drives and relaxed leisure time, allowing travelers to experience the cultural depth, architectural heritage, and natural beauty of five distinct regions. From the iconic streets of London and the literary towns of England to the misty Scottish Highlands and the rugged Cliffs of Moher, this tour delivers a seamless blend of history, culture, and scenic charm. Cross-border travel between England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland, and the Republic of Ireland adds richness and diversity, making this itinerary ideal for travelers seeking a comprehensive and memorable European experience.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The region experiences a temperate maritime climate, strongly influenced by the Atlantic Ocean. This results in generally mild weather throughout the year, with moderate seasonal variations and occasional rainfall. Summers, from May to September, are pleasant and comfortable, with average temperatures ranging between 15°C and 25°C, making it ideal for sightseeing and outdoor exploration. Winters are cool rather than extreme, particularly in England and Ireland, while Scotland and Northern Ireland can experience colder conditions, especially in the Highlands. Rain showers can occur at any time of year, contributing to the region’s lush green landscapes, and travelers are advised to carry light jackets and rain protection for comfort.

itinerary.title: : Arrival at London – Windsor – London
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at London Heathrow Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and begin your journey into England, a country known for its royal legacy, historic landmarks, and global influence. After immigration clearance, proceed towards the historic town of Windsor, home to the magnificent Windsor Castle, the oldest and largest inhabited castle in the world and an official residence of the British monarchy. After exploring this royal town, you will return to London, the capital city of England, where tradition and modernity coexist effortlessly. The remainder of the evening is at leisure to relax after your long flight before settling in for an overnight stay in London.
additionalInfo: The remainder of the evening is at leisure to relax after your long flight before settling in for an overnight stay in London.

itinerary.title: London
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to discovering the iconic highlights of London, one of the world’s most cosmopolitan cities. The city tour introduces you to famous landmarks such as Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, and Trafalgar Square, each narrating centuries of British history. London is also known for its cultural diversity, world-class museums, and vibrant shopping streets.
additionalInfo: You may choose to enjoy leisure time exploring Covent Garden, Oxford Street, or taking a scenic walk along the River Thames before returning to the hotel for another overnight stay in London.

itinerary.title: London – Oxford – Stonehenge – Bath / Swindon
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you depart London and travel through the picturesque English countryside towards Oxford, renowned for its prestigious university and stunning medieval architecture. Continuing onward, you visit Stonehenge, one of the world’s most mysterious prehistoric monuments, standing majestically on the Salisbury Plain. Later, the journey proceeds to Bath or Swindon for the night. Bath is famous for its Roman Baths and elegant Georgian architecture, reflecting England’s ancient and classical heritage.
additionalInfo: You will check into your hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening.

itinerary.title: Bath / Swindon – Cardiff
itinerary.description: Leaving England behind, today you enter Wales, a country celebrated for its Celtic culture, dramatic landscapes, and historic castles. You travel to Cardiff, the Welsh capital, known for its compact city center and rich history. Upon arrival, you may explore Cardiff Castle, an impressive fortress set amidst modern city surroundings, showcasing Roman, Norman, and Victorian influences.
additionalInfo: The evening is free to explore Cardiff Bay or enjoy local Welsh cuisine before overnight stay in Cardiff.

itinerary.title: Cardiff – Stratford-upon-Avon – Manchester
itinerary.description: This morning, you journey back into England, traveling through rolling countryside towards Stratford-upon-Avon, the birthplace of William Shakespeare. The town is filled with charming timber-framed houses and literary significance. After soaking in the atmosphere of this historic town, you continue northwards to Manchester, a dynamic city known for its industrial heritage, world-famous football culture, and vibrant music scene. On arrival,
additionalInfo: you check into your hotel and relax for the evening.

itinerary.title: Edinburgh – Flight to Dublin
itinerary.description: Short flight to Dublin. Evening free for leisure or optional Irish pub experience.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Dublin hotel

itinerary.title: Manchester – Lake District – Windermere – Gretna Green – Glasgow
itinerary.description: After breakfast, the journey heads towards the breathtaking Lake District National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its serene lakes, rolling hills, and poetic landscapes. A visit to Windermere, the largest lake in England, offers stunning natural views. Continuing north, you cross into Scotland, stopping at Gretna Green, famous for its romantic wedding traditions. By evening, you arrive in Glasgow, Scotland’s largest city, known for its Victorian architecture, vibrant arts scene, and friendly atmosphere,
additionalInfo: where you will stay for the next three nights.

itinerary.title: Glasgow – Edinburgh – Kelpies – Glasgow
itinerary.description: Today you explore Edinburgh, the capital of Scotland, a city steeped in history and dramatic scenery. Highlights include the majestic Edinburgh Castle, perched atop Castle Rock, and the historic Royal Mile. On the return journey, you stop to view The Kelpies, massive horse-head sculptures symbolizing Scotland’s industrial heritage and folklore. You return to Glasgow in the evening for overnight stay.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Dublin hotel

itinerary.title: Glasgow – Dunkeld – Pitlochry – Loch Tummel – Glenturret Distillery – Glasgow
itinerary.description: This day offers a deep dive into the scenic Scottish Highlands, known for their rugged beauty and tranquil landscapes. You travel through the charming villages of Dunkeld and Pitlochry, followed by a visit to Loch Tummel, offering panoramic views of the surrounding hills.
additionalInfo: A stop at Glenturret Distillery, one of Scotland’s oldest whisky distilleries, provides insight into traditional whisky-making. You return to Glasgow by evening.

itinerary.title: Glasgow – Belfast
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you transfer to the port or airport for your journey to Belfast, the capital of Northern Ireland. Belfast is a city of resilience and renewal, known for its shipbuilding history and cultural revival.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, you check into your hotel and enjoy a relaxed evening exploring the city.

itinerary.title: Belfast
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to exploring Belfast and its surroundings. You may visit landmarks such as Titanic Belfast, which tells the story of the city’s shipbuilding legacy, along with city highlights reflecting both history and modern development.
additionalInfo: Northern Ireland’s landscapes are lush and green due to frequent rainfall, giving the region its famous emerald appearance. Overnight stay in Belfast.

itinerary.title: Belfast – Roscommon / Athlone
itinerary.description: Leaving Northern Ireland, you enter the Republic of Ireland, a country known for its warm hospitality, rolling green countryside, and rich folklore. You travel south through scenic rural landscapes to Roscommon or Athlone, located in the heart of Ireland.
additionalInfo: The evening is free to relax and experience the peaceful charm of the Irish countryside.

itinerary.title: Roscommon / Athlone – Cliffs of Moher – Dublin
itinerary.description: Today’s journey takes you westward to the spectacular Cliffs of Moher, one of Ireland’s most iconic natural wonders, where dramatic cliffs rise above the Atlantic Ocean offering unforgettable views.
additionalInfo: After this breathtaking experience, you proceed east towards Dublin, Ireland’s lively capital city, known for its literary heritage, historic pubs, and youthful energy. Upon arrival, you check into your hotel for a two-night stay.

itinerary.title: Dublin – Kildare – Dublin
itinerary.description: This day is spent exploring Dublin’s major attractions, including historic streets, cultural landmarks, and lively neighborhoods. Later, you travel to Kildare, famous for its luxury outlet shopping and Irish heritage sites.
additionalInfo: After leisure time, you return to Dublin for your final overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dublin – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to Dublin Airport for your onward journey.
additionalInfo: The tour concludes with wonderful memories of the United Kingdom and Ireland, encompassing royal cities, natural wonders, and rich cultural experiences across five countries.

name: European Dreams: Paris, Switzerland & Austria
metaTitle: Austria, Switzerland & Paris Tour Package | Vienna, Alps & Eiffel Tower with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Discover Vienna, the Swiss Alps and Paris with Duniya Dekho. Includes Schönbrunn Palace, Mt. Titlis, Jungfraujoch, Seine Cruise and Disneyland Paris.
description: This exciting European itinerary combines the romance of Paris with the breathtaking alpine landscapes of Switzerland and the cultural elegance of Austria, along with a unique visit to Liechtenstein. From iconic landmarks, Versailles, and Disneyland Paris to scenic lakes, snow-capped mountains, Rhine Falls, and historic imperial cities, the journey offers a perfect blend of culture, nature, and leisure. Ideal for families, couples, and first-time travelers, this tour delivers a memorable and well-balanced European experience across four beautiful countries.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The region experiences a predominantly temperate continental and alpine climate, with clear seasonal variations influenced by altitude and geography. Summers, from May to September, are generally mild to warm and ideal for sightseeing, with temperatures ranging between 18°C and 30°C in cities, while alpine regions remain cooler and refreshing. Winters are colder, especially in Switzerland and Austria’s mountainous areas, where snowfall is common and landscapes transform into scenic winter wonderlands. Spring and autumn bring pleasant weather, blooming valleys, and colorful foliage, making these seasons popular for travel. Occasional rainfall can occur throughout the year, particularly in alpine regions, and travelers are advised to carry layered clothing to stay comfortable in changing weather conditions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paris
itinerary.description: Upon arrival in Paris, the capital of France and one of the most romantic cities in the world, you will be transferred to your hotel. Paris is renowned for its timeless architecture, artistic heritage, and elegant lifestyle.
additionalInfo: The rest of the day is free to relax or enjoy a leisurely walk around nearby streets, cafés, and boulevards, soaking in the unmistakable Parisian atmosphere before your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Paris City Tour
itinerary.description: Today you explore the iconic highlights of Paris, a city that effortlessly blends history, art, and modern culture. The panoramic city tour introduces you to world-famous landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower, Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Louvre Museum exterior.
additionalInfo: The scenic drive along the River Seine showcases Paris at its most elegant, making this a truly memorable introduction to the City of Lights.

itinerary.title: Versailles & Disneyland Paris
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you proceed to the magnificent Palace of Versailles, a symbol of royal grandeur and one of Europe’s most impressive landmarks. The palace’s lavish halls and beautifully landscaped gardens reflect France’s royal history and architectural excellence. Later, you visit Disneyland Paris, where fantasy, adventure, and entertainment come together, offering magical experiences for both children and adults. You return to Paris in the evening for your overnight stay.
additionalInfo: You return to Paris in the evening for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Paris – Geneva
itinerary.description: Today you travel from France into Switzerland, a country celebrated for its breathtaking alpine scenery and high quality of life. Upon arrival in Geneva, a cosmopolitan city set beside Lake Geneva, you enjoy a brief orientation showcasing the Jet d’Eau fountain, international institutions, and charming lakeside promenades.
additionalInfo: The serene surroundings and mountain views create a peaceful setting for your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Geneva – Vevey – Bern – Lucerne
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you journey through the scenic Swiss countryside, stopping at Vevey, a charming lakeside town along Lake Geneva known for its relaxed atmosphere. You then continue to Bern, the capital of Switzerland, where medieval architecture, arcaded streets, and the iconic clock tower reflect the city’s historic charm. By evening, you arrive in Lucerne, one of Switzerland’s most picturesque cities, beautifully set beside Lake Lucerne and surrounded by mountains.
additionalInfo: By evening, you arrive in Lucerne, one of Switzerland’s most picturesque cities, beautifully set beside Lake Lucerne and surrounded by mountains.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis / Engelberg Excursion
itinerary.description: Today is dedicated to exploring the alpine beauty of Engelberg, a classic Swiss mountain resort. A journey to Mount Titlis offers an unforgettable experience of snow-capped peaks, glaciers, and panoramic mountain views.
additionalInfo: The highlight includes riding cable cars and experiencing the eternal snow, making this day a true alpine adventure before returning to Lucerne for the night.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch – Interlaken
itinerary.description: This day features a visit to Jungfraujoch, known as the “Top of Europe,” one of Switzerland’s most iconic attractions. The scenic train journey through the Alps leads to breathtaking views of glaciers and snow-covered landscapes. Later, you visit Interlaken, a charming town nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, offering postcard-perfect scenery.
additionalInfo: You return to Lucerne by evening for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lucerne – Schaffhausen – Rhine Falls – Vaduz – Innsbruck
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you travel towards Schaffhausen to witness the magnificent Rhine Falls, Europe’s largest waterfall, where powerful cascades create a spectacular natural display. Continuing onward, you enter Liechtenstein and visit Vaduz, the capital city, known for its alpine setting and peaceful charm.
additionalInfo: Later, you proceed into Austria, arriving in Innsbruck, a beautiful city set amidst the Alps, where you check in for the night.

itinerary.title: Innsbruck – Wattens – Salzburg (1 Night)
itinerary.description: This morning, you explore Innsbruck, famous for its imperial history and mountain views. The journey continues to Wattens, home to the Swarovski Crystal Worlds, where art, design, and craftsmanship come together in a unique attraction. Later, you proceed to Salzburg, the birthplace of Mozart, renowned for its baroque architecture and musical heritage,
additionalInfo: where you stay overnight.

itinerary.title: Salzburg – Hallein – Vienna
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you travel through Hallein, a picturesque town known for its historic salt mines and traditional Austrian charm. You then continue to Vienna, Austria’s capital, a city synonymous with imperial palaces, classical music, and refined elegance.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, you enjoy a brief orientation showcasing the grandeur of this historic city before checking in for the night.

itinerary.title: Vienna – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the airport for your onward journey. The tour concludes with unforgettable memories of Europe’s romantic cities, alpine landscapes, cultural treasures, and fairy-tale destinations across four beautiful countries.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, you enjoy a brief orientation showcasing the grandeur of this historic city before checking in for the night.

itinerary.title: Venice Island Tour
itinerary.description: Take a Vaporetto to Venice Island. Visit St. Mark’s Square, Basilica exterior, Bell Tower and Glass Factory demonstration.

name: Portugal & Spain Highlights
metaTitle: Spain & Portugal Tour Package | Madrid, Barcelona, Lisbon & Porto with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Discover the cultural treasures of Spain and Portugal with Duniya Dekho. Includes Madrid, Barcelona, Lisbon and Porto featuring iconic landmarks, beaches, food and heritage.
description: Experience the charm of Porto, the vineyards of the Douro Valley, and the fairytale palaces of Sintra. Explore Lisbon’s vibrant streets, relax on Algarve’s golden beaches, and uncover Andalusia’s treasures in Seville, Granada, and the Costa del Sol. Conclude your journey with the cultural wonders of Toledo, Madrid, Valencia, and Barcelona, including a visit to the stunning Montserrat mountains.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Portugal and Spain are located on the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe. The itinerary covers coastal regions like Porto, Algarve, Costa del Sol, and Valencia, historic inland cities such as Lisbon, Toledo, Madrid, and Granada, and scenic mountainous areas including Sintra and Montserrat. The route combines rivers, beaches, vineyards, and cultural landmarks.Spring (April–May) offers mild and pleasant weather across both countries. Coastal areas are warm and sunny, ideal for sightseeing and beach visits, while inland cities are comfortable with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C. Rainfall is minimal, making it perfect for outdoor activities and exploration.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Porto (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Porto, Portugal’s vibrant riverside city, known for its historic charm and world-famous port wine. After airport transfer to your hotel, check in and take some time to relax. Later, enjoy a gentle stroll along the Ribeira district, a UNESCO World Heritage area, lined with colorful houses and lively cafes.
additionalInfo: Optionally, you can take a scenic walk along the Dom Luís I Bridge, enjoying panoramic views of the Douro River.

itinerary.title: Porto – Douro Valley – Porto
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for a full-day excursion to the Douro Valley, one of Europe’s oldest wine regions. Drive through rolling hills and terraced vineyards, stopping at local estates to taste famous port wines. Enjoy a leisurely river cruise along the Douro River, taking in the picturesque scenery.
additionalInfo: Return to Porto in the evening for overnight stay, with free time to explore local restaurants and try traditional dishes like Francesinha or Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá.

itinerary.title: Porto – Fatima – Sintra – Lisbon (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and head south towards Lisbon. En route, stop at Fatima, Portugal’s most important pilgrimage site, famous for the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima. Continue to Sintra, a fairy-tale town nestled in lush hills, home to the majestic Pena Palace and the Moorish Castle.
additionalInfo: Enjoy sightseeing and photography opportunities before continuing to Lisbon, where you check in for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lisbon – Algarve (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart Lisbon and drive to the Algarve region, famous for its sun-kissed beaches, limestone cliffs, and charming coastal villages. On arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy some leisure time. You may opt to visit Praia da Marinha or Lagos for a scenic beach walk, or simply relax and take in the stunning coastal views.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Barcelona hotel

itinerary.title: Algarve – Seville (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and cross into Spain, arriving in Seville, the heart of Andalusia. After hotel check-in, spend the evening exploring the city at leisure.
additionalInfo: Stroll through the historic Santa Cruz neighborhood, enjoy tapas at a local eatery, or experience Seville’s vibrant nightlife.

itinerary.title: Seville
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy a full day of sightseeing in Seville. Visit the magnificent Seville Cathedral, the largest Gothic cathedral in the world, and climb the Giralda Tower for panoramic city views. Explore the stunning Alcázar Palace with its intricate Moorish architecture and beautiful gardens. Take time to wander through the charming streets, plazas, and bridges of the old town. Optionally, attend a traditional flamenco show in the evening.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Lisbon hotel

itinerary.title: Seville – Ronda – Costa del Sol – Mijas – Marbella (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart Seville and drive to the picturesque town of Ronda, perched on cliffs with breathtaking views of the El Tajo Gorge. Explore the historic old town, the iconic Puente Nuevo bridge, and charming streets. Continue along the Costa del Sol, stopping at Mijas, a classic whitewashed Andalusian village with cobbled streets and artisan shops.
additionalInfo: Arrive in Marbella in the evening, check in at your hotel, and enjoy overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Marbella – Granada – Toledo (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Check out and travel to Granada to visit the world-renowned Alhambra Palace (subject to ticket availability), a stunning example of Moorish architecture with its intricate palaces and gardens. After exploring Granada, drive to Toledo, the historic Spanish city famous for its medieval streets and cultural mix of Christian, Muslim, and Jewish heritage.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Toledo.

itinerary.title: : Toledo – Madrid (1 Night)
itinerary.description: In the morning, explore Toledo’s famous landmarks such as the Toledo Cathedral, Alcázar, and winding medieval streets. Later, drive to Madrid, Spain’s cosmopolitan capital. Check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure, perhaps enjoying a stroll along Gran Via or sampling Spanish cuisine at a local restaurant.
additionalInfo: Check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure, perhaps enjoying a stroll along Gran Via or sampling Spanish cuisine at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: : Madrid – Valencia (1 Night)
itinerary.description: IAfter breakfast, depart Madrid and drive to Valencia, a coastal city blending historic charm with modern architecture. Visit Valencia’s old town, including the Valencia Cathedral, Plaza de la Virgen, and the futuristic City of Arts and Sciences (optional).
additionalInfo: Enjoy a relaxing evening sampling the city’s famous paella before overnight stay.

itinerary.title: : Valencia – Barcelona (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and travel along the scenic eastern coast to Barcelona. On arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.
additionalInfo: You may explore the vibrant Las Ramblas, visit the Gothic Quarter, or enjoy a sunset by the beach.

itinerary.title: : Barcelona – Montserrat
itinerary.description: After breakfast, take a day excursion to Montserrat, a striking mountain range and pilgrimage site famous for its Benedictine monastery and the Black Madonna statue. Enjoy panoramic views of the Catalonian landscape, take a cable car or funicular ride, and explore the monastery complex.
additionalInfo: Return to Barcelona in the evening for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: : Barcelona – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Barcelona airport for your onward flight. Depart with wonderful memories of your Portugal and Spain journey.
additionalInfo: Depart with wonderful memories of your Portugal and Spain journey.

name: Scandinavia & Baltic Discovery: Capitals, Nature & Cruises
metaTitle: Scandinavia Tour Package | Norway, Sweden, Denmark & Finland with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore stunning Scandinavian capitals and Nordic landscapes including Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen and Helsinki with Duniya Dekho. Experience fjords, royal palaces, Viking history and pristine nature.
description: Discover the highlights of Northern Europe, from Copenhagen’s canals to Norway’s dramatic fjords, Stockholm’s archipelago, Helsinki’s charm, and Tallinn’s medieval streets. This journey blends cultural landmarks, scenic landscapes, and relaxing overnight cruises for an unforgettable experience.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: This itinerary covers Northern Europe, including Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Estonia. It features a mix of coastal capitals, historic towns, scenic fjords, mountain regions, and archipelagos, offering a combination of urban exploration and natural beauty.Traveling in October, the region experiences cool autumn weather. Temperatures generally range from 5°C to 15°C. Coastal areas are mild and breezy, while inland and mountainous regions may be cooler. Occasional rain is possible, so light jackets and layers are recommended.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Copenhagen (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Copenhagen, Denmark’s charming capital, known for its colorful canals, historic architecture, and vibrant culture. After airport transfer, check in at your hotel and enjoy some leisure time. You may explore Nyhavn harbor,
additionalInfo: stroll along Strøget shopping street, or relax at a local café.

itinerary.title: stroll along Strøget shopping street, or relax at a local café.
itinerary.description: After breakfast, board a scenic overnight cruise from Copenhagen to Oslo
additionalInfo: Enjoy the amenities and entertainment on board while sailing across the beautiful waters of the Skagerrak Strait and experiencing the Nordic maritime atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Oslo (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Oslo, Norway’s capital, and check in to your hotel. Explore Oslo’s cultural and historic highlights, such as the Vigeland Sculpture Park, the Royal Palace, and the Oslo Opera House.
additionalInfo: Spend the evening at leisure, enjoying the city’s modern cafes and scenic waterfront.

itinerary.title: Geilo (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Depart Oslo and travel to Geilo, a picturesque mountain town nestled between Oslo and Bergen. En route, enjoy the scenic Norwegian landscapes with rolling hills and fjords.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and spend the evening at leisure.
itinerary.description: After breakfast, continue your journey through Norway’s stunning fjord regions. Take the scenic train ride from Geilo to Myrdal, followed by the famous Flam Railway descending into the village of Flam.
additionalInfo: Enjoy a fjord cruise through Nærøyfjord to Gudvangen and then drive to Bergen, Norway’s “Gateway to the Fjords,” for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: : Bergen – Stockholm (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore Bergen’s highlights, including Bryggen Wharf, the Fish Market, and the funicular ride up Mount Fløyen for panoramic views. Later, transfer to Stockholm, Sweden’s capital city, known for its archipelago, royal palaces, and historic Gamla Stan district.
additionalInfo: Check in at your hotel for a two-night stay

itinerary.title: Stockholm
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring Stockholm. Visit the Vasa Museum, the Royal Palace, and the city’s scenic waterways. Optionally, take a short excursion to Vaxholm, a charming island town in the Stockholm archipelago, known for its historic fortress and picturesque streets. .
additionalInfo: Evening at leisure in the city

itinerary.title: Evening at leisure in the city
itinerary.description: Board an overnight cruise from Stockholm to Helsinki, Finland. Enjoy the cruise amenities while sailing across the Baltic Sea and soaking in the serene Nordic views.
additionalInfo: Overnight on board

itinerary.title: Helsinki – Tallinn (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Arrive in Helsinki and enjoy a brief city tour of Finland’s capital, including Senate Square, Helsinki Cathedral, and the lively Market Square. In the afternoon, take a ferry to Tallinn, Estonia’s medieval capital. Explore Tallinn’s Old Town, with its cobbled streets and historic architecture, before checking in at your hotel for overnight stay.
additionalInfo: Tallinn – Departure

itinerary.title: Tallinn – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward flight, concluding your memorable journey through Scandinavia and the Baltic region.

name: Greek Island Hopping Adventure
metaTitle: Greek Island Hopping Adventure | Athens, Santorini & Mykonos with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the ultimate Greek Island Hopping Adventure with Duniya Dekho. Explore Athens, Santorini & Mykonos – visit the Acropolis, relax on stunning beaches, enjoy breathtaking sunsets and discover authentic Greek culture and hospitality.
description: Experience the cradle of Western civilization in Athens, exploring iconic landmarks like the Acropolis and Parthenon. Island-hop to vibrant Mykonos, known for its stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and whitewashed houses. Finally, fall in love with breathtaking Santorini, famous for its picturesque whitewashed houses, blue-domed churches, and stunning sunsets, as you enjoy a romantic getaway in this Greek paradise.
Explore the historical marvels of Athens followed by the dreamy white-washed villages of Santorini and the vibrant windmill-lined shores of Mykonos.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Greece is a southeastern European country comprising over 2,000 islands, with a diverse geography featuring mountains, valleys, and coastlines along the Aegean and Ionian Seas. The climate is Mediterranean, characterized by warm, dry summers and mild, wet winters, with temperatures varying by region and season, making it an ideal destination for tourists year-round.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport and transfer to your hotel via private transfer. Check-in and spend the day at leisure, exploring the city's ancient history, iconic landmarks like the Acropolis, vibrant neighborhoods like Plaka, and savoring delicious Greek cuisine.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Athens

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a half-day guided city tour that takes you through the heart of Athens. Visit the iconic Panathenaic Stadium, the historic site of the first modern Olympics in 1896. Drive past notable landmarks like the Temple of Olympian Zeus, Hadrian's Arch, the Parliament Building, and the Unknown Soldier's Memorial. Explore the revered Acropolis, featuring the majestic Parthenon, the elegant Erechtheion, and other ancient structures. Visit the world-renowned Acropolis Museum to discover an extensive collection of ancient artifacts and gain insight into Athens' rich history and cultural heritage.
additionalInfo: After an enriching day, return to your hotel for a well-deserved rest and

itinerary.title: Athens to Mykonos
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Athens port to board the high-speed ferry to Mykonos, a picturesque island known for its vibrant atmosphere and stunning landscapes. Upon arrival in Mykonos, transfer to your hotel and check-in, getting ready to immerse yourself in the island's charm. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Mykonos' beautiful sandy beaches, vibrant waterfront, and narrow streets lined with whitewashed houses and colorful shops. You can also consider an optional tour to Delos Island, a UNESCO World Heritage site and the mythological birthplace of Apollo and Artemis. Delos boasts an impressive collection of ancient ruins, including temples, theaters, and statues, offering a glimpse into Greece's rich historical past. Return to Mykonos in the evening and enjoy the island's lively nightlife, with numerous bars, clubs, and restaurants to choose from.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Mykonos

itinerary.title: Mykonos City and Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided city and island tour of Mykonos (operates on Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun). Explore the charming Old Town, visiting iconic spots like Little Venice, the windmill area, the unique Paraportiani church, and the picturesque harborfront. Discover the island's stunning beaches, such as Agios Ioannis, Plati Yalos, and Ornos. Visit the traditional village of Ano Mera, featuring a quaint village square and a 16th-century monastery. Gain valuable insights into Mykonos' culture, history, and way of life.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy an overnight stay in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Santorini
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and transfer to Mykonos port to board the high-speed ferry to Santorini. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in. Explore Santorini's breathtaking landscapes, featuring ancient rock formations, rugged cliffs, and picturesque black sand beaches. Spend the rest of the day at leisure or consider an optional Volcanic Islands Sunset Dinner Cruise. Sail on a classic wooden boat to the volcano, relax in the hot springs, and enjoy stunning Caldera views. Savor a delightful dinner onboard as the sun sets behind Oia village.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Santorini

itinerary.title: Santorini Tours
itinerary.description: After breakfast, choose between two exciting Santorini tours:
additionalInfo: Volcano Hot Springs Tour: Explore Nea Kameni's volcano crater, relax in Palea Kameni's hot springs, and unwind on Thirassia island.
Oia Sunset Tour: Enjoy the iconic Oia sunset after a day of exploring the island.
Both tours promise unforgettable experiences in stunning Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Athens
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out of your hotel and transfer to Santorini port to board the high-speed ferry back to Athens. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing or exploring Athens on your own. Overnight in Athens.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Mykonos hotel

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and transfer to Athens International Airport for your departure flight back home, concluding your Greek island-hopping adventure.

name: Northern Lights Adventure
metaTitle: Northern Lights Tour Package | Tromsø, Rovaniemi & Reykjavik with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Witness the magical Aurora Borealis with Duniya Dekho. Covers Tromsø, Rovaniemi and Reykjavik with snow adventures, Arctic culture and Northern Lights experiences.
description: Experience the best of Iceland’s dramatic landscapes on this 10-day journey, from the vibrant capital of Reykjavik to the scenic fjords of Akureyri, the volcanic wonders of the Golden Circle and Snæfellsnes Peninsula, and the breathtaking glaciers, waterfalls, and black sand beaches along the South Coast. Explore geothermal hot springs, iconic waterfalls, glacial lagoons, and lava caves while enjoying the country’s unique natural beauty. With its cool, changeable climate, Iceland offers an unforgettable adventure of contrasts—fire and ice, mountains and coastlines, serenity and raw power—all in one extraordinary destination.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Your Iceland trip covers diverse landscapes—from coastal cities like Reykjavik and Keflavik, fjords and mountains in Akureyri and Borgarnes, to glaciers, waterfalls, and black sand beaches along the South Coast and Vatnajökull National Park, plus volcanic and geothermal areas in the Golden Circle and Snæfellsnes Peninsula.Iceland has a subarctic oceanic climate: cold winters (–5°C to 4°C) with snow and short daylight, and cool summers (10–15°C) with long daylight hours. Weather is highly changeable, coastal areas are windier and wetter, and northern regions tend to be colder.Overall, the itinerary showcases Iceland’s dramatic scenery—glaciers, volcanoes, fjords, waterfalls, lava fields, and geothermal wonders—all in a cool, unpredictable climate

itinerary.title: Arrival in Reykjavik (2 Night)
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Keflavik International Airport, transfer to Reykjavik, Iceland’s vibrant capital city. After check-in at your hotel, the remainder of the day is at leisure.
additionalInfo: You may explore the charming city center, visit Hallgrímskirkja Church, stroll along the waterfront, or relax and unwind after your journey.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik – Whale Watching – Blue Lagoon – Reykjavik
itinerary.description: Begin your day with an exciting whale-watching excursion from Reykjavik’s Old Harbour, where you may encounter humpback whales, minke whales, dolphins, and various seabirds. Later, visit the iconic Blue Lagoon to relax in its soothing geothermal waters surrounded by lava fields.
additionalInfo: Return to Reykjavik for an overnight stay

itinerary.title: – Reykjavik – Akureyri (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, travel north toward Akureyri, known as the “Capital of North Iceland.” Enjoy scenic landscapes along the way, including mountains, waterfalls, and vast lava fields. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and spend the evening exploring this picturesque town.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Tromsø hotel

itinerary.title: Akureyri – Diamond Circle – Akureyri
itinerary.description: Today, explore the stunning Diamond Circle route. Visit the powerful Dettifoss waterfall, the dramatic Ásbyrgi Canyon, the geothermal area of Hverir, and the beautiful Lake Mývatn, famous for its unique volcanic formations.
additionalInfo: Return to Akureyri for the night

itinerary.title: – Akureyri – Into the Glacier – Borgarnes (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Depart Akureyri and travel toward Borgarnes. En route, enjoy the remarkable “Into the Glacier” experience, where you will explore ice tunnels carved inside one of Iceland’s largest glaciers. Continue your journey to Borgarnes and check in for a two-night stay.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Rovaniemi hotel

itinerary.title: Borgarnes – Snæfellsnes Peninsula – Lava Cave – Borgarnes
itinerary.description: Discover the diverse beauty of the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, often referred to as “Iceland in Miniature.” Visit dramatic cliffs, black sand beaches, lava fields, and the iconic Kirkjufell Mountain.
additionalInfo: Experience an adventurous lava cave exploration before returning to Borgarnes.

itinerary.title: Borgarnes – Seljalandsfoss – Skógafoss – Black Sand Beach – Vik (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Travel along Iceland’s spectacular South Coast. Stop at Seljalandsfoss waterfall, where you can walk behind the cascading water, and admire the powerful Skógafoss waterfall. Continue to the famous Reynisfjara black sand beach, known for its striking basalt columns and sea stacks.
additionalInfo: Arrive in Vik for a two-night stay

itinerary.title: Vik – Skaftafell National Park – Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon – Vik
itinerary.description: Explore Skaftafell in Vatnajökull National Park, offering breathtaking glacier views and scenic hiking opportunities. Continue to Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon to witness floating icebergs drifting across the serene waters. Visit nearby Diamond Beach before returning to Vik.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Reykjavik hotel

itinerary.title: – Vik – Golden Circle – Keflavik (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to explore Iceland’s famous Golden Circle. Visit Thingvellir National Park, the Geysir geothermal area with its erupting hot springs, and the magnificent Gullfoss waterfall.
additionalInfo: Later, transfer to Keflavik for your final overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Keflavik – Reykjavik – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Keflavik International Airport for your departure flight, concluding your unforgettable journey through Iceland’s dramatic landscapes.
additionalInfo: natural wonders

name: Eastern Europe in a Week: A Journey Through Iconic Cities
metaTitle: East Europe Tour Package | Prague, Vienna, Budapest & Krakow with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore East Europe with Duniya Dekho. Visit Prague, Vienna, Budapest and Krakow. Experience castles, river cruises, medieval squares and European culture.
description: This Central Europe trip covers Hungary, Croatia, Slovenia, Austria, Slovakia, and the Czech Republic, exploring vibrant cities, charming towns, and scenic landscapes. You’ll experience historic capitals like Budapest, Vienna, and Prague, picturesque spots like Lake Bled, and riverside cities along the Danube and Sava. In early spring, expect cool, mild weather with chances of light rain, making layered clothing ideal for comfortable travel.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Your trip takes you through Central Europe, starting in Budapest, Hungary, on the Danube with its mix of flat plains and hills, then to Zagreb, Croatia, in the Sava River valley, and Ljubljana and Bled, Slovenia, with riverside hills and the Alpine scenery of Lake Bled. Next is Vienna, Austria, on the Danube plains, Bratislava, Slovakia, along the river with low hills, and finally Brno and Prague, Czech Republic, both set among gentle hills and river valleys. The climate is mostly continental, with cool early spring temperatures, daytime highs of 12–15°C (54–59°F), chilly nights around 2–5°C (36–41°F), and occasional rain or snow in Alpine areas. Layered clothing and a light jacket are recommended.

itinerary.title: Budapest
itinerary.description: Arrive in Budapest and transfer to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the local area or relaxing after your journey.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Budapest.

itinerary.title: Budapest
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day exploring the highlights of Budapest, including Buda Castle, Fisherman’s Bastion, Parliament Building, and the Chain Bridge. In the evening, you can take a scenic Danube River cruise.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Budapest.

itinerary.title: Budapest – Zagreb – Ljubljana
itinerary.description: Depart Budapest and travel to Zagreb, the capital of Croatia. After a brief city tour, continue your journey to Ljubljana, the charming capital of Slovenia.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Ljubljana.

itinerary.title: Overnight stay in Ljubljana.
itinerary.description: Start the day with a tour of Ljubljana, then head to the picturesque town of Bled to see Lake Bled and the iconic Bled Castle.
additionalInfo: In the afternoon, continue your journey to Vienna, Austria. Overnight stay in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Vienna
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring Vienna’s rich cultural heritage. Visit Schönbrunn Palace, St. Stephen’s Cathedral, the Hofburg Palace, and enjoy a walk through the historic city center.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Overnight stay in Vienna.
itinerary.description: Travel from Vienna to Bratislava, Slovakia, for a short city tour. Continue to Brno, the historical city in the Czech Republic, before heading to Prague. Arrive in Prague and check in to your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Prague.

itinerary.title: Prague
itinerary.description: Enjoy a full day exploring the magical city of Prague. Visit Prague Castle, Charles Bridge, Old Town Square, Astronomical Clock, and other key attractions. Overnight stay in Prague.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Krakow hotel

itinerary.title: Prague – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your Central European journey.

name: South Korea : Your Gateway to Korea’s Seasons
metaTitle: South Korea Tour Package | Seoul, Busan & Jeju with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore a diverse region of riverfront cities, crescent-shaped islands, forested gardens, and scenic coastal harbors. With varied climates and seasonal highlights like spring blooms and autumn foliage, it’s best visited in spring or fall for pleasant weather and stunning views.
description: The region features a mix of landscapes, from a bustling city in the northwest along a major river surrounded by mountains, to a small crescent-shaped island with tree-lined avenues, a hilly landscaped garden amid forests, and a coastal city with beaches, mountains, and harbors. The climate varies from cold, dry winters and hot, humid summers inland, to milder winters and warm, humid summers along the coast, with occasional snow in winter. The best time to visit is generally in spring or autumn for pleasant weather, scenic views, and seasonal highlights such as flower blooms, autumn foliage, or winter light displays.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Located in the northwest along a major river, surrounded by mountains, with cold, dry winters and hot, humid summers; best visited in spring or autumn.A small crescent-shaped island on a river with tree-lined avenues; cold winters with snow, mild summers; ideal in spring, autumn, or snowy winter.Hilly, landscaped garden surrounded by forests; cold, crisp winters, mild summers; best in spring for flowers or winter for light displays.Coastal city with beaches, mountains, and harbors; milder winters, warm humid summers, rare snow; best visited in spring or autumn.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Seoul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Incheon International Airport, one of the world’s most efficient and modern airports. After clearing immigration, transfer to your hotel in Seoul by shared coach. Spend the day settling in and soaking up the city’s vibrant energy. Seoul perfectly blends modern skyscrapers with historic palaces and traditional neighborhoods. You can take a stroll around nearby areas or simply relax at your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Overnight stay in Seoul
itinerary.description: Begin your day exploring Gyeongbokgung Palace, the grandest of Seoul’s royal palaces, known for its beautiful architecture and the ceremonial changing of the guards. Dive deeper into Korean culture by trying on a Hanbok, the traditional Korean attire, which makes for a wonderful photo opportunity within the palace grounds. Later, visit Insadong, a neighborhood full of art galleries, traditional tea houses, and souvenir shops showcasing Korea’s rich heritage.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Nami Island & Garden of Morning Calm
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy a scenic day trip outside Seoul. Visit Nami Island, a picturesque island known for its tree-lined paths, lush scenery, and peaceful atmosphere. Continue to the Garden of Morning Calm, one of Korea’s most beautiful gardens, featuring themed landscapes, walking paths, and seasonal flowers. Both destinations offer excellent opportunities for photography and relaxation.
additionalInfo: Return to Seoul in the evening for overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Seoul to Busan
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and travel to Busan, South Korea’s second-largest city. Busan is famous for its sandy beaches, seafood markets, and cultural charm. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and enjoy some leisure time exploring the city at your own pace. Overnight stay in Busan.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Busan hotel

itinerary.title: Busan City Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a full-day tour of Busan. Begin with Haeundae Beach, known for its long sandy shores and vibrant seaside atmosphere. Visit Gamcheon Culture Village, a colorful hillside neighborhood adorned with murals, quaint cafes, and artisan shops. Explore Jagalchi Fish Market, Korea’s largest seafood market, where you can taste freshly prepared seafood delicacies. End the day with panoramic views from Busan Tower and a stroll in Yongdusan Park.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for overnight stay

itinerary.title: Busan – Leisure Day
itinerary.description: Spend a relaxed day at your own pace. Options include lounging at Gwangalli Beach with its stunning night views, visiting Shinsegae Centum City, the world’s largest department store, or exploring the serene Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, a seaside temple perched on cliffs overlooking the ocean.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Busan.

itinerary.title: Busan to Seoul by KTX Bullet Train
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and board the KTX bullet train, a high-speed train that covers the distance to Seoul in about 2.5–3 hours. Upon arrival in Seoul, enjoy the evening at leisure. You can explore Myeongdong Shopping Street, famous for fashion and street food, or relax at your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Seoul.

itinerary.title: Seoul – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to Incheon International Airport for your flight back home. Take home beautiful memories of South Korea, from its royal heritage and modern cityscapes to scenic islands, gardens, and coastal charm.

name: Japan — Where Heritage Meets Futuristic Wonders
metaTitle: Japan Tour Package | Tokyo, Kyoto & Osaka with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Japan with Duniya Dekho. Visit Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka. Experience temples, cherry blossoms, bustling cities, traditional culture, and Japanese cuisine.
description: Experience an unforgettable journey through Japan, a land of vibrant culture, rich history, and breathtaking natural beauty. This 7 nights 8 days itinerary takes you on a thrilling adventure through Tokyo's neon streets, Kyoto's ancient temples, and Osaka's foodie paradise.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Japan is an archipelago, comprising over 6,800 islands, with four main islands: Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu, and Shikoku. The country's terrain is diverse, with mountains covering over 70% of its land, including iconic peaks like Mount Fuji and Mount Haku. Japan's unique geography also features over 100 active volcanoes, as well as an extensive coastline with many bays, inlets, and islands.Japan's climate varies greatly depending on the region, ranging from temperate to tropical and cold climates. The temperate climate prevails in most areas, with four distinct seasons, while Okinawa and the southern islands experience a subtropical climate. Hokkaido and the northern islands have a cold climate, with long, snowy winters and mild summers. Seasonal changes are pronounced in Japan, with mild springs, hot and humid summers, comfortable autumns, and cold winters.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tokyo, Japan
itinerary.description: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, proceed through immigration, customs, and baggage claim. Ensure you have all necessary travel documents and essentials, such as Wi-Fi arrangements or a local SIM card.After completing arrival formalities, meet your friendly tour guide at the designated location. They will escort you to your hotel and assist with the check-in process, ensuring a smooth and comfortable start to your journey.Spend the rest of the day relaxing and rejuvenating.
additionalInfo: In the evening, indulge in a delicious Indian dinner and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Tokyo, the vibrant capital city of Japan.

itinerary.title: Tokyo's Vibrant Landmarks and Immersive Experiences
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on a thrilling adventure to explore Tokyo's iconic sights and immersive experiences.
additionalInfo: Hie Shrine and Rainbow Bridge:Begin the day with a serene visit to Hie Shrine, a beautiful Shinto shrine in Akasaka, famous for its striking red torii gates and tranquil surroundings. Take a stroll through the shrine's unique architecture and lush greenery, and capture stunning photos at the iconic torii gate pathway.Next, head to the Rainbow Bridge, connecting central Tokyo with the Odaiba area. Enjoy breathtaking views of this impressive bridge spanning Tokyo Bay, and stop by Odaiba's Statue of Liberty replica for a memorable photo opportunity.

Hie Shrine and Rainbow Bridge:Begin the day with a serene visit to Hie Shrine, a beautiful Shinto shrine in Akasaka, famous for its striking red torii gates and tranquil surroundings. Take a stroll through the shrine's unique architecture and lush greenery, and capture stunning photos at the iconic torii gate pathway.Next, head to the Rainbow Bridge, connecting central Tokyo with the Odaiba area. Enjoy breathtaking views of this impressive bridge spanning Tokyo Bay, and stop by Odaiba's Statue of Liberty replica for a memorable photo opportunity

TeamLab Planets Tokyo and Tokyo Sky Tree :After lunch, immerse yourself in the captivating world of TeamLab Planets Tokyo, an interactive digital art experience. Explore mirrored rooms, walk through water, and interact with dynamic digital displays.Later, visit Tokyo Sky Tree, Japan's tallest structure, standing at 634 meters. Ascend to the Tembo Deck at 349 meters for breathtaking 360-degree views of Tokyo, and possibly even glimpse Mount Fuji on aclear day.

Shibuya Scramble Crossing:Conclude the day at the iconic Shibuya Scramble Crossing, one of Tokyo's busiest intersections. Experience the city's energy firsthand, surrounded by flashing lights, giant video screens, and a bustling atmosphere.
End the day with a delicious Indian dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Tokyo's Hidden Gems and Cultural Experiences
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a unique adventure through the Aqua Line, an underwater highway connecting Tokyo to the Chiba area. Visit Umi Hotaru, an artificial island and rest area in the middle of Tokyo Bay, offering breathtaking views, shopping, and panoramic views.
additionalInfo: Next, head to Yokohama's Yamashita Park to explore the historic ocean liner, Hikawamaru. This retired luxury liner, featuring an Art Deco interior, now serves as a museum showcasing its rich history and role during World War II.

Return to Tokyo for lunch, followed by an authentic Kimono Experience. Visit a kimono rental shop, choose a beautiful kimono, and have professionals assist with traditional dressing, complete with accessories.

Sensou-ji Temple and Nakamise Street: Visit Sensou-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest and most significant Buddhist temple in Asakusa. Walk through the grand Kaminarimon Gate, featuring its famous red lantern, and explore the temple's main hall. Take part in local customs, capture photos, and receive omikuji (fortune slips).Adjacent to the temple, Nakamise Street is one of Tokyo's oldest shopping streets, offering traditional Japanese snacks, souvenirs, and handicrafts.

Ginza District:Conclude the day in Ginza, Tokyo's upscale shopping district, known for luxury boutiques, department stores, and fine dining. Enjoy free time to explore the district, visit designer flagship stores, relax in chic cafes, or admire the famous Ginza Wako Clock Tower.
End the day with a delicious Indian dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Tokyo.

itinerary.title: Discover Hakone's Natural Beauty and Mt. Fuji's Majestic Views
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic journey to Hakone, a picturesque region renowned for its stunning natural beauty, hot springs, and breathtaking views of Mt. Fuji. The approximate 1.5 to 2-hour drive or train ride from Tokyo offers a relaxing start to the day.
additionalInfo: Lake Ashi Cruise : Arrive at Lake Ashi, a serene and picturesque crater-formed lake, and embark on a 30-minute cruise. On clear days, enjoy spectacular views of Mt. Fuji, while gliding past iconic landmarks like the Hakone Shrine torii gate, which dramatically rises from the lake's edge.

Hakone Ropeway Disembark at Tougendai Station and transfer to the Hakone Ropeway, which offers panoramic views of Mt. Fuji, surrounding mountains, and the active volcanic valley of Owakudani. The 16-minute ride is a highlight of the day.

Owakudani and Mt. Fuji Viewing Explore Owakudani's geothermal activity, including bubbling hot springs and sulfur vents. Enjoy lunch at a nearby restaurant, savoring traditional Japanese cuisine while taking in views of Mt. Fuji.

Continue to the Mt. Fuji area, where you'll visit iconic viewing points, including the Mt. Fuji 5th Station (weather permitting). Enjoy spectacular views, visit the small shrine, and explore souvenir shops. If access to the 5th Station is limited, alternative viewing spots offer impressive perspectives on Mt. Fuji's majestic peak.
Dinner and Overnight in Shizuoka.

itinerary.title: Hiroshima and Miyajima Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Begin the day by arranging for your suitcase to be sent to Osaka via Japan's convenient luggage forwarding service, takuhaibin. This allows for smooth travel without heavy bags.
additionalInfo: Travel to Hiroshima : Take the bullet train from Mishima to Hiroshima, transferring at Nagoya Station. Upon arrival, enjoy lunch and prepare for an unforgettable adventure.

Miyajima Island Getaway Travel to Miyajima-guchi and take the ferry to Miyajima Island. The 10-minute ferry ride offers breathtaking views of the iconic torii gate of Itsukushima Shrine, which appears to float on the water during high tide.

Itsukushima Shrine :Upon arrival, visit Itsukushima Shrine, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the shrine's stunning architecture, learn about its spiritual significance, and take a leisurely stroll along the temple grounds. If the tide is low, walk up to the base of the torii gate for an up-close view.
Enjoy an Indian dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Hiroshima.

itinerary.title: Hiroshima's Historic Sites and Himeji Castle
itinerary.description: Begin the day with an early departure to explore Hiroshima's historic sites before heading to Himeji.
additionalInfo: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum and Atomic Bomb Dome:Visit the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum, located in the Peace Memorial Park, to gain insight into the tragic events of the atomic bombing in 1945. Take your time exploring the impactful exhibits, which include artifacts, photographs, and stories of survivors.Next, walk to the nearby Atomic Bomb Dome, a poignant symbol of peace and a reminder of the city's resilience. Reflect on the site's significance while exploring the park.

Himeji Castle:After lunch, arrive at Himeji Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of Japan's most iconic castles. Marvel at the stunning white facade and intricate architectural design. Explore the grounds, the castle's main keep, and learn about its rich history.Admire the architectural marvels, including the maze-like layout and stone walls. Stroll through the surrounding garden and appreciate the picturesque beauty of this castle, affectionately called the 'White Heron Castle' due to its elegant appearance.
Enjoy an Indian dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Osaka.

itinerary.title: Kyoto's Cultural and Scenic Delights
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a day-long adventure to Kyoto, a city steeped in tradition and natural beauty.
additionalInfo: Traditional Japanese Tea Ceremony: Begin your Kyoto experience with a traditional Japanese tea ceremony, a timeless ritual rooted in Zen Buddhism. Under the guidance of a tea master, learn the art of making and appreciating matcha (green tea) in a serene setting. Emphasizing mindfulness and respect, this ceremony offers a unique glimpse into Japanese culture and aesthetics

Kinkakuji (Golden Pavilion): Next, visit Kinkakuji, Kyoto's iconic Golden Pavilion, a Zen temple covered in gold leaf. Set amidst lush gardens and a reflective pond, this breathtaking landmark is one of Japan's most photographed sites. Stroll along the designated path, admiring the pavilion from different angles, and soak in the tranquil atmosphere.

Arashiyama DistrictTravel to the picturesque Arashiyama district, famous for its iconic Togetsu-kyō Bridge and serene bamboo forest. Begin with a leisurely walk across the bridge, which spans the Hozu River and offers stunning views of the surrounding hills.

Bamboo Forest Continue to the nearby Bamboo Forest, where towering bamboo stalks create a calming and otherworldly atmosphere. Walk along the winding path, surrounded by the soothing sounds of rustling bamboo, for a uniquely Kyoto experience.Return to Osaka in the afternoon, with the evening free for shopping and exploration. Visit popular shopping areas like Sannomiya Center Gai and discover Osaka's vibrant nightlife.
Enjoy an Indian dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Osaka.

itinerary.title: Departure and Fond Farewells
itinerary.description: As your incredible Japanese adventure comes to a close, take a moment to relax and savor a delightful final breakfast.
additionalInfo: Check-out and Departure PreparationsComplete check-out procedures, ensuring you have all necessary travel documents, souvenirs, and essentials packed. Double-check that you haven't forgotten any cherished mementos or memories.

Reflections and FarewellsAt the airport, take a final moment to reflect on the unforgettable experiences and memories gathered during your time in Japan. From Kyoto's serene temples to Tokyo's vibrant streets, Hakone's tranquil beauty, Hiroshima's heartfelt moments, and beyond – this adventure has undoubtedly left an indelible mark on your heart.As you depart, carry with you a treasure trove of memories, stories, and experiences that will be cherished for a lifetime. Wishing you a smooth and safe journey home, filled with joyful recollections of your unforgettable adventure in Japan.
Sayonara, Japan!

name: Oman Discovery
metaTitle: Oman Tour Package | Muscat, Nizwa & Wahiba Sands with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Oman with Duniya Dekho. Visit Muscat, Nizwa, Wahiba Sands and Jebel Akhdar. Experience forts, deserts, mountains, beaches, and authentic Omani culture.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Oman, a land of breathtaking beauty and rich heritage. Begin in Muscat, the capital city, where you'll spend three nights discovering the stunning architecture, bustling souks, and majestic mosques. Next, venture into the rugged dunes of Wahiba Sands, where you'll spend a night under the stars in a desert camp. Then, head to Jabal Akhdar, the 'Green Mountain', where you'll spend a night surrounded by lush valleys, ancient villages, and breathtaking views. Throughout your journey, experience the warm hospitality of the Omani people, and immerse yourself in the country's unique blend of traditional and modern cultur

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Oman, located on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, boasts a diverse geography characterized by rugged mountains, vast deserts, and stunning coastlines. The country's landscape is dominated by the Hajar Mountains, which stretch from the north to the south, while the Rub' al Khali desert covers much of the west. Oman's climate is generally hot and dry, with very little rainfall throughout the year. The summer months can be extremely hot, with temperatures often reaching 45°C (113°F), while the winter months are milder, with temperatures ranging from 15°C to 25°C (59°F to 77°F), making it an ideal winter destination

itinerary.title: Arrival in Muscat
itinerary.description: Arrive at Muscat International Airport, where you'll be greeted by the warm Omani hospitality. Transfer to your hotel, where you can freshen up and relax after your journey. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the surrounding area or simply enjoying the hotel's amenities.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Muscat

itinerary.title: Muscat City Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a fascinating city tour of Muscat, starting with a visit to the magnificent Grand Mosque (closed on Fridays and public holidays). This stunning mosque, completed in 2001, blends modern and traditional architectural styles, featuring exquisite handmade carpets, crystal chandeliers, and a breathtaking great dome. Please note that ladies are required to be fully covered and carry a headscarf, while men should wear trousers.
additionalInfo: Next, take a scenic drive along the waterfront Corniche, stopping at the vibrant Muttrah Souq, filled with colorful stalls and local vendors. Make a photo stop at the majestic Al Alam Palace, the official residence of His Majesty Sultan Qaboos, flanked by the historic 16th-century Portuguese forts, Mirani and Jalali.
The final stop is the Bait Al Zubair Museum, which offers a glimpse into Oman's rich history and heritage.
After a day filled with culture, history, and stunning architecture, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay in Muscat.

itinerary.title: Dolphin and Whale Watching Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on an exhilarating dolphin and whale watching tour, departing from the Marina. As you sail through the Arabian Sea, keep your eyes peeled for playful dolphins and majestic whales, including various species that inhabit these waters. While sightings can't be guaranteed, this tour promises an unforgettable experience, with insights into the fascinating world of marine mammals.
additionalInfo: Return to the Marina at 1200 Hrs and head back to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Muscat's hidden gems, visiting local markets, or simply relaxing at your hotel.
Overnight at your hotel in Muscat.

itinerary.title: Muscat to Wahiba Sands
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable adventure, departing Muscat by 4WD vehicle and traversing the scenic coastal route to Wahiba Sands. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Gulf of Oman's turquoise waters, pristine white beaches, and rugged landscape. Visit the quaint fishing village of Quriyat, where you may spot flamingos and eagles near an inland stream.
additionalInfo: Explore the picturesque Wadi Arabayeen, with its tranquil pools and date palms, and marvel at the Bimah sinkhole, a stunning limestone crater filled with blue-green water. As you drive along the coast, keep an eye out for sharks, gazelles, and other wildlife.
Arrive in Sur and visit a traditional dhow factory, before continuing through mountainous terrain, offering spectacular ocean views.

Finally, arrive at the breathtaking Wahiba Sands, a vast expanse of undulating red and white dunes rising up to 200 meters. Experience the thrill of dune bashing and capture the ever-changing patterns of the dunes on camera. Enjoy dinner and overnight at the Arabian Oryx Camp.

itinerary.title: Wahiba Sands to Jabal Akhdar
itinerary.description: Begin the day with breakfast at the camp, surrounded by the serene beauty of Wahiba Sands. Visit a traditional Bedouin family in their simple yet welcoming habitat, and experience their renowned hospitality. Gain insight into their ancient knowledge of the Sands and their unique way of life.
additionalInfo: Next, head to Wadi Bani Khalid, a picturesque oasis with crystal-clear waters, small villages, and breathtaking mountain scenery. Wear comfortable clothing and shoes, as you'll have the opportunity to explore this stunning wadi.

In the afternoon, proceed to Jabal Akhdar, a mountainous region famed for its lush fruit orchards, natural springs, and traditional villages. Visit the villages of Saiq, Wadi Bani Habib, and Al Ain, perched on the mountainside, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. If traveling in March or April, enjoy the sweet fragrance of roses in full bloom.
Overnight at Sama Jabal Akhdar.

itinerary.title: Jabal Akhdar to Nizwa and Departure
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a scenic drive to Nizwa, the historic capital of Oman's interior and the birthplace of Islam in the Sultanate. Make a photo stop at the iconic Round Tower Fort, a 17th-century architectural marvel.
additionalInfo: Explore Nizwa's vibrant Souq, famous for its bustling Friday cattle auction, as well as its stunning array of intricately hand-carved 'Khanjars' (daggers) and exquisite silver jewelry.
After a morning of discovery, proceed to Muscat International Airport for your departure, bringing back memories of Oman's captivating landscapes, rich history, and warm hospitality.

name: Saudi Arabia — Where History Meets Modern Marvels
metaTitle: Saudi Arabia Tour Package | Riyadh, Jeddah & AlUla with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Discover the best of Saudi Arabia on a journey through Riyadh’s modern and traditional landmarks, the historic forts of Hail, the UNESCO-listed heritage and ancient rock art of AlUla, the spiritual beauty of Madinah, and the vibrant Red Sea charm of Jeddah. Experience breathtaking desert landscapes, mountains, valleys, and coastal scenery, all under the country’s warm, arid climate.
description: Discover the best of Saudi Arabia on a journey through Riyadh’s modern and traditional landmarks, the historic forts of Hail, the UNESCO-listed heritage and ancient rock art of AlUla, the spiritual beauty of Madinah, and the vibrant Red Sea charm of Jeddah. Experience breathtaking desert landscapes, mountains, valleys, and coastal scenery, all under the country’s warm, arid climate.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Saudi Arabia features diverse landscapes, from the deserts and plateaus of Riyadh and Hail to the sandstone valleys of AlUla, the historic Hejaz region of Madinah, and the coastal city of Jeddah on the Red Sea. The climate is mostly arid, with very hot summers, mild winters, and minimal rainfall. Inland areas are dry and hot, desert valleys have warm days and cool nights, and coastal regions are humid.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Riyadh
itinerary.description: Arrive in Riyadh and check into your hotel. Begin your exploration with a full-day Riyadh city tour accompanied by an English-speaking guide. Visit the National Museum of Saudi Arabia to learn about the country’s history and culture, and stop by the King Abdulaziz Historical Center. Explore the Masmak Fort, a 19th-century fortress that played a key role in Saudi history. Take a stroll through the Riyadh souks and markets, such as Souq Al Zal, to experience traditional shopping and local crafts. End the day with a drive along Kingdom Centre Tower, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the city.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Riyadh.

itinerary.title: Riyadh
itinerary.description: Continue exploring Riyadh with your English-speaking guide. Start the day at the Kingdom Centre Tower Sky Bridge, enjoying panoramic views of the city and its modern skyline. Visit the Al Masmak Fortress, an iconic historical site, and learn about Riyadh’s role in the unification of Saudi Arabia. Explore the Diriyah area, the birthplace of the Saudi state, with its beautifully restored mud-brick architecture and cultural sites. Stop by the Riyadh galleries and souks to experience local markets, traditional crafts, and souvenirs. In the afternoon, visit the Wadi Hanifah, a scenic valley offering a glimpse of Riyadh’s natural landscape. End the day with dinner at a local restaurant featuring traditional Saudi cuisine.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Riyadh.

itinerary.title: Riyadh → Hail
itinerary.description: Take the train from Riyadh to Hail, enjoying the scenic desert landscapes along the journey. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and start exploring the city. Visit the historic Aarif Fort, a landmark that reflects Hail’s rich heritage and strategic importance in the region. Explore the surrounding Hail old town to see traditional architecture and experience local culture. If time permits, stroll through the Al Murabba Park or visit Qishlah Palace, another historical building that once served as a military fort. Enjoy dinner at a local restaurant featuring regional cuisine,
additionalInfo: And return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Hail.

itinerary.title: Hail → AlUla
itinerary.description: travel from Hail to AlUla, enjoying the scenic desert and mountainous landscapes along the way. Upon arrival, start your exploration with the ancient Jubbah site, renowned for its rock art and petroglyphs dating back thousands of years, giving a fascinating glimpse into early human civilization in the Arabian Peninsula. Continue to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hegra (Madain Salih), where an English-speaking Rawi (guide) will take you through the Nabatean tombs, monumental sandstone facades, and well-preserved archaeological ruins. Take time to photograph the unique desert landscapes and learn about the history and culture of the Nabateans. End the day with a visit to Elephant Rock (Jebel Al Fil), a natural rock formation shaped like an elephant, set against the stunning desert backdrop, perfect for sunset views and photography.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for dinner and overnight stay in AlUla.

itinerary.title: AlUla → Madinah
itinerary.description: Travel from AlUla to Madinah, the holy city of Islam, and check into your hotel upon arrival. Begin your exploration with a guided tour of Madinah’s religious and historical sites, including the Prophet’s Mosque (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi), one of the most sacred sites in Islam. Take time to visit the Quba Mosque, the first mosque built in Islamic history, and Masjid al-Qiblatain, famous for its connection to the change of Qibla direction in early Islamic tradition. Explore the Old Madinah markets (souks) to experience local culture, traditional crafts, and Arabian hospitality. Learn about the city’s rich heritage and its significance in Islamic history.
additionalInfo: In the evening, enjoy a traditional Saudi meal at a local restaurant before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay in Madinah.

itinerary.title: Madinah → Jeddah
itinerary.description: Depart Madinah and travel to Jeddah. Spend the day on a full-day Jeddah city tour, exploring the historic districts, Corniche, and other key attractions.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Jeddah.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jeddah
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and depart from Jeddah. After checking out from your hotel in Jeddah, plan ahead to travel to King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED)

name: Dubai City Break
metaTitle: Dubai Tour Package | Burj Khalifa, Desert Safari & Marina Cruise with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Dubai with Duniya Dekho. Visit Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Palm Jumeirah, enjoy a desert safari, Marina cruise and experience modern Arabian luxury.
description: Experience the ultimate luxury and excitement of Dubai on our 4 Night 5 Days travel itinerary. Explore the city's iconic landmarks, immerse yourself in its vibrant culture, and indulge in its world-class amenities.

Discover the majestic Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, and marvel at the stunning Dubai Fountain Show. Take a thrilling desert safari, visit the iconic Palm Jumeirah, and explore the traditional souks.

Enjoy luxurious accommodations, savour delicious cuisine, and take advantage of our expert guides and hassle-free transfers. Whether you're looking for adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, our Dubai itinerary has something for everyone.
Join us on an unforgettable journey to Dubai and experience the ultimate in luxury and entertainment!

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Dubai is located on the southeastern coast of the Persian Gulf, in the United Arab Emirates. The city's terrain is flat and sandy, with some rocky areas. Dubai's climate is hot and humid, with very little rainfall. Summer temperatures often reach 45°C, while winters are mild, ranging from 15-25°C.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport, where our representative will greet and assist you with your transfer to the hotel. Check-in to your hotel and freshen up.In the evening, embark on a traditional Dhow Cruise along the Dubai Creek, while enjoying a delicious dinner and mesmerizing views of the city's skyline.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Embark on a half-day guided tour of Dubai's iconic landmarks, including the Jumeirah Mosque, Dubai Museum, traditional souks, and a photo stop at the majestic Burj Khalifa. In the evening, experience the thrill of a desert safari, where you'll enjoy dune bashing in a 4x4 vehicle, watch the sunset over the dunes, and savor a delicious BBQ dinner at a Bedouin camp, relaxing under the stars with traditional Arabic hospitality.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Burj Khalifa Visit
itinerary.description: Spend the day at leisure, relaxing at the hotel, exploring Dubai's shopping malls, or visiting any of the city's many attractions. In the evening, head to the iconic Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, and take a high-speed elevator to the observation deck on the 124th floor. Be mesmerized by the stunning views of the city skyline and enjoy the spectacular Musical Fountain Show, a symphony of water, music, and lights that will leave you spellbound.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Miracle Garden & Global Village Visit
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring two of Dubai's most unique attractions. Begin with a visit to the breathtaking Miracle Garden, a floral wonderland featuring over 45 million flowers arranged in stunning designs and patterns. Next, head to the Global Village, a cultural and entertainment park showcasing the traditions and customs of over 90 countries from around the world. Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere, live performances, and international cuisine, with return transfers provided for a hassle-free experience.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from the hotel and transfer to Dubai International Airport for your onward flight, bringing back memories of your wonderful trip to Dubai!
