name: Singapore Malaysia Thailand
metaTitle: Singapore Malaysia Thailand Tour Package | Kuala Lumpur, Singapore & Bangkok with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand with Duniya Dekho. Visit Gardens by the Bay, KL Twin Towers, Bangkok temples and enjoy Sentosa, Safari and beaches.
description: Experience the vibrant tapestry of Southeast Asia on a thrilling journey through Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand. From bustling cities to idyllic beaches, and from ancient temples to modern marvels, this incredible adventure has it all.

Discover the multicultural charm of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia's vibrant capital, and the sleek sophistication of Singapore, a cosmopolitan city-state. Explore the historic streets of Chinatown, the tranquil gardens of Gardens by the Bay, and the iconic landmarks of Marina Bay Sands.

Next, immerse yourself in the warm hospitality and rich culture of Thailand. Visit the majestic Grand Palace in Bangkok, relax on the stunning beaches of Phuket or Koh Samui, and experience the vibrant nightlife of Patong or Chiang Mai.
With its rich blend of cultures, histories, and landscapes, this unforgettable journey through Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand promises to be an adventure of a lifetime.

additionalInfo.name: Malaysia Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Malaysia is a country located in Southeast Asia, consisting of two main landmasses: Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia. It borders Thailand to the north, Indonesia to the southeast, and Singapore to the south.Malaysia has a tropical rainforest climate, with high temperatures and high humidity throughout the year. The country experiences two monsoon seasons: the northeast monsoon from November to March, and the southwest monsoon from May to September.

additionalInfo.name: Singapore Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Singapore is a small island city-state located at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula. It consists of 63 islands and has a total land area of approximately 720 square kilometers.Singapore has a tropical rainforest climate, with high temperatures and high humidity throughout the year. The country experiences two main seasons: the northeast monsoon from December to early March, and the inter-monsoon period from mid-March to May and from September to November.

additionalInfo.name: Thailand Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Thailand is a country located in Southeast Asia, bordering Myanmar to the west, Laos to the east, Cambodia to the southeast, and Malaysia to the south. It has a diverse geography, with mountains, forests, and plains.Thailand has a tropical climate, with three main seasons: the cool season from November to February, the hot season from March to May, and the rainy season from June to October. The southern region of Thailand has a slightly different climate, with a rainy season from April to October.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
itinerary.description: Welcome to Malaysia! Upon arrival at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you'll be greeted by our local representative and treated to a delicious breakfast.Your Malaysian adventure begins with a visit to Putrajaya, the country's administrative capital. This stunning complex is a masterpiece of modern architecture, blending seamlessly into the surrounding landscape. Explore the beautifully landscaped gardens, tranquil lakes, and impressive landmarks, including the Prime Minister's office.As the sun sets, check-in to your hotel and freshen up. The evening is yours to unwind and enjoy a sumptuous dinner.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Kuala Lumpur, ready to discover more of this vibrant city tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious American breakfast, embark on a fascinating city tour of Kuala Lumpur. Discover the city's rich history, cultural landmarks, and stunning architecture.Visit the iconic Menara KL Tower, one of the tallest communication towers in the world, and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city from its observatory deck.
additionalInfo: Explore the city's historic heart, visiting notable landmarks such as:
1.The National Mosque, a symbol of Malaysia's Islamic heritage
2. The King's Palace, the official residence of the Malaysian monarch
3. The Sultan Abdul Samad Building, a stunning example of Moorish architecture.
4.  Merdeka Square, the site of Malaysia's independence declaration.
5. The National Monument, a tribute to the country's fallen heroes.
Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant and spend some time shopping for souvenirs or exploring the city on your own.In the evening, indulge in a delicious Indian dinner and relax after a day of exploring.
Overnight in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur to Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling adventure to Genting Highlands, a mystical destination nestled in the Titiwangsa Mountains. Begin the day with an early breakfast, followed by a scenic drive to Genting Highlands.En route, visit the Batu Caves, a sacred Hindu site featuring an impressive limestone temple. As you ascend to Genting Highlands, situated 2,000 meters above sea level, enjoy the crisp mountain air and breathtaking views.
additionalInfo: Spend the day exploring Genting Highlands, a premier entertainment hub offering a range of activities, including:
1. A thrilling cable car ride (subject to weather and maintenance).
2. Exciting theme parks and attractions
3. Casinos and nightlife.
4. Shopping and dining options.
Enjoy lunch at one of the many restaurants and cafes. As the day comes to a close, return to Kuala Lumpur and indulge in a delicious Indian dinner.
Overnight in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur to Singapore
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, depart for Singapore, a vibrant city-state known for its stunning gardens, iconic architecture, and multicultural heritage.Cross the border and complete immigration formalities before checking-in to your hotel. Enjoy lunch at an Indian restaurant to satisfy your cravings.In the evening, visit Gardens by the Bay, a breathtaking botanical garden featuring stunning floral displays and iconic structures like the Flower Dome. Explore the garden's wonders from around the world, except Antarctica.Next, head to Marina Bay Sands, an iconic hotel and entertainment complex. Ascend to the SkyPark Observation Deck for panoramic views of the city skyline and the South China Sea.Conclude the day with a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Singapore, ready to explore more of this fascinating city tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour and Sentosa Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Start the day with a sumptuous buffet breakfast at your hotel, followed by a comprehensive city tour of Singapore.
additionalInfo: Explore the city's multicultural heritage by visiting:
1. Little India, a vibrant neighborhood filled with colorful temples and spicy aromas.
2. The iconic Merlion statue, a symbol of Singapore's history and culture.
3. The scenic Singapore River, offering stunning views of the city skyline.
4. Chinatown, a bustling neighborhood filled with traditional shops and eateries.
5. The Sri Mariamman Temple, a beautiful Hindu temple and national monument.
6. The Esplanade, a stunning performing arts center with a unique architectural design.
Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at an Indian restaurant before checking into your hotel.
In the afternoon, embark on a thrilling adventure to Sentosa Island, a purpose-built island theme park offering a range of exciting attractions, including:
1. Volcano Land, a thrilling theme park with volcanic landscapes and fire-breathing dragons.
2. The Asian Village, a cultural showcase of Asian traditions and customs.
3. Fantasy Island, a water park with thrilling rides and slides.
4. The S.E.A. Aquarium, one of Asia's largest tropical fish oceanariums.
Reach the island by cable car and enjoy the stunning views of the city skyline. Conclude the day with a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant.
Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Singapore Adventure
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty buffet breakfast at your hotel, fueling up for an action-packed day at Universal Studios Singapore.Spend the day exploring the thrilling rides, shows, and attractions of this world-famous theme park. With your lunch coupon in hand, enjoy a convenient and delicious meal amidst the excitement.
additionalInfo: Experience the magic of movie-themed zones, including:
1. Hollywood, where you can walk the red carpet and experience the glamour of Tinseltown.
2. New York, where you can explore the city's iconic streets and skyscrapers.
3. Sci-Fi City, where you can blast off into a world of futuristic thrills.
4. Ancient Egypt, where you can uncover the secrets of the pharaohs.
End the day with a satisfying dinner at an Indian restaurant.
Overnight in Singapore, with memories of your Universal Studios adventure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Singapore and Arrival in Pattaya, Thailand
itinerary.description: Begin the day with an early buffet breakfast or packed breakfast at your hotel, before checking out and proceeding to the airport for your flight to Thailand.Bid farewell to Singapore and arrive at Bangkok's Don Mueang International Airport (DMK). Upon arrival, transfer to Pattaya City by coach, a popular beach resort town known for its vibrant nightlife, stunning beaches, and exciting attractions.Check into your hotel and freshen up. In the evening, experience the spectacular Alcazar Show, a dazzling display of music, dance, and costume.Conclude the day with a delicious buffet dinner at an Indian restaurant.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Pattaya, ready to explore this exciting city tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Pattaya's Coral Island and Nong Nooch Village Adventure
itinerary.description: Start the day with a hearty buffet breakfast at your hotel, preparing you for an exciting day ahead.
additionalInfo: Embark on a thrilling Coral Island excursion by speedboat, where you'll discover:
1. Crystal-clear waters and powdery white sand beaches.
2. Vibrant coral reefs and diverse marine life.
3. Opportunities for swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing.
Enjoy a delicious lunch at an Indian restaurant, replenishing your energy for the next adventure.
In the afternoon, visit the picturesque Nong Nooch Village, a cultural and recreational park showcasing:
1. Traditional Thai architecture and gardens.
2. Stunning elephant shows and performances.
3. Opportunities to learn about Thai culture and traditions.Conclude the day with a sumptuous buffet dinner at an Indian restaurant.
Overnight in Pattaya, with memories of your island and village adventures.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok and City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a buffet breakfast at your hotel, followed by check-out and a scenic drive to Bangkok, the vibrant capital city of Thailand.Upon arrival, check into your hotel and freshen up. Enjoy a delicious buffet lunch at an Indian restaurant, preparing you for an exciting city tour.
additionalInfo: Embark on a fascinating city tour and temple tour of Bangkok, visiting:
1. The Golden Buddha, a stunning 5.5-ton gold statue.
2. The Marble Buddha, a beautiful temple featuring a majestic marble Buddha image.
3. Other iconic landmarks and temples, showcasing Bangkok's rich history and culture.

In the evening, experience the magic of Bangkok's nightlife on a scenic Chaophraya Dinner Cruise. Savor a delicious meal while taking in the breathtaking views of the city's skyline and riverbanks.Return to your hotel and relax after a day of exploration.
Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: Bangkok's Safari World Adventure
itinerary.description: Start the day with a buffet breakfast at your hotel, fueling up for a thrilling adventure at Safari World.
additionalInfo: Embark on a journey through the Safari Park, an open zoo featuring an incredible array of wildlife, including:
1. Giraffes, roaming freely in their enclosure.
2. Zebras, showcasing their striking black and white stripes.
3. Tigers, lions, and other majestic predators.
Next  visit the Marine Park  where you'll be treated to spectacular animal shows, including:
1. Sea Lion Show: watch these charming creatures perform tricks and stunts.
2. Dolphin Show: marvel at the intelligence and agility of these marine mammals.
3. Hollywood Cowboy Stunt Show: experience the thrill of a Wild West showdown.
Enjoy an Indian lunch at the Safari World Restaurant, surrounded by the sights and sounds of the animal kingdom.
In the evening, savor a delicious dinner at an Indian restaurant. Overnight in Bangkok, with memories of your wild adventure.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
itinerary.description: Enjoy a farewell buffet breakfast at your hotel, followed by check-out and transfer of your luggage to the coach.
additionalInfo: Depending on your flight schedule, you'll be treated to a buffet lunch or depart for the airport accordingly.
Our representative will escort you to Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) for your onward flight to Bangalore.
Bid farewell to Thailand and return home with cherished memories of your incredible journey!

name: Wonders of Vietnam & Cambodia
metaTitle: Vietnam & Cambodia Tour Package | Hanoi, Halong Bay, Ho Chi Minh & Siem Reap with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Vietnam and Cambodia with Duniya Dekho. Visit Hanoi, Halong Bay Cruise, Ho Chi Minh City and Siem Reap including Angkor Wat and cultural highlights.
description: Discover the wonders of Vietnam and Cambodia on this unforgettable journey. Explore Vietnam's vibrant cities: Hanoi's rich history, Halong Bay's stunning landscapes, and Ho Chi Minh City's bustling streets. Then, venture into Cambodia and uncover the ancient secrets of Siem Reap's magnificent Angkor Wat temple complex. Experience the warmth of local hospitality, indulge in delicious cuisine, and create lifelong memories in these incredible destinations.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Vietnam and Cambodia are located in Southeast Asia, bordered by China, Laos, and Thailand.Vietnam's diverse geography features tropical rainforests, towering mountains, and a long coastline along the South China Sea.Cambodia's landscape is dominated by the Mekong River and Tonle Sap Lake, with a tropical climate and two distinct seasons: wet and dry. The region's climate is generally warm and humid, with temperatures ranging from 20-30°C (68-86°F) throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our driver will greet you and transfer you to your hotel in the city center. Spend the morning relaxing and rejuvenating after your journey.In the afternoon, delve into Hanoi's rich history and culture with a visit to Ba Dinh Square, the heart of the city's cultural and political life. Take a moment to photograph the iconic Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from the outside.
additionalInfo: Next, explore the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's oldest university, founded in 1070. Stroll through the serene gardens and admire the well-preserved architecture, a testament to the country's rich heritage.
Take a leisurely walk around picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, home to temples, pagodas, and a popular spot for locals and visitors alike.

Finally, wander through Hanoi's enchanting Old Quarter, a maze of narrow alleys and traditional shophouses. Discover the unique charm of 'The 36 Streets,' where each street is named after its traditional trade.
Overnight in Hanoi, ready to continue your Vietnamese adventure tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description: Depart Hanoi for Ha Long Bay, a stunning Natural World Heritage Site recognized by UNESCO. Upon arrival at the Cruise Port, receive a warm welcome from the cruise staff and check-in for your overnight cruise.
additionalInfo: Embark on a journey to discover the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay, characterized by thousands of limestone rocks and karst grottoes. Savor a delicious lunch on board, then explore the bay's hidden gems, including ancient grottos, pristine beaches, and floating villages.
Enjoy swimming, kayaking, or simply taking in the majestic scenery. Later, return to the cruise for a cooking demonstration, followed by a delightful dinner.
Spend the evening at leisure, relaxing on board or participating in activities. Overnight on the cruise, surrounded by the tranquil beauty of Ha Long Bay.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Rise early to witness the breathtaking dawn over Ha Long Bay, as the sun rises over the emerald waters and limestone islets. Enjoy a delicious breakfast on board, then continue cruising through the bay's stunning landscapes.
additionalInfo: Discover the uniquely shaped islets, each with its own name, such as Sail Island, Fisherman's Head Rock, and Turtle Islet. Check out of your cabin and savor a leisurely brunch on board as the cruise returns to the pier.
Disembark and transfer back to Hanoi, where you'll check-in to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing or exploring the city. Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: In Hanoi, your driver will pick you up and transfer you to Noi Bai Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City (flight tickets excluded).
additionalInfo: Upon arrival in Ho Chi Minh City, also known as Saigon, you'll be welcomed by your local tour guide and transferred to the city center.
Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour
itinerary.description: Begin the day with breakfast at your hotel, then depart for a morning city tour.Visit the Independence Palace, a historic landmark and witness to the Vietnam War. Explore the grand building, now a museum and reception hall. Continue to the beautiful Notre Dame Cathedral, a French colonial-era structure, and the historic Central Post Office, one of the city's major landmarks. Next, visit the War Remnants Museum, a poignant reminder of the country's turbulent past. Gain insight into the Vietnamese perspective on the war and the nation's struggle for independence. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, savoring traditional Vietnamese cuisine.
additionalInfo: In the afternoon, drive to the Cu Chi Tunnels, a network of underground tunnels that played a vital role in the war. Explore the tunnels, learning about their construction and significance. Experience the thrill of firing a rifle (optional) and gain a deeper understanding of the war and its impact on the nation.
Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the evening and overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Day Trip
itinerary.description: Begin the day with breakfast at your hotel, then depart for My Tho, a charming town on the Mekong River.Visit the historic Vinh Trang Pagoda, dating back to the 19th century. Then, board a sampan and cruise through the picturesque islands of the Mekong Delta, including Dragon, Unicorn, Phoenix, and Tortoise islands. Stop at Unicorn Island to stroll through orchards, enjoy tropical fruits, and experience traditional folk music. Visit a local fruit plantation and ride a hand-rowed sampan through the serene Thoi Son canal. Interact with local villagers, visit a honey-bee farm, and sample honey tea and coconut candy. Savor a delicious lunch at a local restaurant.
additionalInfo: In the afternoon, choose to cycle through Tan Thach village, immersing yourself in local daily life, or relax in a hammock, enjoying the cool breeze.
Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the late afternoon, with memories of the Mekong Delta's natural beauty and rich culture. Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Siem Reap
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure until checking out of your hotel. Your driver will then transfer you to the airport for your flight to Siem Reap (flight tickets excluded). Upon arrival in Siem Reap, you'll be greeted and driven to your hotel for check-in. In the afternoon, visit the Senteurs D'Angkor New Workshop, where local artisans create handmade soap, cosmetics, and spices. Observe the preparation of traditional curry and amok, and sample local flavors like flavored coffee and tea. Next, visit Wat Bo, a respected pagoda founded in the 18th century, featuring unique wall paintings of the Reamker (Ramayana). End the day at Psar Chars, Siem Reap's lively 'Old Market',
additionalInfo: where you can find everything from souvenirs to local delicacies. Overnight in Siem Reap.

itinerary.title: Explore Angkor Thom and Angkor Wat
itinerary.description: Begin the day with breakfast at your hotel, then set out to explore the ancient city of Angkor Thom. Visit the South Gate of Angkor Thom, also known as 'Big Angkor', a 3km² walled and moated royal city that was the last capital of the Angkorian Empire. Discover the famous
additionalInfo: Bayon Temple, a masterpiece of Khmer architecture, and the Terrace of the Elephants, an impressive 300-meter-long wall adorned with carved elephants. Explore the Royal Palace Area, Phimeanakas, and the Terrace of the Leper King, featuring intricate carvings and mythological beings. Next, visit the enchanting Ta Prohm Temple, a testament to the power of nature, with its crumbling stones and vines. In the afternoon, explore the magnificent Angkor Wat Temple, one of the wonders of the oriental world. Marvel at its awe-inspiring ruins, decorative details, and architectural style, a testament to the achievements of Southeast Asia's greatest civilization.
Overnight in Siem Reap

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure until checking out of your hotel.
additionalInfo: Your driver will then transfer you to the airport for your departure flight, bringing an end to your unforgettable journey through Vietnam and Cambodia.
We hope you have had a wonderful trip and we bid you farewell!

metaTitle: Phuket & Krabi Tour Package | Beaches, Islands & Adventure with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience Thailand's tropical gems with Duniya Dekho. Visit Phuket & Krabi including Phi Phi Islands, Four Island Tour, beaches, temples, nightlife & adventure.
description: Embark on a tropical paradise adventure to Phuket and Krabi, two of Thailand's most stunning destinations, where turquoise waters, powdery white sand beaches, and dramatic limestone cliffs await. This 5-night, 6-day journey promises breathtaking landscapes, crystal-clear waters, and unforgettable experiences that will leave you enchanted and inspired.Get ready to immerse yourself in the warmth and hospitality of Thai culture, indulge in delicious local cuisine, and unwind in the tranquil atmosphere of these tropical paradises. Whether you're seeking relaxation, adventure, or a mix of both, Phuket and Krabi offer the ultimate getaway for travelers of all kinds.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Phuket and Krabi are located in southern Thailand, along the Andaman Sea coast. Phuket is Thailand's largest island, boasting stunning beaches, limestone cliffs, and lush forests. Krabi Province, meanwhile, is a mainland destination known for its dramatic limestone karsts, turquoise waters, and idyllic islands.The climate in Phuket and Krabi is tropical, with warm temperatures and high humidity year-round. The region experiences two main seasons: the dry season (November to April), characterized by clear skies and calm seas, and the wet season (May to October), marked by occasional rain showers and rougher seas.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Krabi City Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive at Phuket International Airport and transfer to Krabi, a stunning province known for its breathtaking beaches, islands, and limestone cliffs. Check-in to your hotel and freshen up.Later, embark on a city tour of Krabi, exploring its charming streets, bustling markets, and iconic landmarks. Visit the revered Wat Kaew Korawaram, a stunning Buddhist temple, and the vibrant Krabi Town Night Market, offering a wide range of local goods and street food.
additionalInfo: As the day comes to a close, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Four Island Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on an unforgettable Four Island Tour, exploring Krabi's most stunning islands.Visit the picturesque Tup Island, Chicken Island, Poda Island, and Phra Nang Cave Beach. Enjoy snorkeling, swimming, and sunbathing in crystal-clear waters, surrounded by towering limestone cliffs and powdery white sand beaches.
additionalInfo: As the day comes to a close, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Krabi to Phuket with Tiger Kingdom Visit
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast at your hotel, check out and bid farewell to Krabi. Transfer to Phuket, Thailand's largest island, known for its stunning beaches, vibrant nightlife, and rich culture.En route, visit the Tiger Kingdom, a unique wildlife sanctuary offering an up-close encounter with majestic tigers. Get ready for an unforgettable experience, interacting with these magnificent creatures in a safe and controlled environment.Upon arrival in Phuket, check-in to your hotel and freshen up. Spend the rest of the evening exploring Phuket's lively streets, trying local cuisine, or simply relaxing at your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay at your hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the breathtaking Phi Phi Islands, one of Thailand's most iconic destinations. Take a ferry ride through the turquoise waters of the Andaman Sea, surrounded by limestone cliffs and picturesque beaches.Visit the stunning Maya Bay, made famous by the movie. The Beach and explore the island's hidden coves, snorkel in the crystal-clear waters, and relax on the pristine beaches.
additionalInfo: As the day comes to a close, return to Phuket and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Phuket City Tour
itinerary.description: Explore the charms of Phuket on a guided city tour, discovering the island's rich history, vibrant culture, and stunning landmarks.Visit the iconic Promthep Cape, offering breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea, and the revered Wat Chalong, a stunning Buddhist temple.Stop by the Phuket Big Buddha, a majestic 45-meter-tall statue, and explore the bustling Old Phuket Town, with its Sino-Portuguese architecture and lively markets.
additionalInfo: As the day comes to a close, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast at your hotel, check out and bid farewell to Phuket. Transfer to Phuket International Airport for your onward journey, carrying memories of stunning beaches, crystal-clear waters, and unforgettable experiences.
additionalInfo: Depart with a heart full of joy and a promise to return to this tropical paradise someday.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Sunset Serenity

name: Explore Taiwan — Culture, Nature & and Wonder
metaTitle: Taiwan Tour Package | Taipei, Taroko Gorge & Scenic Wonders with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Taiwan with Duniya Dekho. Visit Taipei, Taroko Gorge, Sun Moon Lake, Jiufen, Shifen and enjoy culture, street food and nature.
description: Explore the vibrant city of Taipei, known for its stunning skyline, bustling night markets, and iconic landmarks like Taipei 101. Experience the natural beauty of Taichung, with its scenic mountains and lush countryside. Visit Kaohsiung, a city surrounded by stunning harbor views and historic landmarks. Discover the pristine landscapes and indigenous culture of Taitung, and relax in the hot springs and scenic surroundings of Jiaoxi. This journey showcases the diversity and charm of Taiwan, from bustling cities to natural wonders.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Taiwan is an island nation located in East Asia, characterized by a diverse geography of rugged mountains, scenic coastlines, and lush plains. The island's terrain is dominated by the Central Mountain Range, with peaks reaching over 3,000 meters. Taiwan's climate is subtropical in the north and tropical in the south, with four distinct seasons. The island is susceptible to typhoons and heavy rainfall during the summer months, while winters are generally mild in the north and warm in the south. This unique geography and climate support a wide range of flora and fauna, making Taiwan a haven for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Taipei
itinerary.description: Arrive at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) and transfer to your hotel in Taipei. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city on your own.
additionalInfo: Enjoy the evening at your own pace and overnight at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Taipei City Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the best of Taipei on a guided city tour, exploring iconic landmarks that showcase the city's rich history, vibrant culture, and modern spirit. Visit the world-famous National Palace Museum, Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, and Lungshan Temple, gaining valuable insights into Taipei's unique blend of tradition and heritage. Stop by the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper, a symbol of the city's modernity and architectural prowess. With your guide's expert commentary, enjoy a well-rounded city experience that highlights the best of Taipei. Overnight at the hotel in Taipei.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Taipei to Sun Moon Lake
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic drive from Taipei to Sun Moon Lake, Taiwan's largest freshwater lake, known for its unique shape and stunning natural beauty. Explore the lake's surroundings on a guided tour, visiting attractions like the Ita Thao indigenous village, Ci'en Pagoda, Xuanzang Temple, and the grand Wenwu Temple. Learn about the local Thao people's culture and traditions through your guide's insightful commentary.
additionalInfo: Overnight at a hotel near Sun Moon Lake or in downtown Taichung.

itinerary.title: Tainan and Kaohsiung
itinerary.description: Visit Tainan, Taiwan's oldest city, and explore historic Fort Zeelandia and Anping Old Street, known for its rich history and local delicacies. Then, head to Kaohsiung to discover the stunning Fo Guang Shan Monastery, featuring Southeast Asia's tallest standing Buddha and 480 smaller statues. Engage with a monk to gain insights into Buddhism and its teachings.
additionalInfo: Enjoy a comfortable stay at a 5-star hotel in Kaohsiung, conveniently located near shops and amenities. Overnight in Kaohsiung.

itinerary.title: Kenting National Park and Taitung
itinerary.description: Explore Kenting National Park's breathtaking coastal landscapes and rich marine life, visiting iconic sites like Maopitou, Chuanfan Rock, Eluanbi Lighthouse, and Longpan Park. Then, drive along the scenic South Link Highway to Taitung and unwind at Hotel Royal Chihpen. Relax and rejuvenate in the natural hot springs, easing any fatigue from the day's adventures.
additionalInfo: Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Taitung.

itinerary.title: East Coast Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic journey along Taiwan's stunning east coast, visiting natural wonders like Xiaoyeliu, Sanxiantai, Shitiping, and Fanshuliao. Marvel at the unique geological formations shaped by the sea. In the afternoon, enjoy a picturesque train ride from Hualien to Yilan. Relax and unwind in the evening at a hotel in Jiaoxi, known for its hot springs and serene surroundings.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Jiaoxi

itinerary.title: Whisky and Culture
itinerary.description: Visit the award-winning King Car Kavalan Whisky Distillery to learn about the whisky-making process and savor a tasting session. Then, explore Taiwan's rich cultural heritage at the National Center for Traditional Arts, featuring exhibitions, performances, and hands-on workshops.
additionalInfo: After a fulfilling day, enjoy a comfortable bus ride back to Taipei, concluding your island tour. Overnight in Taipei.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Check out of your hotel and transfer to Taoyuan International Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your Taiwan adventure.

name: Beautiful Philippines
metaTitle: Philippines Tour Package | Boracay, Cebu & Manila with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore the Philippines with Duniya Dekho. Visit Boracay, Cebu and Manila with white beaches, island hopping, lagoons, heritage sites and vibrant nightlife.
description: Experience the vibrant culture and stunning beauty of the Philippines on this 4-day adventure. Begin in Manila, the capital city, where you'll discover historic landmarks like Intramuros and Fort Santiago, and immerse yourself in the city's energetic atmosphere. Then, fly to Boracay, a tropical paradise famous for its crystal-clear waters, powdery white sand beaches, and breathtaking sunsets. Relax in a beachfront resort, snorkel or dive in the vibrant coral reefs, or simply bask in the island's laid-back charm. This journey offers the perfect blend of urban excitement and beachside serenity, showcasing the best of the Philippines.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The Philippines, an archipelago of over 7,000 islands, boasts a diverse geography of lush mountains, vast plains, and stunning coastlines. The islands are volcanic in origin, with rugged mountains, such as Mayon Volcano, and scenic hills, like the Chocolate Hills. The climate is tropical, with three main seasons: the hot and dry summer, the rainy season, and the cool winter. Temperatures range from 20-30°C (68-86°F), with high humidity levels throughout the year. The country is prone to typhoons and earthquakes, but its unique geography also creates a variety of microclimates, making each island a distinct and exciting destination.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manila
itinerary.description: Arrive in Manila, the vibrant capital of the Philippines, and enjoy a warm welcome from our representative. Transfer to your hotel, where you'll spend the night, and take some time to freshen up and relax after your journey.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Manila

itinerary.title: Manila City Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a comprehensive tour of Manila, exploring its rich history, cultural landmarks, and vibrant neighborhoods. Begin in the financial district of Makati, visiting Fort Bonifacio and the American Cemetery. Then, proceed to Rizal Park, a tribute to the country's national hero, Dr. Jose Rizal. Next, delve into the historic Walled City of Intramuros, discovering its cobblestone streets, ancient churches, and colonial-era architecture. Visit the iconic San Agustin Church, Casa Manila, and Fort Santiago, each revealing a unique aspect of Manila's complex past. Continue on to Quiapo, the city's bustling central district, and the Chinese Cemetery, where elaborate mausoleums and fusion architecture await. Conclude the day with some shopping before returning to your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Manila

itinerary.title: Manila to Boracay
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Manila and embark on a journey to the stunning island of Boracay. Transfer to the domestic airport for your flight to Caticlan, the gateway to Boracay. Upon arrival, take a scenic transfer to your hotel, where you'll spend the next two nights. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing on the beach, exploring the island, or simply enjoying the hotel's facilities.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Boracay

itinerary.title: Boracay Island Hopping Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable island-hopping adventure in Boracay, exploring the island's hidden coves, pristine beaches, and vibrant coral reefs. This exhilarating tour takes you to some of the island's most stunning spots, where you can snorkel, swim, and marvel at the breathtaking scenery. Discover the island's thriving marine life, and enjoy the crystal-clear turquoise waters. This island-hopping tour is the ultimate Boracay experience, creating lifelong memories of your tropical paradise getaway.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Boracay

itinerary.title: Departure from Manila
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the stunning island of Boracay and transfer to the airport for your return journey to Manila. From Manila, board your international flight back home, carrying with you a treasure trove of unforgettable memories from your Philippines adventure.

name: Bhutan Adventure
metaTitle: Bhutan Tour Package | Thimphu, Paro & Punakha with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Bhutan with Duniya Dekho. Visit Thimphu, Paro and Punakha with monasteries, fortresses, scenic valleys and rich culture in the Land of Happiness.
description: Discover the mystical kingdom of Bhutan, a land of breathtaking beauty, pristine culture, and warm hospitality. Visit the charming cities of Thimphu, Punakha, and Paro, and immerse yourself in the country's unique blend of traditional and modern charm. Explore majestic fortress monasteries, ancient temples, and sacred sites, including the iconic Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest Monastery), and discover the vibrant culture, rich history, and stunning natural beauty of Bhutan, from lush valleys and towering mountains to picturesque villages and traditional farms, with a 5-night journey through Thimphu (2N), Punakha (1N), and Paro (2N).

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Bhutan, a small country nestled in the Himalayas, boasts a diverse geography with towering mountains, lush forests, and picturesque valleys. The country's climate varies greatly depending on the altitude, with subtropical temperatures in the south and cold, snowy winters in the north. The four distinct seasons bring different experiences, from the rhododendron blooms of spring to the warm summers, harvest-filled autumns, and serene winters, making Bhutan a year-round destination for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhutan and Transfer to Thimphu
itinerary.description: Begin your journey to Bhutan with a breathtaking mountain flight from India. As you fly into the Himalayas, witness the world's highest peaks from the left side of the aircraft, with your pilot announcing the names of the mountains if the weather permits.Descend into the high mountains and take in the stunning views of the Paro Valley, with its lush alpine forests, quaint monasteries, temples, and traditional farmhouses. Catch a glimpse of the fertile Paro Valley, the majestic Paro Dzong, and the meandering Paro Chu river before landing at Paro International Airport.Upon arrival, our representative will greet you and assist with your transfer to Thimphu, the capital city of Bhutan. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city or relaxing in your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu City Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day city tour of Thimphu, exploring its iconic landmarks and cultural attractions.Visit the revered National Memorial Chorten, a stupa dedicated to the third king of Bhutan, and marvel at the impressive Buddha statue. Next, stop at the Takin Zoo, home to the national animal of Bhutan, the takin.Drive downhill and pause at the junction to admire the majestic Trashichho Dzong, a stunning fortress monastery that serves as the seat of the government.Continue to the National Library, which houses a vast collection of ancient Buddhist texts and manuscripts, and the Folk Heritage Museum, showcasing the traditional Bhutanese way of life.In the afternoon, take a leisurely stroll to the Handicraft Bazaar, where you can witness artisans at work and shop for traditional handicrafts.Spend the late afternoon at leisure, exploring the city's main streets, shopping for souvenirs, or simply relaxing in a local café.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy an overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for the scenic Punakha Valley, driving through the majestic Dochula Pass (10,000 ft). Stop at the charming Hongtsho village and the immigration checkpoint to stamp your permit.As you cross the pass, marvel at the stunning 108 Druk Wangyal chortens, adorned with colorful prayer flags. Descend into the picturesque Punakha Valley, passing through Thinleygang village and Lobesa.Take a short walk through the villages to visit the revered Chimmi Lhakhang, a temple dedicated to the 'Divine Madman' Drukpa Kinley. Later, explore the majestic Punakha Dzong, strategically located at the confluence of the Pho Chu and Mo Chu rivers.
additionalInfo: Arrive at your hotel in Punakha and spend the rest of the evening at leisure. Overnight stay in Punakha.

itinerary.title: Punakha to Paro via Thimphu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Paro, driving via Thimphu. Stop at Lampelri and visit the serene Royal Botanical Park, home to a diverse range of flora and fauna. Spend 30 minutes exploring the park, where you may spot red pandas, various bird species, and take photos by the natural lake. You may also have the opportunity to watch a short documentary about the park.Continue your drive to Paro, passing through Semtokha, and transfer to your hotel upon arrival. Check-in and spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing or exploring Paro's charming town.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Paro.

itinerary.title: Paro Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour of Paro, exploring its iconic landmarks and cultural attractions.Visit the majestic Paro Dzong, a fortress monastery that dates back to the 17th century. Next, explore the National Museum, housed in the round fortress of Ta Dzong, which showcases a fine collection of natural and historic artifacts, making it one of the best natural history museums in Asia.In the afternoon, visit the Paro Penlop Heritage Farmhouse, which offers a glimpse into traditional Bhutanese farming practices. Stop by the ruins of Drukgyel Dzong, a 17th-century fortress that once protected the kingdom from Tibetan invaders. Explore the ancient Kyichu Lhakhang, one of the oldest and most sacred monasteries in Bhutan, dating back to the 7th century.Later, transfer to the base of the iconic Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery, one of the most revered spiritual heritage sites in Bhutan.Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Paro's charming town, shopping for souvenirs, or simply relaxing in a local café
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy an overnight stay in Paro.

itinerary.title: Departure from Paro
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, bid farewell to the enchanting kingdom of Bhutan as you transfer to Paro International Airport for your onward flight, carrying back memories of your unforgettable journey.

name: Classic China: A Journey Through
metaTitle: China Tour Package | Beijing, Shanghai & Xi’an with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore China with Duniya Dekho. Visit Beijing, Shanghai & Xi'an with the Great Wall, Forbidden City, Terracotta Warriors, skylines & ancient culture.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through China's ancient history, vibrant culture, and breathtaking landscapes. Explore the iconic cities of Beijing, Xian, and Shanghai, each offering a unique glimpse into China's fascinating past and present.

Discover Beijing's majestic Great Wall, Forbidden City, and Temple of Heaven, showcasing the city's rich imperial heritage. Uncover the secrets of Xian's ancient Terracotta Warriors and experience the city's vibrant Muslim Quarter. In Shanghai, marvel at the stunning skyline, explore the picturesque Yu Garden, and experience the city's cutting-edge technology and innovation.
This incredible 7-night journey takes you to the heart of China, blending history, culture, and modernity in an unforgettable adventure.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: China, the world's third-largest country, encompasses a vast and diverse geography, with sprawling mountains, majestic rivers, and expansive deserts. The landscape ranges from the snow-capped Himalayas in the southwest to the scenic coastlines along the East China Sea. China's climate varies greatly, with tropical regions in the south, temperate zones in the east, and cold, arid deserts in the northwest. The country experiences four distinct seasons, with harsh winters in the north and milder winters in the south, while summers can be hot and humid, especially in the eastern coastal regions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Beijing
itinerary.description: Arrive at Beijing International Airport, marking the beginning of your incredible China journey. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in. Spend the remainder of the day exploring Beijing at your own pace, discovering its vibrant streets, trying local cuisine, or simply relaxing at your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Beijing.

itinerary.title: Great Wall of China & Jade Factory
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling day trip to one of the world's most iconic landmarks - the Great Wall of China. Visit the majestic Juyong Pass section of the wall, exploring its ancient history and marveling at its sheer scale. Next, visit a local Jade factory, learning about the significance and craftsmanship of this precious stone. En route, make a photo stop at the impressive Olympic Stadium, a testament to Beijing's modern architecture. Return to your hotel in the evening, with unforgettable memories of the day's adventure.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Beijing.

itinerary.title: Beijing City Tour
itinerary.description: Delve into the rich history and culture of Beijing on a comprehensive city tour. Start at Tiananmen Square, one of the world's largest public squares, and then explore the magnificent Forbidden City, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and former imperial palace. Visit the stunning Summer Palace, a masterpiece of Chinese garden design. Later, enjoy a few hours of free time to indulge in some shopping at the vibrant Hongqiao Market, where you can find everything from souvenirs to local delicacies. Return to your hotel in the evening, with a deeper understanding of Beijing's fascinating heritage.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Beijing.

itinerary.title: Beijing to Xi'an & Big Wild Goose Pagoda
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Beijing and embark on a journey to the ancient city of Xi'an. After breakfast, check-out of your hotel and transfer to the train station or airport for your onward journey to Xi'an. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by a representative and transferred to your hotel. Later, visit the iconic Big Wild Goose Pagoda Square, a masterpiece of Buddhist architecture, and marvel at the spectacular Fountain Show. Return to your hotel in the evening, with a glimpse into Xi'an's rich history and culture.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Xi'an.

itinerary.title: Terra Cotta Warriors & Xi'an City
itinerary.description: Uncover the secrets of Xi'an's ancient past on a full-day tour. Visit the world-renowned Terra Cotta Warriors, one of the greatest archaeological discoveries of the 20th century, and explore the nearby Crockery Factory. Return to the city and make a photo stop at the ancient City Wall, a testament to Xi'an's rich history. Later, indulge in some shopping and local cuisine on Muslim Street, a vibrant and colorful marketplace. Return to your hotel in the evening, with unforgettable memories of Xi'an's unique blend of history and culture.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Xi'an.

itinerary.title: Xi'an to Shanghai
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Xi'an and embark on a journey to the cosmopolitan city of Shanghai. After breakfast, check-out of your hotel and transfer to the train station or airport for your onward journey to Shanghai. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city's vibrant atmosphere, or simply relaxing at your hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Shanghai City Tour
itinerary.description: Experience the vibrant energy of Shanghai on a comprehensive city tour. Visit the iconic People's Square, explore the Silk factory, and wander through the bustling Yuyuan Bazaar. Take in breathtaking views of the city from the 88th floor of the Jinmao Tower, and stroll along the picturesque Bund area, with its stunning colonial architecture. Later, indulge in some retail therapy on Nanjing Road, one of China's premier shopping destinations, with a few hours of free time to browse and shop. Return to your hotel in the evening, with unforgettable memories of Shanghai's unique blend of tradition and modernity.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Shanghai.

itinerary.title: Departure from Shanghai
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Shanghai and China as you check-out of your hotel after breakfast. Transfer to Shanghai Airport for your departure flight, carrying back memories of your incredible journey through China's ancient history, vibrant culture, and breathtaking landscapes.

name: MAURITIUS
metaTitle: Mauritius Tour Package | Beaches, Lagoons & Islands with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Mauritius with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy pristine beaches, lagoons, island excursions, water sports and cultural attractions.
description: Discover the gem of the Indian Ocean - Mauritius! This tropical paradise is famous for its stunning beaches, crystal-clear waters, and coral reefs, with diverse landscapes ranging from lush forests to rugged mountains. Experience the unique blend of French, British, and African cultures, enjoy snorkeling, diving, and other water sports, and relax on pristine beaches, making Mauritius the perfect destination for adventure, relaxation, or romance.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Mauritius is an island nation located in the Indian Ocean, approximately 2,000 kilometers off the southeastern coast of Africa. The island is volcanic in origin, with a central plateau surrounded by mountains, forests, and a stunning coastline of beaches, bays, and coves. Mauritius has a tropical maritime climate, with warm temperatures ranging from 22-28°C (72-82°F) throughout the year. The island experiences two main seasons: a warm and humid summer from December to April, and a milder winter from June to September, making it an ideal destination for year-round travel

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mauritius
itinerary.description: Welcome to the beautiful island of Mauritius! Upon arrival, you'll be greeted and transferred to your hotel, where you can unwind and freshen up. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring your surroundings, relaxing on the beach, or enjoying the hotel's facilities.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Mauritius.

itinerary.title: North Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a fascinating North Island Tour, exploring the vibrant city of Port Louis. Visit the Citadel, a historic fort that offers breathtaking views of the city, and stop at the Marie Reine De Paix viewpoint for panoramic views. Discover the iconic Champ de Mars racecourse, one of the oldest in the world, and indulge in some retail therapy at Le Caudan Waterfront, featuring over 170 shops. En route back to your hotel, make a brief stop at the popular Jumbo shopping mall.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Mauritius.

itinerary.title: Full Day South Island Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling Full Day South Island tour, exploring the island's natural wonders and cultural attractions. Visit the Model Ship Factory in Floreal, and marvel at the stunning views from Trou Aux Cerfs, a dormant volcanic crater. Discover the charming residential town of Curepipe, and proceed to Grand Bassin, a sacred lake and home to the majestic Shiva Temple. Drive through the breathtaking Plaine Champagne and explore the unique 23-Coloured Nature Park, featuring volcanic ash landscapes that date back millions of years.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Mauritius.

itinerary.title: Ile Aux Cerfs Island Excursion
itinerary.description: Spend the day basking in the sun and fun on the stunning Ile Aux Cerfs Island. Take a speedboat from Trou D'eaxu Douce to the island, and enjoy a day of leisure and relaxation. Explore the island at your own pace, swim in the crystal-clear waters, and indulge in various water sports (at your own expense). A perfect day to unwind and soak up the tropical island atmosphere. Overnight at the hotel in Mauritius.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Mauritius.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the beautiful island of Mauritius as you are transferred to the airport for your departure flight, carrying back memories of your wonderful tropical getaway.

name: Maldives
metaTitle: Maldives Tour Package | Luxury Resorts, Water Villas & Beaches with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience Maldives with Duniya Dekho. Stay at premium island resorts, enjoy crystal blue waters, water sports, and tropical beaches.
description: Escape to a tropical paradise in the Maldives, where luxurious beach villas overlook crystal-clear waters and pristine white sand beaches. Snorkel or dive among vibrant coral reefs and marine life, indulge in world-class spa treatments and fine dining experiences, and enjoy sunset cruises, fishing, and other water sports in a stunning Indian Ocean setting. Book your dream Maldives getaway and experience the ultimate in relaxation and luxury!

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The Maldives is an island nation located in the Indian Ocean, southwest of India and Sri Lanka. This tropical paradise is comprised of 1,192 coral islands, forming a double chain of 26 atolls, spread over approximately 90,000 square kilometers. The Maldives' geography is characterized by crystal-clear waters, pristine white sand beaches, and coral reefs teeming with marine life. The climate is warm and humid, with average temperatures ranging from 28-32°C (82-90°F) throughout the year. The Maldives experiences two distinct seasons: the dry northeast monsoon from December to April, and the wet southwest monsoon from May to November.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Maldives
itinerary.description: Welcome to the Maldives, a tropical paradise famous for its stunning coral islands, turquoise lagoons, and vibrant marine life. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted with a warm welcome and transferred to your resort by speedboat, offering a glimpse into the breathtaking beauty that awaits. Spend the rest of the day relaxing and enjoying the resort's facilities.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the resort.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Maldives
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delicious breakfast, then indulge in a day of relaxation and leisure. Spend your time lounging on the pristine beach, or try your hand at exciting water activities like snorkelling, scuba diving, windsurfing, or canoeing (optional, at extra cost). Enjoy the resort's facilities and soak up the tranquil atmosphere. Overnight at the resort.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the resort.

itinerary.title: Island Exploration
itinerary.description: Today is yours to explore the island at your own pace. Discover hidden coves, take a leisurely stroll along the beach, or simply relax in a secluded spot. The day is yours to unwind and soak up the serenity of the Maldives. Overnight at the resort.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the resort.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Today, bid farewell to the beautiful Maldives as you are transferred to the airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your wonderful island getaway.

name: Seychelles — Islands of Endless Beauty
metaTitle: Seychelles Tour Package | Pristine Beaches, Islands & Nature with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Seychelles, a tropical island paradise in the Indian Ocean known for crystal-clear turquoise waters, white-sand beaches, granite rock formations, vibrant coral reefs, and lush green hills. Perfect for honeymooners, beach lovers, and nature enthusiasts seeking a peaceful getaway.
description: Seychelles is a breathtaking tropical island nation in the Indian Ocean, known for its crystal-clear turquoise waters, powdery white-sand beaches, and dramatic granite rock formations. Surrounded by vibrant coral reefs and lush green hills, the islands offer a perfect blend of natural beauty and tranquility. With its warm tropical climate, rich marine life, and relaxed island atmosphere, Seychelles is an ideal destination for beach lovers, honeymooners, and nature enthusiasts seeking a peaceful and scenic getaway.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Seychelles is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, located northeast of Madagascar, and consists of 115 islands divided into granite islands (such as Mahe, Praslin, and La Digue) and coral islands. The country is famous for its white sandy beaches, turquoise waters, lush tropical forests, and unique granite rock formations. It has a tropical climate with warm temperatures throughout the year, usually ranging between 24°C and 32°C. The weather is generally humid with refreshing sea breezes. The northwest monsoon season (November to March) is warmer and wetter, while the southeast monsoon (May to September) brings cooler and drier conditions.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Mahe – Transfer to Praslin
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Mahe International Airport, you will proceed to the jetty to board the ferry to Praslin.The scenic ferry ride takes approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes, offering beautiful views of the Indian Ocean.On arrival in Praslin, transfer to your hotel and check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure relaxing on the beach, enjoying the resort facilities, or exploring the nearby surroundings at your own pace
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Praslin.

itinerary.title: Praslin – La Digue Island Boat & Bike Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for an exciting full-day excursion to La Digue Island. You will travel by boat from Praslin to La Digue, one of the most picturesque islands in Seychelles.Upon arrival, explore the island by bicycle, the most popular and charming way to discover La Digue.Visit the world-famous Anse Source d’Argent beach, known for its stunning granite rock formations and crystal-clear waters. You may also explore L’Union Estate and enjoy the relaxed island atmosphere.
additionalInfo: Later in the afternoon, return by boat to Praslin. Overnight stay in Praslin.

itinerary.title: Praslin – Visit Valle de Mai & Anse LazioL
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Valle de Mai Nature Reserve. This prehistoric forest is home to the rare Coco de Mer palm and unique wildlife species found only in Seychelles. Enjoy a guided walk through the lush tropical forest and learn about its fascinating ecosystem.Later, proceed to Anse Lazio, one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Relax on the soft white sand, swim in the turquoise waters, or simply soak in the breathtaking scenery.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening. Overnight stay in Praslin

itinerary.title: Praslin to Mahe
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and transfer to the jetty for your ferry back to Mahe. The ferry ride takes approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.Upon arrival in Mahe, transfer to your hotel and check in. Spend the remainder of the day at leisure.You may relax at the beach, explore local markets, or enjoy optional water activities.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Mahe.

itinerary.title: Mahe – Full Day Mahe Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day guided tour of Mahe Island. Explore the capital city, Victoria,one of the smallest capitals in the world. Visit landmarks such as the Clock Tower, local market, and botanical gardens.Continue your journey through scenic mountain roads and coastal routes, stopping at panoramic view points for spectacular photo opportunities. Visit beautiful beaches such as Beau Vallon and enjoy the island’s natural beauty.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening. Overnight stay in Mahe.

itinerary.title: Mahe – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from your hotel. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have some free time for last-minute shopping or relaxation.
additionalInfo: Later, transfer to Mahe International Airport for your onward flight, carrying wonderful memories of your Seychelles holiday.

name: Discover the Jewel of Sri Lanka
metaTitle: Sri Lanka Tour Package | Beaches, Heritage & Nature with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Sri Lanka with Duniya Dekho. Visit Colombo, Kandy, Bentota and Sigiriya with cultural heritage, beaches, tea gardens and wildlife experiences.
description: Explore the heart of Sri Lanka on this 4-night, 5-day adventure. Discover Kandy's cultural treasures, Nuwara Eliya's stunning landscapes, and Colombo's vibrant streets.Immerse yourself in ancient temples, tea plantations, and colonial architecture. Experience the warm hospitality, rich heritage, and breathtaking beauty of Sri Lanka.Create lifelong memories on this carefully curated journey, perfect for those seeking a mix of culture, nature, and adventure.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Sri Lanka, an island nation in South Asia, boasts a diverse geography, with lush rainforests, towering mountains, and pristine beaches. The country's terrain is dominated by the Central Highlands, with peaks like Adam's Peak and Kirigalpoththa. The climate is tropical, with three main seasons: hot and dry (December to April), monsoon (May to September), and cool and dry (October to November). The north-east monsoon brings significant rainfall, while the south-west monsoon affects the western coast. Temperatures range from 22°C to 32°C (72°F to 90°F) throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Colombo City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at the airport, our representative will warmly welcome and assist you. Begin your Sri Lankan adventure with a scenic drive to Colombo, the country's vibrant commercial capital.Discover the best of Colombo on a comprehensive city tour, featuring iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Explore the bustling Pettah Market, admire the stunning architecture of the Red Mosque, and stroll through the picturesque Vihara Mahadevi Park.Visit the historic Race Course, the futuristic Colombo Port City, and the iconic Independence Square. Unwind in the evening with a relaxing stay at your hotel in Colombo.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Colombo

itinerary.title: Colombo to Nuwara Eliya via Kitulgala
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast at the hotel, embark on a scenic journey to Nuwara Eliya, a picturesque hill station nestled in the heart of Sri Lanka's tea country.As you wind your way through misty roads and lush green tea plantations, the cool climate and English countryside atmosphere will transport you to a bygone era. Nuwara Eliya, once a British colonial retreat, is dotted with colonial bungalows, hedgerows, and a world-class golf course.Experience the natural beauty of the hill country, with its endless waterfalls, rolling green valleys, and tea pluckers in vibrant saris. Take a leisurely hike or bike ride along the shores of Lake Gregory, and soak up the tranquil atmosphere.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Nuwara Eliya

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya to Kandy via Tea Plantation
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a journey to the heart of Sri Lanka's tea country. Visit a renowned tea plantation and discover the art of Ceylon Tea production.Take a guided tour of the tea factory, learning about the traditional tea-making process and the rich history behind this iconic brand. As you stroll through the lush green tea estates, breathe in the crisp mountain air and savor the scent of freshly brewed tea.Later, proceed to Kandy, the last royal capital of Sri Lanka and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the city's rich cultural heritage, including the sacred Temple of the Tooth, a revered Buddhist site.Experience the vibrant atmosphere of Kandy, strolling through the bustling markets, visiting the Kandy City Centre, and enjoying a cultural show featuring traditional music and dance.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Kandy

itinerary.title: Kandy to Colombo via Peradeniya and Pinnawala
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the majestic Royal Botanical Gardens of Peradeniya, a 147-acre oasis of lush greenery and vibrant flora. Stroll through the beautifully landscaped gardens, admiring the orchid house, giant Javan fig tree, and other highlights.Next, proceed to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a sanctuary for rescued and orphaned elephants. Witness the heartwarming sight of baby elephants being bottle-fed and roam freely in their natural habitat. Observe these gentle giants taking a river bath, an unforgettable experience.Later, transfer to Colombo, the vibrant commercial capital of Sri Lanka. Check-in to your hotel and relax.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Colombo

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Sri Lanka as your unforgettable journey comes to an end. Spend the morning at leisure, relaxing at the hotel or exploring Colombo's nearby attractions.Later, you'll be escorted to the airport for your departure flight, carrying memories of Sri Lanka's stunninglandscapes, rich culture, and warm hospitality.

metaDescription: Explore Kuala Lumpur & Langkawi with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy tropical beaches, cable car views, shopping malls, island hopping and cultural landmarks.
description: Malaysia: A Cultural and Natural Paradise Located in the heart of Southeast Asia, Malaysia is a vibrant and diverse country that offers a unique blend of culture, history, and natural beauty. From the bustling streets of Kuala Lumpur to the idyllic beaches of Penang, and from the ancient rainforests of Taman Negara to the majestic mountains of the Cameron Highlands, Malaysia has something for every kind of traveler.

With its rich cultural heritage, Malaysia is a melting pot of different ethnicities, religions, and traditions. The country's vibrant cities, such as Kuala Lumpur and Penang, offer a glimpse into its colonial past, while its rural areas provide a window into its indigenous culture. From the delicious street food to the colorful festivals, Malaysia is a country that is full of life and energy.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Malaysia is a Southeast Asian country with two main landmasses: Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia. The afternoon is filled with more excitement as you explore the Sky Dome, Skyrex, and 3D Art Langkawi, culminating in a visit to the iconic Skybridge. After a day filled with adventure and excitement, retire to your hotel for a comfortable.

name: Singapore Lion City Delight
metaTitle: Singapore Tour Package | Marina Bay Sands, Sentosa & Gardens by the Bay with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Singapore with Duniya Dekho. Visit Marina Bay Sands, Sentosa Island, Universal Studios, Gardens by the Bay, Singapore Flyer, Chinatown and Little India.
description: Experience the vibrant city-state of Singapore, a melting pot of cultures and cuisines. Explore iconic landmarks like Gardens by the Bay and Marina Bay Sands. Enjoy thrilling attractions like Universal Studios Singapore and Sentosa Island. Savor the flavors of Singapore's street food scene and indulge in world-class shopping. Discover the city's rich history and cultural heritage in this 5-day adventure.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Singapore is an island city-state located at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula, approximately 137 kilometers north of the equator. The city-state comprises the main island of Singapore and 62 smaller islands. Singapore has a tropical rainforest climate with high humidity and temperatures ranging from 23°C to 34°C throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore and Night Safari Adventure
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, you'll be warmly greeted by our representative. They will assist you with a seamless transfer to your hotel, where you'll check-in and freshen up.Later in the evening, get ready for a thrilling adventure at the world-famous Night Safari! Embark on a journey through the jungle, where you'll encounter fascinating nocturnal creatures from around the world. With over 1,000 animals from 120 species, this unique experience promises to be an unforgettable highlight of your Singapore trip.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour and Sentosa Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel, fueling up for an exciting day ahead.Half-Day City Tour of Singapore (9:00 am - 12:00 pm) Embark on a comprehensive city tour, showcasing the best of Singapore's iconic landmarks and cultural attractions. Visit:
additionalInfo: Merlion Park: Witness the majestic Merlion statue, a symbol of Singapore's rich history.
Chinatown: Explore the vibrant streets, temples, and markets of this charming neighborhood.
Little India: Discover the colorful culture, temples, and cuisine of Singapore's Indian community.
Marina Bay Sands: Marvel at the stunning architecture and breathtaking views of the city skyline.
Sentosa Island Adventure (1:00 pm - 5:00 pm)
After the city tour, head to Sentosa Island, a tropical paradise offering an array of exciting experiences:
S.E.A. Aquarium: Explore the underwater world, featuring over 100,000 marine animals from around the globe.
Madame Tussauds Singapore: Get up close and personal with wax figures of famous celebrities and historical leaders.
Wings of Time (7:30 pm - 8:30 pm)

End your day with a spectacular display of light, sound, and water at Wings of Time, a mesmerizing night show at Sentosa Island. Witness the fusion of music, laser, and pyrotechnics, set against the stunning backdrop of the Singaporean skyline.Dinner and Overnight Stay
Return to the hotel in the evening and enjoy a delightful dinner at the hotel's restaurant. Spend the rest of the evening relaxing in your room or exploring the surrounding area.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Adventure at Universal Studios Singapore
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel, fueling up for an action-packed day ahead.Full-Day Universal Studios Singapore (9:00 am - 6:00 pm) Get ready for a thrilling adventure at Universal Studios Singapore, one of the most popular theme parks in Asia! Explore the park's seven themed zones, featuring:
additionalInfo: Hollywood: Experience the glamour of Tinseltown, with movie-themed attractions and live shows.
New York: Step into the bustling streets of the Big Apple, complete with iconic landmarks and thrilling rides.
Sci-Fi City: Blast off into a futuristic world of science fiction, with cutting-edge attractions and interactive experiences.
Ancient Egypt: Embark on an epic adventure through the land of the pharaohs, with pyramids, mummies, and treasures to discover.
Jurassic Park: Enter a world of prehistoric wonder, with life-like dinosaurs and thrilling rides.
Far Away: Visit the enchanted kingdom from the Shrek franchise, with colourful characters, rides, and attractions.
Madagascar: Join Alex, Marty, and their friends from the Madagascar movies, with fun rides, shows, and play areas.

itinerary.title: Wild Encounters at Singapore Zoo and Gardens by the Bay
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel, fueling up for a fun-filled day ahead Singapore Zoo (9:00 am - 12:00 pm)Transfer to the Singapore Zoo, one of the world's best zoos, home to over 2,800 animals from around the globe. Explore the zoo's naturalistic habitats, including:
additionalInfo: Rainforest Kidzworld: An interactive play area for kids, featuring water play, pony rides, and a petting zoo.
Australian Outback: Get up close to kangaroos, wallabies, and emus in a walk-through exhibit.
Fragile Forest: Discover the fascinating world of tropical rainforests, featuring animals such as orangutans, lemurs, and flying foxes.
Gardens by the Bay (2:00 pm - 5:00 pm)
After lunch, head to Gardens by the Bay, a stunning 101-hectare park featuring incredible floral displays and towering Supertree Grove. Explore:
Flower Dome: Marvel at the breathtaking floral displays, featuring plants from around the world.
Cloud Forest: Discover the mysteries of the tropical cloud forest, with its misty veil, waterfalls, and rare plants.
Supertree Grove: Be amazed by the towering Supertrees, measuring up to 16 stories high.Return to Hotel and Overnight Stay

itinerary.title: Departure from Singapore
itinerary.description: After a wonderful 4-night stay in Singapore, it's time to bid farewell to this vibrant city-state.Check-out of Hotel and Departure (9:00 am - 12:00 pm).Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel, before checking out and proceeding to Changi International Airport for your departure flight.

name: Vietnam Discovery: Hanoi and Ha Long Bay
metaTitle: Vietnam Tour Package | Hanoi, Halong Bay & Ho Chi Minh City with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Vietnam with Duniya Dekho. Visit Hanoi, Halong Bay, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City, Mekong Delta, Cu Chi Tunnels and enjoy Vietnam's culture, cuisine, and landscapes.
description: Experience an unforgettable journey through Vietnam's vibrant culture and breathtaking natural beauty. This itinerary takes you to Hanoi, the country's charming capital, and Ha Long Bay, a stunning UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore Hanoi's Old Quarter, rich in history and culture, and cruise through Ha Long Bay's majestic limestone karsts and emerald waters. Discover ancient temples, pagodas, and historical landmarks, and indulge in delicious Vietnamese cuisine and local street food. Relax onboard a luxurious cruise in Ha Long Bay, and experience the warm hospitality of the Vietnamese people.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Vietnam is a long, thin country located in Southeast Asia, bordered by China to the north, Laos and Cambodia to the west, and the South China Sea to the east. The country's geography is diverse, with mountains, hills, and plains, including the Annamite Mountains and the Mekong Delta. Vietnam's climate is tropical, with two main seasons: a hot and humid summer, and a cooler winter. The north experiences a more temperate climate, while the south is generally warmer and more humid.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Noi Bai Airport, our driver will greet you and transfer you to your hotel in the city center. Spend the morning relaxing and rejuvenating after your journey.In the afternoon, delve into Hanoi's rich history and culture with a visit to Ba Dinh Square, the heart of the city's cultural and political life. Take a moment to photograph the iconic Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from the outside.Next, explore the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's oldest university, founded in 1070. Stroll through the serene gardens and admire the well-preserved architecture, a testament to the country's rich heritage.Take a leisurely walk around picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, home to temples, pagodas, and a popular spot for locals and visitors alike.Finally, wander through Hanoi's enchanting Old Quarter, a maze of narrow alleys and traditional shophouses. Discover the unique charm of 'The 36 Streets,' where each street is named after its traditional trade.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Hanoi, ready to continue your Vietnamese adventure tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description: Depart Hanoi for Ha Long Bay, a stunning Natural World Heritage Site recognized by UNESCO. Upon arrival at the Cruise Port, receive a warm welcome from the cruise staff and check-in for your overnight cruise.Embark on a journey to discover the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay, characterized by thousands of limestone rocks and karst grottoes. Savor a delicious lunch on board, then explore the bay's hidden gems, including ancient grottos, pristine beaches, and floating villages.Enjoy swimming, kayaking, or simply taking in the majestic scenery. Later, return to the cruise for a cooking demonstration, followed by a delightful dinner.Spend the evening at leisure, relaxing on board or participating in activities.
additionalInfo: Overnight on the cruise, surrounded by the tranquil beauty of Ha Long Bay.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Rise early to witness the breathtaking dawn over Ha Long Bay, as the sun rises over the emerald waters and limestone islets. Enjoy a delicious breakfast on board, then continue cruising through the bay's stunning landscapes.Discover the uniquely shaped islets, each with its own name, such as Sail Island, Fisherman's Head Rock, and Turtle Islet. Check out of your cabin and savor a leisurely brunch on board as the cruise returns to the pier.Disembark and transfer back to Hanoi, where you'll check-in to your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing or exploring the city.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Hanoi
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure until checkout time. Our driver will then transfer you to Noi Bai Airport for your departure flight, marking the end of your memorable journey in Vietnam.
