name: Paris to Vienna
metaTitle: Paris to Vienna Tour Package | Paris, Munich & Vienna with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience Europe from Paris to Vienna with Duniya Dekho. Explore Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Munich's Marienplatz, Schönbrunn Palace, Danube River cruise, and rich European culture.
description: Embark on a thrilling journey through four captivating European cities, each steeped in history, culture, and natural beauty. Explore the City of Light, Paris, with its iconic landmarks and romantic atmosphere. Discover the charming Swiss town of Lucerne, nestled between mountains and lakes. Visit Innsbruck, the capital of Austria's Tyrol region, surrounded by breathtaking Alpine scenery. Finally, immerse yourself in the grandeur and elegance of Vienna, Austria's capital city.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: The countries visited on this tour, France, Switzerland, and Austria, offer diverse geography and climate. France, famous for its romantic landscapes, boasts a varied geography, from the snow-capped Alps in the east to the sun-kissed Mediterranean beaches in the south. Switzerland, known for its breathtaking mountains, is home to the Swiss Alps, which cover nearly two-thirds of its territory. Austria, landlocked and located in Central Europe, is characterized by its picturesque Alpine landscapes, rolling hills, and vast forests. The climate varies greatly depending on the region, with cold winters and warm summers in the north, and Mediterranean-like conditions in the south. Overall, the unique geography and climate of these countries make them a paradise for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Arrival in the City of Light
itinerary.description: Bonjour! Welcome to Paris, the enchanting French capital that has captivated hearts for centuries. Upon arrival at the airport, enjoy a hassle-free transfer to your hotel, where you'll begin your Parisian adventure.
additionalInfo: Spend the day immersed in the city's timeless charm. Stroll along the iconic Champs-Élysées, lined with haute couture boutiques, art galleries, and theaters. Alternatively, explore the historic Montmartre neighborhood, famous for its bohemian vibe, street artists, and stunning views of the city.

As the day unfolds, take a leisurely walk along the picturesque Seine River, admiring the city's majestic landmarks, bridges, and historic buildings. Indulge in France's renowned cuisine at a classic bistro or Michelin-starred restaurant, and toast to your arrival in the City of Light.
Overnight at the hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Discover the Timeless Charm of Paris
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a captivating 4-hour coach tour of Paris, exploring the city's iconic landmarks, historic neighborhoods, and picturesque streets. Your expert guide will regale you with fascinating stories and anecdotes about the city's rich history, art, and culture.
additionalInfo: Next, enjoy a relaxing 1-hour Seine River cruise, admiring the city's majestic architecture, bridges, and historic buildings from a unique perspective. You'll see iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Louvre Museum.

The highlight of your day is a visit to the Eiffel Tower, where you'll ascend to the second floor for breathtaking panoramic views of the city. Take in the stunning vistas, snap photos, and enjoy the thrill of being in one of the world's most iconic landmarks.

Moulin Rouge: Enjoy a spectacular evening at the world-famous Moulin Rouge, featuring dazzling dance performances, stunning costumes, and music.Louvre Museum: Visit the world-renowned Louvre Museum, home to an impressive collection of art and artifacts, including the Mona Lisa. Paris Montmartre Food Tour: Embark on a culinary adventure through the charming Montmartre neighborhood, sampling local delicacies, wines, and cheeses.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your Parisian adventure.
Overnight at the hotel in Paris.

itinerary.title: Journey to Lucerne, Switzerland
itinerary.description: Bid adieu to Paris and embark on a new adventure in Switzerland! After checking out of your hotel, board the train to Basel or Zurich, marking the beginning of your Swiss escapade.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival in Switzerland, take advantage of your Swiss Travel Pass, which grants you unlimited access to the Swiss Travel System. Enjoy seamless travel on trains, boats, trams, and buses, exploring the country's breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities.

Utilize your Pass to continue your journey to Lucerne, a charming Swiss town nestled between mountains and lakes. Transfer to your hotel and check-in, then spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Lucerne's picturesque Old Town, scenic lakefront, and iconic landmarks like the Chapel Bridge.
Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis and Lake Lucerne Adventure
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a thrilling alpine adventure to Mount Titlis, utilizing your Swiss Travel Pass for a seamless journey. As you ascend to the summit, marvel at the breathtaking vistas of the surrounding mountains and valleys.
additionalInfo: Experience the ultimate snow adventure at Mount Titlis, where you can engage in various snow activities, such as snow tubing, sledding, or simply playing in the snow. Take a ride on the revolving Titlis Rotair gondola, which offers stunning 360-degree views of the alpine landscape.

In the afternoon, unwind with a relaxing cruise on Lake Lucerne, enjoying the serene waters and picturesque surroundings. Admire the stunning scenery, charming villages, and majestic mountains that surround the lake.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your Mount Titlis and Lake Lucerne adventure.
Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Explore Switzerland at Leisure
itinerary.description: Today, enjoy the freedom to explore Switzerland's breathtaking landscapes at your own pace, utilizing your Swiss Travel Pass for unlimited travel on trains, buses, and boats.
additionalInfo: Consider visiting the picturesque towns of Grindelwald and Interlaken, nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps. Marvel at the stunning scenery, towering mountains, and serene lakes that surround these charming towns.

Grindelwald First: Take a day trip to Grindelwald First, a mountain resort offering panoramic views of the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau mountains. Choose any two activities from the following options: First Cliff Walk: A thrilling walkway with breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. First Glider: A scenic glider ride offering stunning views of the Alps. First Mountain Cart: A fun and exhilarating ride down the mountain on a specially designed cart.
Return to your hotel in Lucerne in the evening, filled with wonderful memories of your Swiss adventure.
Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Innsbruck, Austria
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Lucerne and depart via train, utilizing your Swiss Travel Pass for a seamless journey. Travel through Zurich and continue onwards to Innsbruck, nestled in the heart of Tyrol, Austria.
additionalInfo: As you arrive in Innsbruck, be mesmerized by the stunning Alpine vistas that surround this charming city. Innsbruck boasts a rich Austrian heritage, evident in its historic architecture, cultural landmarks, and traditional cuisine.

Spend the rest of the day exploring Innsbruck's picturesque Old Town, visiting iconic landmarks like the Golden Roof and the Nordkette mountains. Enjoy the unique blend of Austrian and Italian influences that make Innsbruck a fascinating destination.
Overnight at the hotel in Innsbruck.

itinerary.title: Discover the Magic of Swarovski Crystal World
itinerary.description: Today, immerse yourself in the dazzling world of crystals at the Swarovski Crystal World, conveniently accessible via a shuttle bus. This iconic attraction is a must-visit for anyone fascinated by sparkle and shine.
additionalInfo: As you step into the Crystal World, be mesmerized by the stunning displays of crystal art, intricate designs, and innovative installations. Explore the vast crystal collections, and discover the fascinating history and craftsmanship behind Swarovski's iconic crystals.

Nordkette Mountain Adventure: Take a cable car ride to the Nordkette mountains, offering breathtaking 360-degree views of Innsbruck and the surrounding Alps. Enjoy thrilling hiking trails, scenic viewpoints, and picturesque villages.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with the sparkle and wonder of the Swarovski Crystal World.
Overnight at the hotel in Innsbruck.

itinerary.title: Innsbruck to Vienna, the City of Music
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to the picturesque town of Innsbruck and embark on a scenic train journey to Vienna, the former imperial capital of Austria. As you travel through the rolling hills and picturesque villages of the Austrian countryside, get ready to be enchanted by the grandeur and elegance of Vienna.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, immerse yourself in Vienna's rich cultural heritage, steeped in imperial history and musical legacy. Explore the city's iconic landmarks, such as the Schönbrunn Palace, St. Stephen's Cathedral, and the Hofburg Palace. Discover the city's vibrant music scene, which has inspired some of the world's greatest composers, including Mozart, Beethoven, and Strauss.

Upon arrival, immerse yourself in Vienna's rich cultural heritage, steeped in imperial history and musical legacy. Explore the city's iconic landmarks, such as the Schönbrunn Palace, St. Stephen's Cathedral, and the Hofburg Palace. Discover the city's vibrant music scene, which has inspired some of the world's greatest composers, including Mozart, Beethoven, and Strauss.
Overnight at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Vienna's Grand Landmarks and Schönbrunn Palace
itinerary.description: Today, embark on a comprehensive 3.5-hour guided tour of Vienna's iconic landmarks, exploring the city's rich history, architecture, and culture. Board a comfortable coach and travel along the famous Ringstrasse, a grand boulevard that encircles the city center.
additionalInfo: State Opera: A world-renowned opera house and one of the busiest in the world.Hofburg Palace: The former principal imperial palace of the Habsburg dynasty rulers.Parliament: The seat of the Austrian Parliament, featuring a stunning Greek Revival-style building.City Hall: A magnificent Gothic Revival-style building that serves as the seat of the Vienna City Council.

Next, visit the breathtaking Schönbrunn Palace, a former imperial summer residence and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the palace's opulent historic rooms, stroll through the picturesque gardens, and discover the fascinating history of the Habsburg dynasty.
Conclude your tour at the Vienna State Opera, one of the world's most famous opera houses.
Overnight at the hotel in Vienna.

itinerary.title: Departure from Vienna
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Vienna and the enchanting memories of your European adventure. Enjoy a convenient private transfer from your hotel to Vienna International Airport, marking the conclusion of this captivating 10-day journey through Paris, Switzerland, and Austria.
additionalInfo: As you depart, reflect on the breathtaking landscapes, iconic landmarks, and rich cultural heritage you've experienced. From the City of Light to the Swiss Alps and Austria's grand cities, this tour has been a treasure trove of unforgettable moments.
Safe travels, and we hope to welcome you on another adventure soon!

name: Magic of Bhutan
metaTitle: Bhutan Tour Package | Thimphu, Paro & Punakha with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Bhutan with Duniya Dekho. Visit Thimphu, Paro and Punakha with monasteries, fortresses, scenic valleys and rich culture in the Land of Happiness.
description: Experience the mystical kingdom of Bhutan, a land of breathtaking beauty, pristine culture, and warm hospitality, as you journey through the charming cities of Thimphu and Paro. Visit Thimphu's majestic Tashichho Dzong and National Memorial Chorten, and wander through its vibrant streets, discovering local markets and handmade crafts. In Paro, marvel at the breathtaking Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest Monastery) and ancient Paro Dzong, and stroll through the charming streets, soaking up the local culture and cuisine, in this unforgettable adventure to the hidden kingdom of Bhutan.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Bhutan, a small country nestled in the Himalayas, boasts a diverse geography with towering mountains, lush forests, and picturesque valleys. The country's climate varies greatly depending on the altitude, with subtropical temperatures in the south and cold, snowy winters in the north. The four distinct seasons bring different experiences, from the rhododendron blooms of spring to the warm summers, harvest-filled autumns, and serene winters, making Bhutan a year-round destination for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhutan and Transfer to Thimphu
itinerary.description: Experience one of the most breathtaking flights in the world as you soar into the Himalayas. From the left side of the plane, witness the majestic peaks of the world's highest mountains, with your pilot pointing out notable landmarks.
additionalInfo: As you descend into the mountains, take in the stunning views of the Paro Valley, with its lush alpine forests, quaint monasteries, temples, and traditional farmhouses. Catch a glimpse of the picturesque Paro Dzong and the meandering Paro Chu river before landing at Paro International Airport.

Upon arrival, our representative will greet you and assist with your transfer to Thimphu, the capital city of Bhutan. Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city or relaxing in your hotel.
Overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu City Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on a full-day city tour of Thimphu, exploring its rich culture, history, and natural beauty.
additionalInfo: Visit the iconic National Memorial Chorten, a stupa dedicated to the third king of Bhutan, and marvel at the impressive Buddha statue. Next, stop at the Motithang Takin Preserve (Akin Zoo), home to the national animal of Bhutan, the takin.
Drive downhill and pause at the junction to admire the majestic Trashichho Dzong, a stunning fortress monastery that serves as the seat of the government.

Continue to the National Library, which houses a vast collection of ancient Buddhist texts and manuscripts, and the Folk Heritage Museum, showcasing the traditional Bhutanese way of life.Continue to the National Library, which houses a vast collection of ancient Buddhist texts and manuscripts, and the Folk Heritage Museum, showcasing the traditional Bhutanese way of life.
In the afternoon, take a leisurely stroll to the Handicraft Bazaar, where you can witness artisans at work and shop for traditional handicrafts.
Spend the late afternoon at leisure, exploring the city's main streets, shopping for souvenirs, or simply relaxing in a local café.
Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy an overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Paro and City Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Paro and check-in to your hotel upon arrival. Embark on a half-day city tour, exploring Paro's iconic landmarks and rich cultural heritage.
additionalInfo: Visit the majestic Paro Dzong, a fortress monastery that dates back to the 17th century. Next, explore the National Museum, housed in the round fortress of Ta Dzong, which showcases a fine collection of natural and historic artifacts.

Discover the ancient Kyichu Lhakhang, one of the oldest and most sacred monasteries in Bhutan, dating back to the 7th century. Later, visit the Paro Penlop Heritage Farmhouse, which offers a glimpse into traditional Bhutanese farming practices.

Explore the ruins of Drukgyel Dzong, a 17th-century fortress that once protected the kingdom from Tibetan invaders. End the day with a visit to the base of the iconic Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery, one of the most revered spiritual sites in Bhutan.
Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Paro's charming town, shopping for souvenirs, or simply relaxing in a local café.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Paro.

itinerary.title: Departure from Paro
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, bid farewell to the enchanting kingdom of Bhutan as you transfer to Paro International Airport for your onward flight, bringing back memories of your unforgettable journey.

name: Turkish Delight
metaTitle: Turkish Delight Tour Package | Explore Turkey with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Turkey with Duniya Dekho. Discover Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and other iconic destinations with rich culture, stunning landscapes, and historical landmarks.
description: Embark on an unforgettable 5-day journey through Turkey, exploring the vibrant cities, ancient ruins, and breathtaking landscapes of this incredible country.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Turkey is a transcontinental country with a diverse geography, featuring mountains, coastlines, and islands. Its climate varies greatly depending on the region, with Mediterranean, continental, oceanic, and mountainous climates.The country experiences hot summers, cold winters, and mild spring and autumn seasons. With its unique geography and climate, Turkey is a year-round destination, offering a range of experiences and activities for visitors.

itinerary.title: Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Istanbul Airport, where you'll be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. After checking-in, spend the rest of the day exploring this vibrant city at your own pace.Discover the bustling streets, historic landmarks, and vibrant markets of Istanbul. Get a taste of the local cuisine, visit the famous Taksim Square, or take a stroll along the Bosphorus Strait.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Istanbul

itinerary.title: Istanbul Classical City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a comprehensive Full Day Istanbul Classical City tour, exploring the iconic landmarks and historic treasures of this ancient city.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Blue Mosque: Marvel at the stunning architecture and beautiful blue tiles of this magnificent mosque.
Hippodrome: Explore the ancient heart of Istanbul's sporting and social life.
St Sophia Museum: Discover the rich history and stunning architecture of this former Byzantine church and Ottoman mosque.
Topkapi Palace: Uncover the secrets of the Ottoman Empire's primary residence, featuring stunning gardens, kitchens, and treasure houses.
Grand Bazaar: Get lost in the vibrant stalls and shops of one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Istanbul's classical treasures.
Overnight at the hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Fly to Izmir and Arrive in Kusadasi
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to Istanbul and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your domestic flight to Izmir.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival at Izmir Airport, transfer to your hotel in Kusadasi, a charming coastal town on the Aegean coast.

Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Kusadasi's picturesque streets, vibrant markets, and stunning beaches. You can also visit the nearby ancient city of Ephesus or take a relaxing stroll along the marina.
Overnight at the hotel in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Explore Ephesus and its Ancient Wonders
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a fascinating Full Day Kusadasi tour, exploring the ancient ruins and historical landmarks of the region.Tour Highlights:
additionalInfo: Ephesus Ruins: Walk through the ancient streets of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved archaeological sites in Turkey, featuring the impressive Library of Celsus, the Great Theatre, and the Temple of Hadrian.
Artemis Temple: Visit the remains of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
Virgin Mary Church: Explore the historic church where the Virgin Mary is believed to have spent her final days.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Ephesus and its ancient wonders.
Overnight at the hotel in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Kusadasi and proceed to Izmir Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your wonderful Turkish adventure.
additionalInfo: We hope you had a fantastic time exploring the ancient ruins, vibrant cities, and stunning landscapes of Turkey!
Safe travels, and we look forward to welcoming you on another journey soon!

name: Swiss Bliss: Interlaken & Lucerne Getaway
metaTitle: Swiss Bliss Tour Package | Interlaken, Lucerne & Paris with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the charm of Switzerland and Paris with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy scenic Swiss landscapes, Mt. Titlis, Jungfraujoch, Lucerne Lake Cruise, Paris City Tour, Eiffel Tower, and unforgettable experiences.
description: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Switzerland on our 4 nights 5 days travel itinerary, exploring the picturesque towns of Interlaken and Lucerne.In Interlaken, surrounded by majestic mountains and serene lakes, enjoy a range of outdoor activities such as hiking, paragliding, or take a scenic boat tour on Lake Thun or Lake Brienz. Visit the top of Schilthorn Mountain for breathtaking views of the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau mountains.In Lucerne, discover the city's charming old town, picturesque Chapel Bridge, and stunning Lion Monument. Take a scenic cruise on Lake Lucerne, surrounded by majestic mountains and lush greenery. Visit the nearby Mount Pilatus, with its breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape.Our Switzerland itinerary offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, outdoor adventure, and cultural exploration, making it an unforgettable experience for travelers. Join us on this incredible journey and discover the beauty, charm, and magic of Switzerland!

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Switzerland's geography is diverse, with the Swiss Alps covering 60% of the country, numerous lakes, and rolling hills. The climate varies greatly depending on the region, with cold winters and cool summers in the mountains, and mild winters and warm summers in the plateaus and lakeside regions. The country experiences four distinct seasons, with cold winters, mild springs, warm summers, and cool autumns.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & Journey to Interlaken
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Airport and complete the immigration and baggage claim formalities. Next, take a train from the airport's train station to Interlaken, a stunning Swiss town nestled between two lakes. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and freshen up. The rest of the day is yours to unwind and soak in the breathtaking scenery.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe Excursion
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, then embark on an unforgettable journey to Jungfraujoch, the 'Top of Europe'. From Interlaken Ost, take a scenic train ride via Grindelwald or Wengen to Kleine Scheidegg, nestled at the foot of the iconic Eiger North Wall. The Jungfrau Railway, a marvel of engineering, whisks you away to the highest railway station in Europe, Jungfraujoch (3454m/11,333ft). Be awestruck by the breathtaking panorama of the Aletsch Glacier, the longest glacier in the Alps.
additionalInfo: Return to Interlaken and overnight at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Interlaken to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Following breakfast, check-out of the hotel and head to the train station to board your train to Lucerne. Enjoy a scenic journey across the breathtaking Brünig Pass, taking in the picturesque landscapes. Upon arrival in Lucerne, make your way to your hotel and check-in. Spend the rest of the day exploring this charming Swiss city at your own pace, discovering its hidden gems and iconic landmarks.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis Excursion – Glacier Adventures & Cliff Walk
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, ensue on an excursion to Mount Titlis – at 3020 m / 10’000 ft. Make your own way to Lucerne train station to board the train to the mountain monastery village Engelberg where you board a gondola that takes you up to the Trübsee. Continue your trip by the next gondola to Stand and finally the first revolving cable car Titlis Rotair that takes you up to Mount Titlis. For a spectacular, close-up insight into a glacier, visit the glacier cave and ride the Ice Flyer chairlift (optional). Get your thrills on the TITLIS Cliff Walk, a spectacular Suspension bridge at a height of 3041 m/10’000 ft.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, make your own way to the train station to board your train to Zurich airport. On arrival at the airport board your flight back home.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lucerne.

name: Sri Lanka Discovery
metaTitle: Sri Lanka Discovery Tour Package | Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala & Colombo
metaDescription: Explore Sri Lanka’s cultural, natural, and wildlife wonders. Visit Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Yala National Park, and Colombo with unforgettable experiences and warm Sri Lankan hospitality.
description: Explore Sri Lanka's cultural, natural, and wildlife wonders on this 4-night, 5-day adventure. Discover Kandy's ancient temples, Nuwara Eliya's stunning landscapes, and Yala's majestic wildlife.Experience the warmth of Sri Lankan hospitality, rich heritage, and breathtaking beauty. From scenic drives to wildlife encounters, and cultural immersion to modern delights, this journey promises lifelong memories.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Sri Lanka, an island nation in South Asia, boasts a diverse geography, with lush rainforests, towering mountains, and pristine beaches. The country's terrain is dominated by the Central Highlands, with peaks like Adam's Peak and Kirigalpoththa. The climate is tropical, with three main seasons: hot and dry (December to April), monsoon (May to September), and cool and dry (October to November). The north-east monsoon brings significant rainfall, while the south-west monsoon affects the western coast. Temperatures range from 22°C to 32°C (72°F to 90°F) throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Kandy Adventure
itinerary.description:
Upon arrival at Colombo International Airport, our representative will greet and escort you to your air-conditioned vehicle. Begin your Sri Lankan journey with a scenic drive to Kandy.

En route, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a haven for over 100 rescued elephants. Get up close and personal with these gentle giants, a truly unforgettable experience.

Next, stop by a Spice Garden, showcasing Sri Lanka's world-renowned spices and healing herbs. Explore the lush gardens, discovering an array of herbs, including Sandalwood, Margosa, and Citronella.

Arrive in Kandy, check-in to your hotel, and relax.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description:
Start the day exploring Kandy's city sights, including the picturesque Upper Lake Drive, vibrant Market Crafts Centre, and fascinating Gem Museum.

Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens in Peradeniya, a 147-acre haven of lush greenery and exotic flora. Established in 1374, this majestic garden was once a pleasure retreat for the Kings of Gampola and Kandy.

Next, proceed to Nuwara Eliya, stopping en route at the Sri Bhaktha Hanuman Temple. According to legend, this sacred site marks the spot where Hanuman searched for Sita.

In the evening, discover the charm of Nuwara Eliya, a highland city that was once a favorite holiday resort of the British. Stroll through Queen Victoria Park, and enjoy the serene shores of Lake Gregory.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya to Yala
itinerary.description:
Begin the day with a visit to the Seetha Amman Temple, a sacred site believed to be where Sita bathed during her exile. Discover the stream that catered to her needs and see the idols discovered in the stream, including one of Sita.

En route to Yala, experience the thrill of the Flying Ravana Zip Line and marvel at the breathtaking Ravana Waterfalls in Ella.

In the afternoon, venture into Yala National Park, Sri Lanka's most visited and second-largest national park. Embark on a wildlife safari adventure, spotting majestic creatures in their natural habitat.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Yala.

itinerary.title: Yala to Colombo
itinerary.description:
Embark on a city tour of Colombo, exploring its vibrant commercial areas, tree-lined residential neighborhoods, and historic landmarks like the Fort, a former British administrative center.

Visit the bustling Sea Street and Cinnamon Gardens, and experience the city's diverse culture and architecture.

In the evening, indulge in a shopping spree in Colombo, and stroll along the scenic Galle Face Green, a popular spot for locals and tourists alike.

Later, experience Colombo's nightlife, with a visit to a casino (drop-off only).
additionalInfo: Overnight in Colombo.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description:
Bid farewell to Sri Lanka as your memorable journey comes to an end. Spend the morning at leisure, relaxing at the hotel or exploring Colombo's nearby attractions.

Later, you'll be escorted to the airport for your departure flight, carrying cherished memories of your Sri Lankan adventure.

metaDescription: Explore the best of Sri Lanka with Duniya Dekho. Visit Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Bentota, and Colombo while experiencing stunning landscapes, cultural heritage, and tropical beaches.

Experience the vibrant city's rich history, art, and architecture.Next, travel to Nuwara Eliya, the 'Little England' of Sri Lanka, and explore its picturesque landscapes, lush tea plantations, and colonial architecture.Then, head to Bentota, a tropical paradise on the west coast, and relax on its stunning beaches, take a scenic boat ride on the Bentota River, and indulge in water sports.Finally, end your journey in Colombo, the commercial capital, and discover its rich history, vibrant markets, and modern architecture.Our Sri Lanka itinerary offers a unique blend of culture, nature, and adventure, making it an unforgettable experience for travelers.

additionalInfo.description: Sri Lanka, an island nation in South Asia, boasts a diverse geography, with lush rainforests, towering mountains, and pristine beaches. The country's terrain is dominated by the Central Highlands, with peaks like Adam's Peak and Kirigalpoththa. The climate is tropical, with three main seasons: hot and dry (December to April), monsoon (May to September), and cool and dry (October to November). The north-east monsoon brings significant rainfall, while the south-west monsoon affects the western coast. Temperatures range from 22°C to 32°C (72°F to 90°F) throughout the year.

itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Colombo International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted and escorted to your air-conditioned vehicle. Begin your Sri Lankan adventure with a scenic drive to Kandy, the cultural heart of the island.En route, discover two unique attractions:
additionalInfo: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage: Get up close and personal with over 100 rescued elephant orphans, and experience the joy of interacting with these gentle giants.
Spice Garden: Explore the aromatic world of Sri Lankan spices and herbs, featuring an array of plants like Sandalwood, Margosa, and Coconut.
After a day filled with wonder and discovery, arrive in Kandy and check-in to your hotel. Relax and unwind, ready to take on the next day's adventures. Overnight in Kandy.

itinerary.title: Kandy City Tour & Nuwara Eliya Adventure
itinerary.description: Immerse yourself in Kandy's rich history and culture with a city tour, featuring:
additionalInfo: Upper Lake Drive: Enjoy scenic views of Kandy Lake
Market Crafts Centre: Discover local artisans and handicrafts
Gem Museum: Marvel at Sri Lanka's stunning gemstones
Visit the Royal Botanical Gardens, Peradeniya, a 147-acre oasis of tropical plants and flowers.Next, journey to Nuwara Eliya, stopping en route at:
Sri Bhaktha Hanuman Temple: Explore the legendary site where Hanuman searched for Sita.
Seetha Amman Temple: Visit the sacred temple and 'Sita Tear Pond'
In the evening, discover Nuwara Eliya's charm, with its colonial architecture, scenic views, and crisp mountain air. Check-in to your hotel and relax. Overnight in Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls & White Water Rafting Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling journey to Bentota, with a series of breathtaking stops along the way. Witness the majestic Devon Waterfalls and St Clair Waterfalls, surrounded by lush tropical landscapes that will leave you mesmerized.Next, visit Kitulgala, a haven for adventure seekers, where you'll have the opportunity to experience the rush of White Water Rafting (optional). Feel the adrenaline rush as you navigate the rapids, or simply enjoy the scenic views and tranquil atmosphere.After an action-packed day, arrive in Bentota and check-in to your hotel. Unwind and relax, ready to take on the next day's adventures.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Bentota.

itinerary.title: Madu River Boat Safari & Sea Turtle Conservation
itinerary.description: Embark on a leisurely boat safari along the serene Madu River in Balapitiya. This tranquil cruise offers a glimpse into the region's unique ecosystem, with stops at:
additionalInfo: Cinnamon Islands: Learn about the traditional cinnamon harvesting process
Fish Therapy: Experience the unusual sensation of fish pedicure
Bird Watching: Spot a variety of bird species in their natural habitat.

Next, visit the Kosgoda Sea Turtle Hatchery, a conservation project dedicated to protecting these majestic creatures. Learn about the hatchery's efforts to increase the number of hatchlings reaching adulthood and explore the facility.
After a day filled with nature and conservation, return to your hotel in Bentota and relax. Overnight in Bentota.

Visit:Cinnamon Gardens: Admire the picturesque tree-lined streets and colonial architectureFort: Discover the former British administrative centre and military garrison Sea Street: Explore the bustling commercial hub.In the evening, indulge in a shopping spree in Colombo's popular markets and malls. Stroll along the scenic Galle Face Green, a 5-hectare oceanfront promenade that's perfect for sunset views.As night falls, experience Colombo's vibrant nightlife with a visit to a popular casino (drop-off only). Enjoy the city's energetic atmosphere, live music, and exciting entertainment options. Check-in to your hotel and unwind.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Colombo.

Spend the morning at leisure, relaxing at the hotel or exploring Colombo's nearby attractions.Later, you'll be escorted to the Bandaranaike International Airport for your departure flight, carrying memories of Sri Lanka's stunning landscapes, rich culture, and warm hospitality.

name: Australian Dream
metaTitle: Australian Dream 12 Nights 13 Days Tour Package
metaDescription: Experience the ultimate Australian adventure, exploring the country's diverse landscapes and vibrant cities.
description: Experience the ultimate Australian adventure, exploring the country's diverse landscapes and vibrant cities. Begin in Melbourne, the cultural capital, where world-class restaurants, museums, and theaters await. Next, head to Cairns, the gateway to the breathtaking Great Barrier Reef and the lush Daintree Rainforest. Then, discover Sydney's iconic landmarks, such as the Opera House and Harbour Bridge, and soak up the sun on Bondi Beach. Finally, visit Adelaide, the food and wine capital, surrounded by picturesque vineyards and boasting a rich cultural heritage, with its elegant architecture and vibrant arts scene.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Australia, the world's sixth-largest country, boasts a diverse geography, ranging from the red sands of the Outback to the lush rainforests of the north and the snow-capped mountains of the southeast. The country's climate varies greatly, from tropical in the north to temperate in the south, with the central desert region experiencing extreme temperatures and low humidity. The northern states, including Queensland and the Northern Territory, have a wet and dry season, while the southern states, such as New South Wales and Victoria, have a more moderate climate with four distinct seasons.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Melbourne
itinerary.description: Arrive at Melbourne Tullamarine Airport and transfer to your hotel. Check-in to your hotel and freshen up. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Melbourne's vibrant cityscape, cultural attractions, and culinary delights on your own.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Melbourne City Tour and Sky Deck
itinerary.description: Start the day with a self-guided city tour of Melbourne, using the city's iconic tram system. Explore the city's famous landmarks, including Queen Victoria Market, Fitzroy Garden, Albert Park, Federation Square, Shrine of Remembrance, and Southbank Waterfront Precinct. Make a photo stop at the legendary Melbourne Cricket Ground. Later, head to the Melbourne Sky Deck Tower, where you'll enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city (entrance fees included).
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Great Ocean Road Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a thrilling full-day excursion to the iconic Great Ocean Road, renowned for its breathtaking coastal scenery. Witness the majestic 12 Apostles limestone stacks, a testament to the relentless power of the sea. Explore the picturesque Loch Ard Gorge, a tranquil haven surrounded by towering cliffs and crystal-clear waters. Return to Melbourne in the evening, with memories of the day's stunning coastal vistas.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Melbourne.

itinerary.title: Melbourne to Cairns
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Melbourne and depart for Cairns, the tropical gateway to the Great Barrier Reef. Check out of your hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairns. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing in the tropical surroundings.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Cairns.

itinerary.title: Kuranda Scenic Railway and Skyrail Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on a captivating full-day excursion to Kuranda, a charming village nestled in the heart of the tropical rainforest. Experience the thrill of riding the historic Kuranda Scenic Railway, which winds its way through tunnels and over bridges, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. Return to Cairns on the Skyrail Rainforest Cableway, gliding above the treetops and taking in the stunning vistas of the Coral Sea.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Cairns.

itinerary.title: Green Island and Great Barrier Reef Adventure
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the vibrant Green Island, a stunning coral cay situated on the Great Barrier Reef. Take a semi-submersible tour to discover the reef's incredible marine life, without getting wet. Enjoy a leisurely day on the island, relaxing on the beach, snorkeling, or exploring the lush rainforest. With a range of activities to choose from, create your own perfect day on this tropical paradise.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Cairns.

itinerary.title: Cairns to Sydney
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Cairns and depart for Sydney, the iconic Australian city. Check out of your hotel and transfer to the Cairns airport for your flight to Sydney. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check-in. Spend the rest of the day exploring Sydney's vibrant streets, taking in the stunning harbor views, and discovering the city's world-class attractions at your own pace.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney City Tour and Attractions
itinerary.description:
Embark on a comprehensive Hop-on Hop-off tour of Sydney, exploring the city's iconic landmarks and neighborhoods, including Bondi Beach, Harbour Bridge, Darling Harbour, The Rocks, King's Cross, Chinatown, and the Sydney Opera House.

Later, visit the Sea Life Aquarium at Darling Harbour, where you'll exchange your 2-combo pass voucher for admission to the aquarium and the Sydney Tower Eye with a 4D experience.

In the evening, enjoy a relaxing 1-hour Sydney Harbour Cruise, taking in the stunning views of the city skyline.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Blue Mountains Adventure
itinerary.description:
Embark on a thrilling excursion to the breathtaking Blue Mountains, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Spanning over one million hectares, this natural wonderland boasts an diverse landscape of rainforests, canyons, tall forests, and heathlands.

Visit a wildlife sanctuary, where you'll encounter koalas and kangaroos up close. End the day with a scenic boat ride, taking in the majestic views of the surrounding mountains. Return to your hotel in Sydney, bringing back memories of the day's adventure.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Sydney.

itinerary.title: Sydney to Adelaide
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Sydney and depart for Adelaide, the vibrant capital of South Australia. Transfer to Sydney Airport for your flight to Adelaide. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the city's charming streets, cultural attractions, and scenic parks.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Kangaroo Island Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on an exciting day trip to Kangaroo Island, renowned for its stunning natural beauty and diverse wildlife. Visit the Kangaroo Island Wildlife Park, where you'll have the unique opportunity to feed kangaroos and get up close to adorable koalas. Listen to the park keeper's insightful talk about these amazing animals and take advantage of the photo opportunity to hold a koala (optional, additional cost). As you return to Penneshaw for your ferry and coach transfer back to Adelaide, keep an eye out for more kangaroos and wallabies in their natural habitat.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your respected hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Barossa Valley Wine Tour
itinerary.description:
Indulge in the rich flavors of South Australia's renowned Barossa Valley wine region. Visit Pindarie Cellar Door, where you'll sample some of the finest wines the region has to offer. Savor a delicious 2-course gourmet lunch, carefully crafted to showcase the region's culinary delights.

Later, head to the Barossa Valley Chocolate Company in Tanunda, where you'll discover the perfect pairing of rich chocolates and fine wines. Treat your taste buds to a decadent experience, as you sample expertly paired chocolates and wines. Return to Adelaide in the evening, with memories of the day's epicurean adventure.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Adelaide.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Adelaide and Australia as you check out of your hotel and transfer to the airport for your onward flight. Reflect on the unforgettable experiences and memories you've made during your journey, from the scenic landscapes to the vibrant cities and unique wildlife. Safe travels home or to your next destination!

name: Cape Town and Sun City Adventure
metaTitle: Cape Town & Sun City Tour Package | South Africa with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Cape Town and Sun City with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy scenic landscapes, iconic attractions, and unforgettable South African experiences.
description: Discover the vibrant spirit of South Africa on this 5-day adventure. Begin in stunning Cape Town, where you'll spend three nights exploring the city's iconic landmarks, such as Table Mountain and Cape of Good Hope. Take in the breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean, visit the vibrant Bo-Kaap neighborhood, and sample some of the world's best wines in the nearby Winelands. Then, head to Sun City, a luxury resort nestled in the heart of the Pilanesberg Game Reserve, where you'll spend two nights surrounded by untamed African wilderness. Enjoy thrilling game drives, relax at the Valley of Waves, or try your luck at the casino – the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and luxury.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Located at the southern tip of Africa, South Africa boasts a diverse geography, with a range of ecosystems, from the majestic Table Mountain to the scenic Cape Winelands, and from the arid Karoo desert to the subtropical coastlines. The country's varied landscape is home to some of the world's most unique and breathtaking natural wonders, including the iconic Cape of Good Hope and the stunning Pilanesberg Game Reserve. South Africa's climate is equally diverse, with Mediterranean, subtropical, and desert climates all present. The western coast is generally cooler and wetter, while the eastern coast is warmer and more humid, with summer temperatures often reaching the mid-30s (°C) and winters ranging from mild to chilly.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cape Town
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cape Town International Airport, where you'll be warmly greeted by a representative. Enjoy a seamless transfer to your hotel, where you can freshen up and get settled. Spend the rest of the day exploring Cape Town at your own pace, discovering its vibrant culture, stunning natural beauty, and world-class attractions.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town City Tour & Table Mountain
itinerary.description: Embark on a half-day tour of Cape Town, exploring its iconic landmarks, rich history, and vibrant culture. Begin with a scenic drive to Table Mountain (weather permitting), taking in the breathtaking views of the city and Atlantic Ocean. Next, visit notable attractions such as the South African Museum, Company Gardens, Parliament buildings, Castle of Good Hope, and bustling Green Market Square. Wander through the colourful streets of Bo-Kaap, discovering its unique cultural heritage and admiring the picturesque homes.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Full Day Peninsula Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable full-day tour of the Cape Peninsula, showcasing the region's stunning natural beauty, diverse wildlife, and rich history. Visit the iconic Cape Point and Cape of Good Hope Nature Reserve, where the Indian and Atlantic Oceans converge. Witness the charming colony of African penguins at Boulders Beach and pass through picturesque towns like Simons Town and Kalk Bay, experiencing the local culture firsthand. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views from Chapman's Peak Drive and explore the Cape Point Nature Reserve, taking a funicular tour to the top. Additional highlights include visits to Simons Town, Boulders Beach Penguin Colony, and the beautiful Kirstenbosch Botanical Gardens.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cape Town.

itinerary.title: Cape Town to Sun City
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Cape Town and transfer to Cape Town International Airport for your flight to Johannesburg (flight not included). Upon arrival, transfer to the luxurious Sun City resort, nestled in the heart of the Pilanesberg Game Reserve. Check-in to your hotel and spend the day exploring the Sun City Cabanas resort at your leisure. Discover the resort's many attractions, including its stunning pools, beautiful gardens, and exciting entertainment options.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day in Sun City
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxing day at leisure in Sun City, free to explore and indulge in the resort's many attractions and activities. Take a thrilling game drive, try your luck at the casino, or simply unwind at the Valley of Waves. You can also treat yourself to a rejuvenating spa treatment, play a round of golf, or enjoy the resort's many dining and entertainment options.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Sun City.

itinerary.title: Departure from Johannesburg
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Sun City and transfer to O.R. Tambo International Airport for your departure flight, bringing back memories of your incredible South African adventure.

name: Dubai Delight
metaTitle: Dubai Tour Package | Explore Dubai with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the best of Dubai with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy city tours, desert safari, Dhow cruise, luxurious hotels, and unforgettable experiences.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the United Arab Emirates, where stunning landscapes, vibrant culture, and opulent luxury await. Our 5 Night 6 Days itinerary takes you on a thrilling adventure through Dubai and Abu Dhabi, showcasing the best of these two incredible cities.In Dubai, marvel at the majestic Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, and experience the stunning Dubai Fountain Show. Explore the iconic Palm Jumeirah, visit traditional souks, and indulge in thrilling desert safaris.

Next, journey to Abu Dhabi, the capital city of the UAE, where you'll discover a treasure trove of cultural and historical landmarks. Visit the breathtaking Sheikh Zayed Mosque, explore the iconic Louvre Abu Dhabi, and experience the thrilling rides and attractions of Ferrari World.Throughout your journey, enjoy luxurious accommodations, savour delicious cuisine, and take advantage of our expert guides and hassle-free transfers. Whether you're looking for adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, our Dubai and Abu Dhabi itinerary has something for everyone.

additionalInfo.name: Dubai Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Dubai is located on the southeastern coast of the Persian Gulf, in the United Arab Emirates. The city's terrain is flat and sandy, with some rocky areas. Dubai's climate is hot and humid, with very little rainfall. Summer temperatures often reach 45°C, while winters are mild, ranging from 15-25°C.

additionalInfo.name: Abu Dhabi
additionalInfo.description: Abu Dhabi is situated on an island in the Persian Gulf, off the central coast of the United Arab Emirates. The city's terrain is generally flat, with some sandy dunes and salt flats. Abu Dhabi's climate is also hot and humid, with very little rainfall. Summer temperatures often reach 45°C, while winters are mild, ranging from 15-25°C.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport, where our representative will greet and assist you with your transfer to the hotel. Check-in to your hotel and freshen up.
additionalInfo: In the evening, embark on a traditional Dhow Cruise along the Dubai Creek, while enjoying a delicious dinner and mesmerizing views of the city's skyline. Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a guided Dubai City Tour, exploring the city's iconic landmarks and attractions. Visit the Jumeirah Mosque, Dubai Museum, and the vibrant textile souks.
additionalInfo: The highlight of the day is a visit to the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building. Take a high-speed elevator to the observation deck on the 124th floor, offering breathtaking views of the city.
Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Spend the morning at leisure, relaxing at the hotel or exploring Dubai's shopping malls and attractions.
additionalInfo: In the evening, embark on an exhilarating Desert Safari adventure. Experience the thrill of dune bashing, watch the sunset over the dunes, and enjoy a delicious BBQ dinner at a Bedouin camp.
Overnight stay at the hotel

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi City Tour & Ferrari World
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Abu Dhabi, the capital city of the UAE. Visit the iconic Sheikh Zayed Mosque, a masterpiece of Islamic architecture, and the Abu Dhabi Corniche, a scenic waterfront area.
additionalInfo: Next, head to Ferrari World, the world's first Ferrari-themed amusement park. Experience the thrill of Formula Rossa, the world's fastest rollercoaster, and other adrenaline-pumping rides. Return to Dubai in the evening and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Shopping
itinerary.description: Spend the day at leisure, indulging in some last-minute shopping and exploring Dubai's world-class malls, such as the Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, or Ibn Battuta Mall.
additionalInfo: You can also opt to visit the Global Village, a cultural and entertainment park, or take a stroll along the Dubai Marina.
Overnight stay at the hotel

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Take a private transfer from Oviedo to Santiago de Compostela, a city renowned for its stunning cathedral and rich history. Arrive in this iconic city, a major pilgrimage site, and check-in to your hotel. The city's charming streets, historic landmarks, and vibrant atmosphere await your exploration.
additionalInfo: After breakfast, check-out from the hotel and transfer to Dubai International Airport for your onward flight, bringing back memories of your wonderful trip to Dubai and Abu Dhabi!

name: Istanbul & Antalya
metaTitle: Dubai Tour Package | Explore Dubai with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the best of Dubai with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy city tours, desert safari, Dhow cruise, luxurious hotels, and unforgettable experiences.
description: Uncover the treasures of Turkey! From the bustling streets of Istanbul to the sun-kissed beaches of Antalya, this journey offers a unique blend of culture, adventure, and relaxation.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Turkey is a transcontinental country with a diverse geography, featuring mountains, coastlines, and islands. Its climate varies greatly depending on the region, ranging from Mediterranean to continental, oceanic, and mountainous. The country's geography and location influence its climate, making it a unique and diverse land.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Arrive at Istanbul Airport, where the vibrant energy of this ancient city awaits. Transfer to your hotel, check-in, and freshen up. Spend the rest of the day exploring Istanbul's winding streets, bustling bazaars, and stunning landmarks at your own pace.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Istanbul

itinerary.title: Istanbul Classical City Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a comprehensive Full Day Istanbul Classical City tour, exploring the iconic landmarks and historic treasures of this ancient city.
additionalInfo: Visit the breathtaking Blue Mosque, one of the most beautiful examples of Ottoman architecture. Explore the Hippodrome, the former heart of Constantinople's sporting and social life. Discover the stunning St Sophia Museum, a masterpiece of Byzantine architecture.

Next, visit the Topkapi Palace, the primary residence of the Ottoman sultans for over 400 years, featuring stunning gardens, kitchens, and treasure houses. Finally, get lost in the vibrant stalls and shops of the Grand Bazaar, one of the world's oldest and largest covered markets.
Overnight at the hotel in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Antalya
itinerary.description: After breakfast, depart for Istanbul Airport and catch your flight to Antalya, a stunning coastal city on the Turkish Riviera.
additionalInfo: Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel, check-in, and spend the rest of the day at leisure.
Explore Antalya's historic old town, visit the picturesque harbor, or simply relax on the beautiful beaches.
Overnight at the hotel in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Discover Antalya's Hidden Gems
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a comprehensive Full Day Antalya tour, exploring the city's stunning natural beauty, rich history, and vibrant culture.Visit the breathtaking Kursunlu Waterfall, a picturesque natural wonder surrounded by lush greenery. Relax on the stunning Konyaalti Beach, known for its crystal-clear waters and scenic views.Next, explore the historic Old Town Kaleici, with its narrow cobblestone streets, charming shops, and ancient architecture. Visit the iconic Hadrian Gate, a magnificent Roman-era entrance to the city.Other highlights of the tour include:
additionalInfo: Hidirlik Hills: Enjoy panoramic views of the city and the Mediterranean Sea.
Clock Tower: Admire the stunning architecture of this historic landmark.
Fluted Minaret: Marvel at the intricate stone carvings of this beautiful minaret.
Palm Street: Stroll along this picturesque street, lined with palm trees and historic buildings.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with unforgettable memories of Antalya's hidden gems.
Overnight at the hotel in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, bid farewell to Antalya and check-out of your hotel. Depart for Antalya Airport, bringing back memories of your wonderful Turkish adventure.
additionalInfo: Board your flight back home, carrying with you the vibrant colors, rich history, and warm hospitality of Turkey.End of tour.

name: Kuala Lumpur Escapade
metaTitle: Kuala Lumpur Tour Package | Cityscape, Shopping & Culture with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Kuala Lumpur with Duniya Dekho. Visit iconic Petronas Towers, Batu Caves, Genting Highlands, shopping malls, temples, night markets and cultural landmarks.
description: Malaysia: A Cultural and Natural Paradise Located in the heart of Southeast Asia, Malaysia is a vibrant and diverse country that offers a unique blend of culture, history, and natural beauty. From the bustling streets of Kuala Lumpur to the idyllic beaches of Penang, and from the ancient rainforests of Taman Negara to the majestic mountains of the Cameron Highlands, Malaysia has something for every kind of traveler.

With its rich cultural heritage, Malaysia is a melting pot of different ethnicities, religions, and traditions. The country's vibrant cities, such as Kuala Lumpur and Penang, offer a glimpse into its colonial past, while its rural areas provide a window into its indigenous culture. From the delicious street food to the colorful festivals, Malaysia is a country that is full of life and energy.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Malaysia is a Southeast Asian country with two main landmasses: Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia. It has: Mountains (Titiwangsa, Crocker Range, Mount Kinabalu)Rainforests Extensive coastlines Climate of Malaysia Malaysia has a tropical rainforest climate with: High temperatures (20-30°C) High humidity (60-90%) Significant rainfall throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, you'll be warmly greeted by our representative, who will escort you on a fascinating journey to the majestic city of Kuala Lumpur. En route, make a captivating stop at Putrajaya, the administrative capital of Malaysia, and marvel at its stunning architecture, beautifully landscaped gardens, and picturesque lakes. After a delightful exploration, proceed to your hotel, where a comfortable check-in awaits. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing in the hotel's tranquil ambiance, before retiring for a peaceful.
additionalInfo: overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur to Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a hearty breakfast at the hotel, followed by a visit to the iconic Batu Caves, a revered Hindu shrine. Next, embark on a thrilling adventure to Genting Highlands, where you'll enjoy a full-day tour that includes a ride on the Two-Way Cable Car, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape. In the evening, indulge in a delicious dinner at a local Indian restaurant. After a day filled with excitement and adventure, retire to your hotel for a comfortable.
additionalInfo: overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
itinerary.description: Following a delicious breakfast, embark on a fascinating Kuala Lumpur city tour, showcasing the best of Malaysia's vibrant capital. Begin with a visit to the iconic KL Tower, one of the tallest communication towers in the world, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the city skyline. As you explore the city, discover its rich history, cultural diversity, and modern architecture, making for a memorable and enriching experience. After a day filled with excitement and discovery, retire to your hotel for a comfortable.
additionalInfo: overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Malacca City Tour
itinerary.description: Start the day with a delicious breakfast at the hotel, followed by a fascinating tour of Malacca City, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Explore the city's rich history and cultural heritage, and enjoy a scenic boat ride along the Malacca River. In the evening, savor a mouth-watering dinner at a local Indian restaurant. After a day filled with history, culture, and natural beauty, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a leisurely breakfast at the hotel, followed by check-out formalities. As your Malaysian adventure comes to a close, our representative will escort you to the airport for your onward journey, bringing back memories of the vibrant culture, stunning landscapes, and warm hospitality of this enchanting country.

name: New Zealand Explorer
metaTitle: Northern Spain Tour Package | Scenic Spain with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Northern Spain with Duniya Dekho. Discover Bilbao, San Sebastián, coastal landscapes, rich culture, and world-class cuisine.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through New Zealand's breathtaking landscapes. Begin in Auckland, the City of Sails, before traveling to Rotorua, where Maori culture and geothermal wonders await. Next, fly to Christchurch, the Garden City, and then venture to the stunning Glacier Region, where towering mountains and glaciers reign supreme. Continue to picturesque Queenstown, the adventure capital of the world, and enjoy three nights surrounded by majestic mountains and serene lakes. Visit the serene Lake Tekapo and majestic Mt. Cook, before returning to Christchurch for a final night. This 11-day journey showcases the best of New Zealand's diverse natural beauty, unique culture, and adventure activities.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: New Zealand, an island nation in the southwestern Pacific Ocean, comprises two main landmasses: the North Island and the South Island. The country's diverse geography features rugged mountains, including the Southern Alps, vast coastlines, pristine fjords, and picturesque lakes. New Zealand's climate varies from subtropical in the north to temperate in the south, with mild temperatures and moderate rainfall throughout the year. The climate is influenced by the Pacific Ocean and the prevailing westerly winds, resulting in distinct regional variations, from the warm and humid north to the cooler and drier south.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Auckland
itinerary.description: Arrive in Auckland, New Zealand's largest city, and collect your rental vehicle. Drive to your accommodation and spend the day exploring this vibrant city, nestled between two stunning harbors. Discover Auckland's diverse landscapes, from the gentle sandy shores of the east to the wild, black sand beaches of the west. Take advantage of the city's beautiful surroundings and consider getting out on the water to explore the sparkling blue Hauraki Gulf, dotted with emerald islands.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Auckland.

itinerary.title: Waitomo, Matamata, and Rotorua
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic journey through the picturesque countryside to Waitomo, where you'll discover an underground wonderland of glowworm caves. Take a guided tour through the shimmering galleries, adorned with galaxies of glowworms.Next, visit Matamata, home to the iconic Hobbiton Movie Set. Explore the charming Shire, featuring unique Hobbit holes, lush gardens, and the Green Dragon Inn, just as seen in the movies.Finally, arrive in Rotorua, a city like no other, with its unique geothermal landscape of bubbling mud pools, steaming geysers, and natural hot springs.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Explore Rotorua's Geothermal Wonders and Maori Culture
itinerary.description: Discover Rotorua's captivating geothermal landscape, featuring an array of steam vents, geysers, and bubbling mud pools, all set amidst stunning freshwater lakes and native forests. This region is also steeped in rich Maori history and mythology.Visit a local geothermal attraction, such as Wai-O-Tapu or Waimangu Volcanic Valley, to witness the unique natural wonders up close. In the evening, experience a magical forest display, where culture, art, and nature come together in a sensory extravaganza.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: Fly to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Take a domestic flight from Rotorua to Christchurch (airfare not included). Arrive in Christchurch, a city nestled between the Pacific Ocean and the majestic Southern Alps. Discover a vibrant city in transformation, featuring beautiful inner-city parks, gardens, and the picturesque Avon River, which meanders through the heart of the city.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Christchurch.

itinerary.title: Christchurch to Glacier Region via Arthurs Pass
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic journey across the picturesque Canterbury Plains, a vibrant tapestry of green hues, and through the breathtaking Arthurs Pass National Park. Arrive on the rugged West Coast, a realm of untamed beauty, characterized by pristine rainforests, mighty glaciers, and ancient geological formations. Marvel at the majestic glaciers, remnants of the last ice age, as they cascade down rocky valleys.
additionalInfo: Overnight in the stunning Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Explore the Glacier Region
itinerary.description: Spend a day at leisure in the breathtaking Glacier Region, where temperate climates and low altitudes make Fox and Franz Josef Glaciers uniquely accessible. Witness the dramatic valleys, scarred by millennia of glacial retreat and advance, where the ice age continues to shape the landscape.Choose from a range of activities, including:
additionalInfo: Visiting Punakaiki's iconic Pancake Rocks.
Taking a scenic flight with a glacier landing for a thrilling hike on the icy terrain.
Enjoy the freedom to tailor your day to your interests and preferences. Overnight at your hotel in the Glacier Region.

itinerary.title: Glacier Region to Queenstown
itinerary.description: Embark on a stunning scenic drive to Queenstown, passing through quaint wilderness towns, picturesque waterfalls, and majestic river landscapes. Be sure to stop at Makarora's breathtaking Blue Pools, a perfect spot to stretch your legs and take in the natural beauty. Arrive in Queenstown, a resort town nestled on the shores of Lake Wakatipu, surrounded by the Southern Alps.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Explore Queenstown, Adventure Capital of the World
itinerary.description: Surrounded by majestic mountains and picturesque vistas, Queenstown is the epitome of an alpine resort town. Renowned as the Adventure Capital of the World, Queenstown offers an unparalleled array of activities to suit all interests and adrenaline levels.Enjoy a free day to tailor your experience:
additionalInfo: Take a leisurely lake cruise or scenic flight.
Hike through breathtaking landscapes or bike through scenic trails.
Indulge in bungee jumping, skydiving, or other adventure sports.
Explore the town's vibrant culture, cuisine, and nightlife.
The choices are endless in Queenstown. Overnight at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Milford Sound Adventure
itinerary.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to Fiordland, one of the world's most pristine and untouched wilderness regions. Travel through a breathtaking landscape of mirror-like lakes, cascading waterfalls, and rocks sculpted by the relentless force of water.Enter the majestic Milford Sound, a natural wonder carved by ancient glaciers and hailed as the 'Eighth Wonder of the World'. Cruise through the sound's towering cliffs, surrounded by lush rainforests and majestic waterfalls, including the iconic Lady Bowen Falls and Stirling Falls.Return to Queenstown in the evening, with lifelong memories of this unforgettable experience.
additionalInfo: Overnight at your hotel in Queenstown.

itinerary.title: Queenstown to Mt Cook/Tekapo
itinerary.description: Embark on a scenic drive to a breathtaking wonderland of golden tussocks, snow-capped mountains, and vibrant turquoise lakes. Hug the shores of stunning Lake Pukaki, a picturesque backdrop for your journey to Aoraki Mt Cook National Park. Here, discover a rugged landscape of ice and rock, dominated by Mt Cook, New Zealand's highest peak.
additionalInfo: Overnight in the serene surroundings of Tekapo or Mt Cook.

itinerary.title: Mt Cook/Tekapo to Christchurch
itinerary.description: Begin the day with a scenic visit to Lake Tekapo, where the picturesque 'Church of the Good Shepherd' stands proudly against the stunning backdrop of the glacier-fed lake's vibrant blue waters. Continue northeast, passing through a landscape of braided rivers and familiar plains, signaling your return to Christchurch. Overnight at your hotel in Christchurch, reflecting on the unforgettable experiences of your New Zealand journey.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Bilbao.

itinerary.title: Departure from Christchurch
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to New Zealand as you check out of your hotel and proceed to Christchurch Airport for your departure flight. Carry with you the unforgettable memories of your journey through New Zealand's breathtaking landscapes, unique culture, and warm hospitality. Safe travels home!

name: Paradise Bangkok & Pattaya
metaTitle: Bangkok & Pattaya Tour Package | City Life & Beach Escape with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Bangkok and Pattaya with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy vibrant city attractions, sacred temples, floating markets, nightlife, coral islands, and relaxing beach experiences.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the vibrant cities of Bangkok and Pattaya, where ancient traditions meet modern charm. Immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage, stunning architecture, and warm hospitality that Thailand has to offer. This 4-night, 5-day itinerary promises an exciting blend of culture, entertainment, and relaxation, carefully crafted to showcase the best of these two fascinating cities.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Bangkok and Pattaya share a tropical climate, characterized by high temperatures and humidity throughout the year. Bangkok's geography is marked by its flat terrain, situated on the banks of the Chao Phraya River. In contrast, Pattaya is nestled in a coastal plain on the Gulf of Thailand.The climate in both cities is divided into three main seasons. The hot season, from March to May, brings scorching temperatures. The rainy season, from June to October, is marked by heavy rainfall and flash flooding. The cool season, from November to February, offers relatively milder temperatures, making it an ideal time to visit.

itinerary.title: Pattaya Arrival
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Pattaya in Suvarnabhumi or DMK Airport, you'll be greeted by our friendly representative who will escort you to your hotel. Check-in to your comfortable accommodations and take some time to freshen up and relax. Spend the day at leisure, exploring the hotel's facilities or taking a stroll around the nearby area.
additionalInfo: As evening falls, get ready to be dazzled by the spectacular Alcazar Show, a world-famous cabaret featuring stunning costumes, mesmerizing music, and talented performers. This extravagant show is a must-see in Pattaya, and you're sure to be enthralled by its energy and glamour.After the show, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay, with memories of the Alcazar Show's magic lingering in your mind.

itinerary.title: Coral Island Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on an exciting excursion to Coral Island, a picturesque gem nestled off the coast of Pattaya. Spend the morning soaking up the sun, swimming in the crystal-clear waters, and snorkeling among the vibrant coral reefs. As you bask in the island's tranquility, indulge in a delightful lunch and recharge for the rest of the day.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the afternoon, feeling refreshed and rejuvenated. The rest of the day is yours to unwind and relax, whether that means lounging by the pool, treating yourself to a spa treatment, or simply taking a leisurely stroll around the hotel's surroundings. As the evening unfolds, enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at your hotel, with memories of Coral Island's beauty lingering in your mind.

itinerary.title: Safari World and Marine Park
itinerary.description: Embark on an exciting journey from Pattaya to Bangkok, with a thrilling stopover at Safari World and Marine Park. After a hearty breakfast, check out from your hotel in Pattaya and begin your transfer to Bangkok.
additionalInfo: En route, visit Safari World, a drive-through wildlife park where you can get up close and personal with exotic animals from around the world. Next, explore the Marine Park, featuring a stunning array of marine life, including dolphins, seals, and colorful fish.As the day draws to a close, continue your journey to Bangkok and check into your hotel. Spend the evening relaxing and rejuvenating, or explore the city's vibrant nightlife. Overnight stay at your hotel in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: City tour and shopping in Bangkok
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast at your hotel, fueling up for an exciting city tour of Bangkok. Explore the city's iconic landmarks, including the majestic Grand Palace, the revered Wat Phra Kaew, and the stunning Wat Arun. Discover the rich history, culture, and architecture that make Bangkok a truly unique and fascinating city.
additionalInfo: As the day unfolds, move on to the shopping segment of your tour. Visit some of Bangkok's most famous markets and shopping malls, such as Indra Square, Water Pavilion. Indulge in some retail therapy, browsing through a vast array of goods, from fashion and accessories to souvenirs and local handicrafts.After a day filled with culture, history, and shopping, return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Bring your unforgettable Bangkok and Pattaya journey to a close with a relaxing morning at your hotel. Savor a delightful breakfast, and then check out from your hotel.
additionalInfo: Next, proceed to the airport for your departure, bringing back memories of the vibrant cities, stunning landmarks, and warm hospitality you experienced during your trip. Depart with a heart full of unforgettable moments and a promise to return to this enchanting land someday.

name: Phuket: Island of Dreams
metaTitle: Phuket Tour Package | Beaches, Islands & Culture with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Discover Phuket with Duniya Dekho. Enjoy pristine beaches, island hopping, cultural landmarks, and tropical adventures.
description: Phuket, Thailand's largest island, is a tropical paradise renowned for its stunning beaches, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant nightlife. The island's lush forests, towering limestone cliffs, and picturesque villages create a breathtaking landscape. Phuket's iconic beaches, such as Patong, Kata, and Karon, offer powdery white sand and turquoise waters perfect for relaxation and water sports. The island's rich culture, delicious seafood, and lively markets add to its charm, making Phuket an unforgettable destination for travelers.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Phuket, Thailand's largest island, is located in the Andaman Sea. The island boasts lush forests, limestone cliffs, and stunning beaches.Phuket's climate is tropical, with warm temperatures and high humidity year-round. The island experiences a dry season (November to April) and a wet season (May to October), with average temperatures ranging from 23°C to 32°C (73°F to 90°F).

itinerary.title: Arrival and Fantasea Show
itinerary.description: Arrive at Phuket Airport, where our representative will greet and escort you to your hotel. Check-in to your hotel and freshen up.In the evening, experience the magic of Phuket's iconic Fantasea Show, a spectacular cultural performance showcasing Thailand's rich heritage and mythology.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island Tour
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast, embark on an unforgettable journey to the breathtaking Phi Phi Islands. Explore the stunning beaches, crystal-clear waters, and limestone cliffs of this tropical paradise.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel in the evening and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Phuket City Tour with Shopping
itinerary.description: Explore the charms of Phuket on a guided city tour, discovering the island's rich history, vibrant culture, and stunning landmarks.Visit the iconic Promthep Cape, offering breathtaking views of the Andaman Sea, and the revered Wat Chalong, a stunning Buddhist temple.Stop by the Phuket Big Buddha, a majestic 45-meter-tall statue, and explore the bustling Old Phuket Town, with its Sino-Portuguese architecture and lively markets.In the evening, indulge in a shopping spree at one of Phuket's popular shopping malls or markets, such as Patong Walking Street or Central Phuket, where you can find everything from souvenirs to designer clothing.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel, bringing back memories of an unforgettable day in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, check out of your hotel and bid farewell to Phuket.Transfer to Phuket International Airport for your onward journey, carrying memories of stunning beaches, crystal-clear waters, and unforgettable experiences.
