name: Portugal Uncovered:Lisbon and Porto
metaTitle: Portugal Tour Package | Lisbon & Porto 7-Day Journey with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Portugal with Duniya Dekho. Discover the charm of Lisbon and Porto, historic landmarks, scenic streets, and vibrant culture on this 7-day journey.
description: Experience the charm of Portugal, a country steeped in history and culture. Begin in Lisbon (3N), the picturesque capital, where historic trams wind through colorful neighborhoods, and majestic castles like São Jorge and Belém Tower stand tall. Explore the vibrant streets of Alfama, indulge in traditional Fado music, and savor delicious seafood. Then, head north to Porto (3N), a city renowned for its Port wine production, stunning riverfront, and iconic Luis I Bridge. Wander through the Ribeira district, visit the Porto Cathedral, and sample the famous wine in the cellars of Vila Nova de Gaia. Discover the rich heritage and natural beauty of Portugal, from the scenic Douro Valley to the stunning coastline.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Portugal's diverse geography spans the western Iberian Peninsula, featuring a 1,800km coastline along the Atlantic Ocean, scenic mountains, and rolling hills. The climate varies from Mediterranean to Atlantic, with mild winters and warm summers. The north is generally cooler and wetter, while the south is sunnier and drier. The rugged Serra da Estrela mountains in central Portugal give way to fertile valleys and scenic coastlines, including the picturesque Algarve region in the south. The country's unique geography and climate support a wide range of flora and fauna, making it a haven for nature lovers and outdoor enthusiasts.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lisbon
itinerary.description: Welcome to Lisbon, the vibrant capital city of Portugal. Upon arrival, you'll be greeted by a private transfer with an English-speaking driver, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free journey to your hotel.Take some time to unwind and get settled into your accommodations, surrounded by the city's historic charm and picturesque landscapes.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lisbon, ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure in this captivating city.

itinerary.title: Exploring Lisbon
itinerary.description: Embark on a guided tour of Lisbon, uncovering the city's rich history, traditions, and iconic landmarks. Visit the majestic Jerónimos Monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the Tower of Belém, a symbol of Portugal's Age of Discovery.Explore the Monument of the Discoveries, a tribute to the country's seafaring explorers, and the Coach Museum, showcasing an impressive collection of royal carriages.Wander through the historic neighborhoods of Alfama and Rossio, immersing yourself in the city's vibrant atmosphere and Fado music.Discover the essence of Lisbon, from its stunning architecture to its warm and welcoming culture.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Lisbon.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Lisbon

name: Safari Dreams: A Journey Through Tanzania's Wild
metaTitle: Tanzania Safari Tour | Wildlife & Adventure with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the wild beauty of Tanzania with Duniya Dekho. Explore Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, and majestic wildlife on an unforgettable safari adventure.
description: Tanzania, a land of breathtaking beauty and diverse wildlife, is home to some of Africa's most iconic destinations. This adventure begins in Arusha, a bustling town at the foot of Mount Meru, before heading to Lake Manyara National Park, renowned for its tree-climbing lions and stunning lake views. The journey continues in Seronera, the heart of the Serengeti, where the Great Migration unfolds. Next, explore the majestic Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the world's largest intact calderas, teeming with wildlife. Finally, visit Tarangire National Park, famous for its majestic baobab trees and large herds of elephants, completing an unforgettable safari experience in the heart of Tanzania.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Tanzania's geography is characterized by diverse landscapes, from the snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest point, to the vast Serengeti plains, Lake Victoria's shores, and the Indian Ocean coastline. The country's climate varies from tropical along the coast to temperate in the highlands, with arid and semi-arid conditions in the north and central regions. The Great Rift Valley runs through Tanzania, creating unique geological formations, including the Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara. The climate is marked by two rainy seasons, with temperatures ranging from 20°C to 30°C (68°F to 86°F) throughout the year, making it an ideal destination for safari adventures and beach relaxation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport, the gateway to Tanzania's incredible landscapes and wildlife. Transfer to Arusha, the vibrant 'Safari Capital' of northern Tanzania, known for its bustling markets, colorful culture, and adventure spirit.Check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring Arusha's charming streets, markets, and surroundings on your own. Enjoy the town's relaxed atmosphere, try local cuisine, and prepare for the exciting safari adventures ahead.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Arusha.

itinerary.title: Lake Manyara National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Arusha and transfer to Lake Manyara National Park, a haven for wildlife enthusiasts. Arrive in time for lunch and check-in to your hotel.In the afternoon, embark on a thrilling game drive within the park, exploring its diverse habitats and spotting an incredible array of wildlife. With over 400 species of birds, Lake Manyara is a birdwatcher's paradise. The park is also home to:
additionalInfo: The largest concentration of baboons in the world.
Giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impala, and waterbuck .
Warthogs, Cape clawless otters, and Egyptian mongooses

Enjoy the breathtaking views of the lake and surrounding landscapes as you explore this unique ecosystem. Return to your hotel in the evening, surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.Overnight at the hotel in Lake Manyara National Park.

itinerary.title: Seronera, Serengeti National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Lake Manyara and transfer to Seronera, a prime location in the central Serengeti. This region is renowned for its exceptional wildlife viewing opportunities, particularly during the Great Migration.Arrive in time for lunch at the camp and check-in to your hotel. In the afternoon, embark on a game drive within the Serengeti National Park, taking in the stunning scenery and spotting an array of wildlife.The Serengeti is home to:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros.
Large herds of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles.
Cheetahs, hyenas, and other predators.
Return to your hotel in the evening, surrounded by the majestic landscapes of the Serengeti.
Overnight at the hotel in Seronera.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drives in Seronera
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on an early morning game drive in the Serengeti National Park, where you'll have the opportunity to spot an incredible array of wildlife, including:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros.
Large herds of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles.
Cheetahs, hyenas, and other predators.
Enjoy a thrilling morning of safari adventures, taking in the stunning scenery and unforgettable wildlife encounters.
In the afternoon, enjoy another game drive, with a break for lunch at a scenic spot. Continue your safari adventures, spotting more wildlife and taking in the breathtaking views of the Serengeti.
Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with the memories of an incredible day in the wild.
Overnight at the hotel in Seronera.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Seronera and transfer to the Ngorongoro Crater, a breathtaking natural wonder and one of Africa's most popular safari destinations. This UNESCO-listed site is renowned for its:
additionalInfo: Unique landscape, surrounded by Tanzania's highlands.
Abundant and diverse wildlife, including the Big Five.
Status as the world's largest intact volcanic caldera.
Arrive in time for lunch and check-in to your hotel, situated within the crater. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, exploring the crater's stunning landscapes and diverse wildlife on your own.
Overnight at the hotel in Ngorongoro Crater, surrounded by the crater's majestic scenery and abundant wildlife.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drive in Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day game drive in the Ngorongoro Crater, with packed lunch boxes to fuel your adventure. Spend the day exploring the crater's unique landscapes and spotting an incredible array of wildlife, including:
additionalInfo: The Big Five: lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinoceros.
Large herds of zebra and wildebeest.
A variety of other wildlife species, including hyenas, cheetahs, and gazelles

Enjoy a thrilling day of safari adventures, taking in the stunning scenery and unforgettable wildlife encounters. Return to your hotel in the evening, filled with the memories of an incredible day in the Ngorongoro Crater.
Overnight at the hotel in Ngorongoro Crater.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Ngorongoro Crater and transfer to Tarangire National Park, renowned for its:
additionalInfo: Spectacular baobab trees.
Breathtaking views of the Maasai Steppe.
Wondrous mountains to the south
Arrive in time for lunch and check-in to your hotel. In the afternoon, embark on a game drive within the park, exploring its diverse wildlife, including:
Large herds of elephants.
Migratory wildebeest, zebra, and buffalo.
Migratory wildebeest, zebra, and buffalo.
Lions, a common sight in the park.
Enjoy a thrilling afternoon of safari adventures, taking in the stunning scenery and unforgettable wildlife encounters. Return to your hotel in the evening, surrounded by the park's natural beauty.
Overnight at the hotel in Tarangire National Park.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kilimanjaro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check-out from your hotel in Tarangire National Park and transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure flight.Reflect on the unforgettable experiences and memories made during your Tanzanian adventure, from the majestic wildlife of the Serengeti to the stunning landscapes of the Ngorongoro Crater and Tarangire National Park.Bid farewell to Tanzania and board your flight back home, carrying with you the warmth and hospitality of the Tanzanian people.

name: Sands of Time: An Egyptian Escape
metaTitle: Egypt Tour Package | Pyramids, Nile Cruise & Ancient Wonders with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Egypt with Duniya Dekho. Discover the Pyramids of Giza, cruise the Nile, visit Luxor and Aswan, and immerse yourself in ancient history and culture.
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through ancient Egypt, exploring the vibrant city of Cairo, cruising along the majestic Nile River, and uncovering the secrets of the pharaohs. Discover the iconic Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum's treasures, and the bustling streets of Islamic Cairo. Then, board a luxurious Nile Cruise and sail to Aswan and Luxor, visiting the magnificent temples of Philae, Kom Ombo, and Edfu, and the Valley of the Kings. Return to Cairo for a final night, bringing back memories of your incredible Egyptian adventure.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Egypt's geography is characterized by its diverse terrain, featuring deserts, mountains, and coastal plains, with the Nile River running through the country. The climate is hot and desert-like, with very little rainfall and high temperatures during the summer months, reaching up to 40°C (104°F), while winter temperatures can drop to around 10°C (50°F), with low humidity levels, especially during winter.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Arrive in Cairo, the vibrant capital of Egypt, and transfer to your hotel. Spend the day relaxing and acclimating to your surroundings. Explore the hotel's amenities or take a leisurely stroll around the neighborhood.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Pyramids, Museum, and Bazaar
itinerary.description: Embark on a fascinating exploration of Cairo's iconic landmarks. Visit the majestic Great Pyramids of Giza, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World, and marvel at their sheer scale and history. Next, discover the treasures of the Egyptian Museum, home to the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts. End the day with a vibrant visit to Khan El Khalili Bazaar, one of the oldest markets in the Middle East, where you can haggle for souvenirs and experience the local culture. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, relaxing at your hotel or exploring the city.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Cairo to Aswan, Nile Cruise Embarkation
itinerary.description: Fly from Cairo to Aswan, a charming city in southern Egypt, and transfer to the cruise terminal. Board your luxurious Nile Cruise and begin your journey along the majestic Nile River. Visit the impressive Aswan High Dam, a marvel of modern engineering, and take a motorboat ride to the picturesque Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis.
additionalInfo: Overnight on the cruise, surrounded by the tranquil waters of the Nile.

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and Edfu Temples
itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring two of Egypt's most fascinating temples. Visit the unique Kom Ombo Temple, a rare double temple dedicated to the worship of two gods: Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus, the falcon god. Continue sailing to Edfu, home to the magnificent Temple of Horus, one of the best-preserved temples in Egypt. Marvel at the temple's impressive architecture and the colossal statue of Horus, a majestic falcon, guarding the entrance.
additionalInfo: Overnight on the cruise, surrounded by the serene beauty of the Nile.

itinerary.title: Luxor's East Bank Wonders
itinerary.description: Discover the ancient splendors of Luxor's East Bank, home to two of Egypt's most breathtaking temples. Visit the magnificent Karnak Temple, a vast complex of sanctuaries, halls, and obelisks, and the stunning Luxor Temple, a majestic testament to the power of ancient Egypt. Explore the intricate hieroglyphics, imposing columns, and majestic architecture of these iconic temples.
additionalInfo: Overnight on the cruise, with the memories of Luxor's grandeur.

itinerary.title: Luxor's West Bank, Return to Cairo
itinerary.description: Embark on a captivating journey to Luxor's West Bank, exploring the iconic Valley of the Kings, the majestic Hatshepsut Temple, and other ancient wonders. Uncover the secrets of Egypt's pharaonic past and marvel at the stunning architecture and intricate hieroglyphics. After the tour, fly back to Cairo from Luxor domestic airport. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and spend the rest of the day relaxing or exploring the city.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.description: Bid farewell to Egypt and transfer to Cairo International Airport for your departure flight, carrying memories of your unforgettable Egyptian adventure.

name: Northern Spain Journey
metaTitle: Northern Spain Tour Package | Scenic Spain with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore Northern Spain with Duniya Dekho. Discover Bilbao, San Sebastián, coastal landscapes, rich culture, and world-class cuisine.
description: Discover the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Northern Spain on this captivating journey. Begin in Bilbao (2N), a vibrant city renowned for its iconic Guggenheim Museum and delicious pintxos. Explore the stunning medieval town of Santillana del Mar (1N), with its well-preserved architecture and historic significance. Next, visit Oviedo (2N), the capital of Asturias, boasting an impressive cathedral and picturesque old town. Continue to Santiago de Compostela (2N), a revered pilgrimage site and UNESCO World Heritage Site, featuring the majestic Cathedral of Santiago. Travel to Leon (2N), a city steeped in history and home to the breathtaking Gothic cathedral. Visit Burgos (1N), with its stunning cathedral and rich history, before returning to Bilbao (1N) to conclude your journey, filled with unforgettable experiences and memories of Northern Spain's unique charm.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Northern Spain's diverse geography spans the Cantabrian Mountains, rolling hills, and scenic coastline along the Bay of Biscay. The climate varies from oceanic to Mediterranean, with mild winters and warm summers. The region's unique geography and climate support a wide range of flora and fauna, including lush forests, rugged coastlines, and picturesque villages. The Cantabrian Mountains create a dramatic backdrop for the region's historic towns and cities, while the coastline offers stunning beaches and scenic views. The region's climate is generally mild, with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 25°C (50°F to 77°F) throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bilbao
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bilbao, the vibrant capital of the Basque Country, and enjoy a private transfer to your hotel. Surrounded by a stunning landscape of forests, mountains, beaches, and rugged coastlines, Bilbao offers a unique blend of natural beauty and cultural richness. Take some time to unwind and explore the city's charming streets, discovering its rich history, architecture, and delicious local cuisine.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Bilbao, ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through Northern Spain.

itinerary.title: Exploring Bilbao
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day in Bilbao, exploring the city's vibrant atmosphere and stunning architecture. Discover iconic landmarks like the Bilbao Guggenheim Museum, a masterpiece of modern art and design. Visit other notable attractions, including the Euskalduna Conference and Music Centre, Norman Foster's Underground, and Santiago Calatrava's airport. Admire the striking towers designed by renowned architects Arata Isozaki and César Pelli. Take your time to wander through the city's charming neighborhoods, sampling local cuisine and drinks, and soaking up the unique energy of Bilbao.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Bilbao.

itinerary.title: Santillana del Mar
itinerary.description: Take a private car transfer from Bilbao to the charming medieval town of Santillana del Mar. This picturesque town is known for its well-preserved architecture, historic significance, and stunning beauty. Arrive in Santillana del Mar and check-in to your hotel, surrounded by the town's unique charm. Take some time to explore the town's narrow streets, visit its historic landmarks, and soak up the atmosphere.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Santillana del Mar.

itinerary.title: Picos de Europa Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a full-day Picos de Europa tour with a private car and driver to Fuente Dé. Take the thrilling cable car ride, descending 753 meters in just 5 minutes. The stunning views of rocky crests, gorges, valleys, glacial lakes, and lush forests will leave you in awe of northern Spain's natural beauty. After the tour, transfer by car to Oviedo, then return to Santillana del Mar for the night.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Santillana del Mar.

itinerary.title: Exploring Oviedo
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day in Oviedo, exploring the city's historic charm at your own pace. Discover the city's rich history, dating back to the 8th century, and its significance as the capital of the Kingdom of Asturias. Wander through the pedestrian historic quarter, taking in the medieval flavor and architecture. The city's unique atmosphere is waiting to be explored, with notable landmarks, local cuisine, and hidden gems to uncover.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Oviedo.

itinerary.title: Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: Take a private transfer from Oviedo to Santiago de Compostela, a city renowned for its stunning cathedral and rich history. Arrive in this iconic city, a major pilgrimage site, and check-in to your hotel. The city's charming streets, historic landmarks, and vibrant atmosphere await your exploration.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Santiago de Compostela.

itinerary.title: Exploring Santiago de Compostela
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day to explore the historic city of Santiago de Compostela, capital of the Region of Galicia. Discover its rich cultural heritage by visiting the historic center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the stunning façades of convents, monasteries, and famous houses like Fonseca, as well as the city's notable contemporary architectures. The iconic Santiago Cathedral, the culmination of the Way of Saint James pilgrimage route, is a must-visit attraction, drawing millions of pilgrims and visitors each year. Take your time to soak up the city's unique atmosphere and history.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Santiago de Compostela.

itinerary.title: Leon
itinerary.description: Take a private transfer to board the train to Leon, a city steeped in history and culture. Upon arrival in Leon, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. Check-in and take some time to explore this charming city, known for its stunning Gothic cathedral and rich heritage.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Leon.

itinerary.title: Exploring Leon
itinerary.description: Enjoy a free day in Leon, exploring the city's rich history and cultural heritage at your own pace. Discover the city's medieval past, its significance on the Pilgrim's Road to Santiago de Compostela, and its unique charm. Visit historic landmarks, stroll through the city's charming streets, and soak up the local atmosphere, making the most of your time in this captivating city.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Leon.

itinerary.title: Burgos
itinerary.description: Take a private transfer to the railway station to board your train from Leon to Burgos, a city steeped in history and medieval charm. Upon arrival, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. Burgos proudly preserves its medieval splendor, showcasing important vestiges of its past as the capital of the unified kingdom of Castilla-Leon for five centuries. The city's iconic cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is a must-see attraction.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Burgos.

itinerary.title: Return to Bilbao
itinerary.description: Take a private transfer to the railway station to board your train from Burgos back to Bilbao. Upon arrival, a private transfer will take you to your hotel. Your journey through northern Spain's stunning landscapes and historic cities comes full circle as you return to Bilbao.
additionalInfo: Overnight at the hotel in Bilbao.

itinerary.title: Departure and this is the last day of your 12-day journey.
itinerary.description: Check out from your hotel and take a private transfer to Bilbao Airport for your flight back home, bringing an end to your memorable journey through northern Spain.

name: Best of Europe Tour – Italy, Switzerland & France
metaTitle: Best of Europe Tour | Italy, Switzerland & France Travel Package with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Explore the Best of Europe with Duniya Dekho. Discover Italy’s iconic cities, Switzerland’s scenic Alps, and France’s romantic charm in one unforgettable tour package.
description: Discover the highlights of Italy, Switzerland, and France on this unforgettable European journey. Explore historic Rome and Vatican City, admire the Leaning Tower of Pisa, experience the romance of Venice, and enjoy the scenic beauty of Lake Como. Marvel at the Swiss Alps with excursions to Mt. Titlis and Jungfraujoch, while visiting charming cities like Lucerne, Interlaken, Bern, Vevey, and Geneva. Conclude your tour in Paris, with visits to Versailles, iconic city landmarks, and a fun-filled day at Disneyland Paris.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: This itinerary covers Italy, Switzerland, and France, offering a mix of historic cities, scenic lakes, and alpine landscapes. Italy features Mediterranean geography with mild and pleasant weather, while Switzerland is dominated by the Alps, with cooler temperatures and snow in higher mountain regions. France, especially Paris, enjoys a temperate climate with comfortable conditions for sightseeing. Overall, the journey offers diverse scenery and generally pleasant weather ideal for travel.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Rome – Vatican City – Rome (1 Night)
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Rome International Airport, meet the local representative and proceed towards Vatican City, the spiritual center of Christianity. Visit St. Peter’s Basilica, one of the largest and most magnificent churches in the world, and spend time at St. Peter’s Square, admiring its grand architecture and atmosphere. Later, enjoy an orientation tour of Rome covering famous landmarks such as the Colosseum (outside view), Roman Forum, Trevi Fountain, and Spanish Steps. Check in at the hotel and relax after your journey.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Rome

itinerary.title: Rome – Pisa (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive towards Pisa, a historic city in the Tuscany region. On arrival, visit the world-famous Leaning Tower of Pisa, located in the beautiful Piazza dei Miracoli, along with the Cathedral and Baptistery (external views). Enjoy free time for photographs and to explore the surrounding area. Later, check in at the hotel and enjoy the evening at leisure.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vicenza.

itinerary.title: Pisa – Venice – Vicenza (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards the romantic city of Venice. On arrival, enjoy an orientation tour of Venice, including St. Mark’s Square, St. Mark’s Basilica (outside view), Doge’s Palace (outside view), and views of the enchanting Venetian canals. Experience the unique charm of the floating city as you walk through its historic streets. Later, continue your journey to Vicenza, known for its elegant architecture, and check in at the hotel.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Vicenza.

itinerary.title: Vicenza – Lake Como – Lucerne / Zurich (3 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and travel towards the scenic Lake Como, surrounded by breathtaking Alpine landscapes and charming lakeside towns. Enjoy photo stops and time to admire the natural beauty of the lake. Later, continue your journey into Switzerland, crossing picturesque mountain regions, and arrive in Lucerne / Zurich. Check in at the hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Lucerne / Zurich.
additionalInfo: Check in at the hotel and relax. Overnight stay in Lucerne / Zurich.

itinerary.title: Mt. Titlis – Engelberg – Lucerne
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for an unforgettable excursion to Mt. Titlis via the alpine village of Engelberg. Experience a series of cable car rides, including the world’s first rotating cable car Rotair, offering stunning 360-degree views of snow-capped mountains. Enjoy snow activities, visit the Ice Grotto, walk on the Cliff Walk, and take in panoramic Alpine views. Later, return to Lucerne and enjoy a short city orientation covering the Lion Monument, Chapel Bridge, and lakeside area.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Lucerne / Zurich.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch – Interlaken
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day excursion to Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe, one of the highlights of the tour. Travel via Interlaken and board the scenic mountain train to Europe’s highest railway station. Visit the Ice Palace, Sphinx Observation Deck, and enjoy breathtaking views of glaciers and snow-covered peaks. Spend time in the snow and capture memorable photographs before returning to the hotel in the evening.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Lucerne / Zurich.

itinerary.title: Lucerne / Zurich – Bern – Vevey – Geneva (1 Night)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed towards Geneva. En route, stop at Bern, the capital city of Switzerland, and enjoy a short orientation tour of its medieval old town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Continue to Vevey, a charming lakeside town famous for being home to the Nestlé Headquarters, and enjoy views of Lake Geneva. Later, arrive in Geneva, check in at the hotel, and relax.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Geneva.

itinerary.title: Geneva – Paris (3 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and travel to Paris, the city of romance and lights. On arrival, check in at the hotel and enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You may explore nearby cafés, stroll along the streets, or relax after the long journey.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Paris

itinerary.title: Paris – Versailles – Paris
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a guided city tour of Paris, covering iconic landmarks such as the Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Not re-Dame Cathedral (outside view), and a photo stop at the Eiffel Tower. Later, proceed to visit the magnificent Palace of Versailles, known for its grand halls and beautifully landscaped gardens.
additionalInfo: Return to Paris in the evening. Overnight stay in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris – Disneyland – Paris
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day visit to Disneyland Paris, one of Europe’s most popular theme parks. Enjoy thrilling rides, magical parades, live shows, and themed attractions suitable for both children and adults. Experience the fairy tale atmosphere and create unforgettable memories before returning to the hotel in the evening.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Paris.

itinerary.title: Paris – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your return journey, marking the end of a memorable and beautifully curated European vacation.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Paris.

name: Greece Getaway: From Ancient Athens to the Iconic Isles of Mykonos & Santorini
metaTitle: Greece Getaway | Athens, Mykonos & Santorini Tour Package with Duniya Dekho
metaDescription: Experience the perfect Greece getaway with Duniya Dekho. Explore ancient Athens, relax on the iconic islands of Mykonos and Santorini, enjoy stunning sunsets, beautiful beaches and authentic Greek culture in one unforgettable journey.
description: This Greece itinerary offers a perfect blend of ancient history, vibrant island life, and breathtaking natural beauty. Begin your journey in Athens, the cradle of Western civilization, where iconic landmarks like the Acropolis and Parthenon showcase the country’s rich heritage. Continue to the cosmopolitan island of Mykonos, known for its charming whitewashed streets, beautiful beaches, and lively waterfront atmosphere. Conclude your trip in the stunning island of Santorini, famous for its dramatic volcanic caldera, blue-domed churches, and unforgettable sunsets. Combining cultural exploration, scenic landscapes, and relaxing island experiences, this journey presents the very best of Greece in one memorable trip.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini are located in Greece and experience a Mediterranean climate, featuring ancient mainland landscapes and mountainous surroundings in Athens, scenic rocky islands and sandy beaches in Mykonos, and dramatic volcanic cliffs with caldera views in Santorini, with pleasant spring temperatures in April ranging between 18°C to 24°C, making it ideal for sightseeing and island exploration.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Athens International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Athens, the cradle of Western civilization, offers a fascinating blend of ancient history and modern vibrancy. The remainder of the day is at leisure to relax after your journey or explore the nearby neighborhood.
additionalInfo: You may enjoy a leisurely stroll through the lively streets, discover local cafés, or savor authentic Greek cuisine at a traditional taverna.

itinerary.title: Athens Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to explore the historic highlights of Athens. Visit the world-renowned Acropolis, home to the iconic Parthenon, Erechtheion, and Temple of Athena Nike, offering panoramic views of the city. Continue to the Acropolis Museum to admire impressive ancient artifacts. Drive past or visit important landmarks such as Syntagma Square, the Hellenic Parliament, Panathenaic Stadium,Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian’s Arch. Later, wander through the charming Plaka district,known for its narrow streets, neoclassical architecture, local shops, and traditional restaurants.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Athens – Mykonos (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the port or airport for your journey to the beautiful island of Mykonos. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel for check-in. Mykonos is famous for its cosmopolitan atmosphere, stunning beaches, and charming whitewashed architecture. In the evening, explore Mykonos Town (Chora), stroll through its maze-like streets, visit the iconic windmills, and enjoy the picturesque waterfront area of Little Venice.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and spend the day discovering Mykonos at your own pace. Relax on some of the island’s most famous beaches such as Paradise Beach, Super Paradise Beach, or Psarou Beach. You may also opt for a boat excursion to the nearby sacred island of Delos, a UNESCO World Heritage. Site and one of Greece’s most important archaeological sites. In the evening, experience Mykonos’ vibrant dining and nightlife scene or enjoy a peaceful sunset by the sea.
additionalInfo: Overnight stay in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos – Santorini (2 Nights)
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the port for your ferry to the stunning island of Santorini. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and check in. Santorini is renowned for its dramatic caldera views, whitewashed houses, and blue-domed churches. Spend the evening exploring the charming village of Oia or Fira and witness one of the most spectacular sunsets in the world
additionalInfo: overlooking the Aegean Sea. Overnight stay in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, explore the highlights of Santorini. Visit the picturesque towns of Fira and Oia, known for their breathtaking cliffside views. Discover the island’s unique volcanic beaches such as Red Beach, Perissa, or Kamari Beach. You may also choose to join an optional caldera cruise, sailing around the volcanic islands and hot springs while enjoying magnificent views of the coastline. Santorini is also known for its local wineries, offering excellent wine-tasting experiences.
additionalInfo: Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Santorini – Athens – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight back to Athens to connect with your onward international flight.
additionalInfo: Depart with unforgettable memories of Greece’s rich history, stunning landscapes, and beautiful island charm.

name: Discover Switzerland – Beauty Beyond Imagination
metaTitle: Discover Switzerland – Beauty Beyond Imagination | Switzerland Tour Package
metaDescription: Discover Switzerland, a beautiful landlocked country in Central Europe known for the Alps, scenic train journeys, winter sports, clear lakes, charming cities, chocolate, cheese, watches, and rich cultural heritage.
description: Switzerland is a small, landlocked country in Central Europe, known for its stunning mountains, clear lakes, and charming cities. The country is famous for the Alps, scenic train journeys, winter sports, and its rich cultural heritage. Switzerland is also renowned for chocolate, cheese, and watches, making it a popular destination for tourists year-round. Its temperate climate varies by region, with snowy winters in the mountains and mild summers in the lowlands.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Switzerland is a small, landlocked country in Central Europe, bordered by Germany, France, Italy, Austria, and Liechtenstein. Its landscape includes the Alps, the Jura Mountains, and the Central Plateau, with over 1,500 lakes such as Lake Geneva and Lake Lucerne.The climate is temperate but varies with altitude: the Alps are cold with snow in winter, while the Plateau is warmer. The west and south are influenced by the Mediterranean, making them slightly milder. Switzerland is a year-round tourist destination, popular for skiing in winter, hiking in summer, scenic train journeys like the Glacier Express, and its charming cities, lakes, and famous chocolate, cheese, and watches.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich
itinerary.description: Upon arriving in Zurich, the largest city in Switzerland, you can start by settling into your hotel and refreshing after your journey. Spend the afternoon exploring the Old Town (Altstadt), with its narrow streets, historic buildings, and charming squares. Walk along Bahnhofstrasse, one of the world’s most famous shopping streets, and enjoy the peaceful promenade along Lake Zurich.
additionalInfo: In the evening, try traditional Swiss cuisine at a local restaurant, such as Zürcher Geschnetzeltes, a creamy veal dish that is a specialty of the region.

itinerary.title: Zurich to Lucerne
itinerary.description: Take a morning train from Zurich to Lucerne, which takes about one hour. Lucerne is a picturesque city famous for its medieval architecture and lakeside setting. Explore the iconic Chapel Bridge (Kapellbrücke), the Lion Monument, and the cobbled streets of the Old Town. If time permits, enjoy a relaxing boat cruise on Lake Lucerne, offering panoramic views of the surrounding mountains.
additionalInfo: In the evening, dine at a lakeside restaurant while enjoying the Alpine scenery.

itinerary.title: Mount Pilatus or Mount Rigi
itinerary.description: Dedicate today to one of Lucerne’s nearby mountains. You can choose Mount Pilatus, accessible via the world’s steepest cogwheel railway from Alpnachstad, or by cable car from Kriens. From the summit, enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Alps, Lake Lucerne, and surrounding valleys.
additionalInfo: Alternatively, Mount Rigi, known as the “Queen of the Mountains,” offers easier hiking trails and similarly stunning vistas. After a day of mountain exploration, return to Lucerne for dinner and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Lucerne to Interlaken
itinerary.description: Take a scenic train ride from Lucerne to Interlaken, which takes approximately two hours. Interlaken, nestled between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz, is a hub for adventure sports and outdoor activities. Spend the afternoon strolling through Interlaken’s town center, walking along the Aare River, and taking in the views of the surrounding Jungfrau Alps. If you enjoy adventure, you can try activities such as paragliding or kayaking on the lakes.
additionalInfo: In the evening, relax at a café while enjoying the tranquil mountain scenery.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
itinerary.description: This day is dedicated to visiting Jungfraujoch, Europe’s highest railway station, often called the “Top of Europe.” Take the train from Interlaken to Lauterbrunnen, then transfer to Kleine Scheidegg before reaching Jungfraujoch. At the summit, you can explore the Ice Palace, enjoy panoramic views from the observation deck, and experience snow activities even in summer.
additionalInfo: Return to Interlaken in the evening for a relaxing dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Interlaken to Zermatt
itinerary.description: Take a morning train to Zermatt, a car-free village at the foot of the Matterhorn, Switzerland’s most iconic mountain. Spend the afternoon exploring Zermatt’s charming streets, visit the Matterhorn Museum, and enjoy the alpine atmosphere. For spectacular views, take the Gornergrat Railway to see the Matterhorn and surrounding peaks.
additionalInfo: Evening is perfect for enjoying a cozy Swiss dinner in one of Zermatt’s traditional restaurants.

itinerary.title: Zermatt to Geneva / Departure
itinerary.description: On your final day, you can enjoy a short morning hike or capture some last photos of the Matterhorn. Then take the train to Geneva, which takes about three and a half hours.
additionalInfo: If time permits, explore the Jet d’Eau, Geneva’s iconic fountain, stroll through the Old Town, and walk along the lakefront before heading to the airport for departure.

name: From Rio’s Rhythms to the Heart of the Amazon - Brazil
metaTitle: From Rio’s Rhythms to the Heart of the Amazon - Brazil | Brazil Tour Package
metaDescription: Explore Brazil’s highlights from vibrant Rio de Janeiro, featuring Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, and lively beaches; witness the breathtaking Iguassu Falls on both Brazilian and Argentine sides; and experience the Amazon Rainforest from Manaus with river cruises, jungle walks, and rich wildlife encounters.
description: Explore Brazil’s highlights from the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro with its iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf Mountain, and lively beaches; witness the awe-inspiring Iguassu Falls on both the Brazilian and Argentine sides; and immerse yourself in the Amazon Rainforest from Manaus with river cruises, jungle walks, and encounters with local wildlife and communities.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Rio de Janeiro – coastal city with beaches, mountains (Corcovado & Sugarloaf), tropical climate, hot & humid; Iguassu Falls – border of Brazil & Argentina, surrounded by rainforest, subtropical climate, warm with frequent rain; Manaus/Amazon – heart of the Amazon Rainforest, rivers and dense jungle, equatorial climate, hot, humid, and rainy year-round.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Rio de Janeiro
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Rio de Janeiro International Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel and assisted with check-in. The remainder of the day will be at leisure to relax after your journey. You may take an evening stroll along the famous Copacabana Beach promenade and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the city. Optional dinner at a traditional Brazilian churrascaria is recommended.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro – Christ the Redeemer & Sugarloaf Mountain
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day city tour of Rio. Visit the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue atop Corcovado Mountain and enjoy panoramic views of the city, beaches, and Guanabara Bay. Continue with an external visit to Maracanã Stadium, Sambadrome, and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Later, take a cable car ride to Sugarloaf Mountain for spectacular sunset views.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro – Culture & Leisure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the colorful Selarón Steps and explore the charming Santa Teresa district, known for its colonial architecture and artistic vibe. You may also stop at scenic viewpoints for breathtaking city views. The afternoon is free to relax at Copacabana or Ipanema Beach. In the evening, you may enjoy samba music or explore Rio’s lively nightlife.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Rio de Janeiro.

itinerary.title: Rio de Janeiro – Iguassu Falls
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu. Upon arrival, you will be transferred to your hotel and assisted with check-in. The rest of the day will be at leisure to relax or explore the surroundings. An optional cultural dinner show can be arranged in the evening.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Iguassu Falls.

itinerary.title: Iguassu Falls – Brazilian & Argentine Sides
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a full-day excursion to the magnificent Iguassu Falls. Begin on the Brazilian side, where walking trails offer panoramic views of the waterfall system. Later, cross to the Argentine side to explore the Upper and Lower Circuits and visit the impressive Devil’s Throat viewpoint. An optional boat ride can be taken for a closer and thrilling experience of the falls.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Iguassu Falls.

itinerary.title: Iguassu Falls – Manaus
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Manaus, the gateway to the Amazon Rainforest. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel or jungle lodge and check in. Depending on arrival time, you may visit the famous Amazon Theatre or explore the local market area. The evening will be at leisure.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Manaus.

itinerary.title: Manaus – Amazon Experience
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day Amazon excursion. Enjoy a boat ride on the Amazon River and witness the Meeting of the Waters, where two rivers flow side by side without mixing. You may also experience a guided jungle walk, wildlife spotting, and a visit to a local community. This day offers an authentic introduction to the rich biodiversity of the Amazon.
additionalInfo: Overnight in Manaus.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, you will have free time depending on your flight schedule. You may explore the nearby market for souvenirs or enjoy a short walk around the city. At the scheduled time, transfer to Manaus International Airport for your onward journey.
additionalInfo: Tour concludes with unforgettable memories of Brazil.

name: Explore the Wild Heart of Norway
metaTitle: Explore the Wild Heart of Norway | Norway Tour Package
metaDescription: Discover Norway’s breathtaking landscapes, from dramatic fjords and snow-capped mountains to scenic coastal villages and vibrant cities. Experience Northern Lights, glacier views, waterfalls, and unforgettable Arctic adventures on this immersive Norway tour package.
description: Norway is a stunning Scandinavian country of fjords, mountains, glaciers, and a rugged coastline dotted with charming villages. From vibrant cities like Oslo and Bergen to the Arctic wonders of Tromsø, Norway offers scenic train rides, fjord cruises, hiking, and natural phenomena like the Midnight Sun and Northern Lights. Its dramatic landscapes and diverse climate make it perfect for adventure, culture, and unforgettable experiences.

additionalInfo.name: Geography and Climate
additionalInfo.description: Norway is a long, narrow country in Northern Europe, stretching from the North Sea in the south to the Arctic Circle and beyond in the north, with dramatic landscapes including fjords, steep mountains, islands, and a rugged coastline dotted with fishing villages. The southern regions, including Oslo and Bergen, have a mild oceanic climate with warm summers (18–25°C) and cold, sometimes snowy winters (0–5°C), while the fjord regions like Flåm and Geiranger are cool in summer (15–22°C) and wet in winter. Northern Norway, including Tromsø, has a subarctic to Arctic climate, featuring cool summers (10–18°C) with 24-hour daylight and cold winters (-5 to -20°C) with long nights and the Northern Lights. Norway’s weather changes quickly, especially in the mountains and fjords, so layering and waterproof clothing are essential.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Oslo
itinerary.description: Arrive in Oslo, Norway’s vibrant capital, known for its mix of modern architecture and historic sites. Begin your day by walking on the roof of the Oslo Opera House, a striking building that juts into the Oslofjord and offers panoramic views. Then, visit Vigeland Sculpture Park, the world’s largest sculpture park created by a single artist, featuring over 200 sculptures by Gustav Vigeland. Explore MUNCH to see iconic paintings like “The Scream” and other modern Norwegian art.
additionalInfo: In the evening, wander the Grünerløkka district, full of street art, cafés, and lively nightlife.In the evening, wander the Grünerløkka district, full of street art, cafés, and lively nightlife.

itinerary.title: Oslo Museums & Views
itinerary.description: Spend the morning on Bygdøy Peninsula, often called Oslo’s “museum peninsula.” Visit the Viking Ship Museum to see remarkably preserved Viking ships and artifacts over 1,000 years old. Next, explore the Fram Museum, dedicated to polar exploration, and see the famous ship Fram that sailed both the Arctic and Antarctic. Finish the day with a sunset at Ekebergparken Sculpture Park, which combines art, history, and sweeping views over the Oslofjord.
additionalInfo: Morning light at Ekebergparken is perfect for photography.

itinerary.title: Scenic Train to Bergen
itinerary.description: Take the Bergen Railway, often called one of Europe’s most scenic train rides, passing through snow-capped mountains, fjords, and waterfalls. Upon arrival in Bergen, explore Bryggen, a UNESCO World Heritage site with colorful Hanseatic-era wooden buildings. Ride the Fløibanen funicular to Mount Fløyen for panoramic city and fjord views. Evening strolls around the harbor reveal lively cafés and restaurants serving fresh seafood.
additionalInfo: Bring a light jacket; Bergen can be rainy even in summer.

itinerary.title: Bergen & Fjord Cruise
itinerary.description: Visit the bustling Bergen Fish Market in the morning to sample local delicacies such as fresh shrimp, salmon, and traditional brown cheese. Later, take a fjord cruise through Sognefjord, Norway’s longest and deepest fjord, where sheer cliffs rise dramatically from the water and waterfalls cascade into the fjord. You may also spot small villages tucked into fjord-side valleys, accessible only by boat.
additionalInfo: Book a fjord cruise in advance; consider a small boat tour for a more intimate experience.

itinerary.title: Norway in a Nutshell Experience
itinerary.description: Travel from Bergen to Flåm via Voss, then cruise through the narrow Nærøyfjord, a UNESCO-listed fjord known for its steep cliffs and waterfalls. Continue on the Flåm Railway, a spectacular 20-kilometer train ride that winds through mountains, tunnels, and waterfalls. Overnight in Flåm or Gudvangen, where small village charm meets stunning natural scenery.
additionalInfo: Early morning departures offer calmer fjord waters for photography.

itinerary.title: Explore Ålesund
itinerary.description: Travel to Ålesund, a coastal town rebuilt in Art Nouveau style after a fire in 1904. Wander the streets to admire ornate facades and pastel-colored buildings. Climb 418 steps to the Aksla viewpoint for a panoramic view of the town, surrounding islands, and the Sunnmøre Alps. Ålesund also has a beautiful aquarium, the Atlanterhavsparken, which highlights marine life from the Norwegian coast.
additionalInfo: Sunset views from Aksla are especially magical.

itinerary.title: Visit Geirangerfjord
itinerary.description: Take a day trip to Geirangerfjord, one of Norway’s most famous fjords and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Marvel at the Seven Sisters Waterfall and the Suitor Waterfall across the fjord. Optional activities include RIB boat safaris for adrenaline-packed sightseeing or hiking trails that offer unforgettable fjord views.
additionalInfo: Bring waterproof clothing; spray from waterfalls can be intense.

itinerary.title: Fly to Tromsø
itinerary.description: Fly north to Tromsø, the gateway to the Arctic. In summer, enjoy the Midnight Sun, while winter brings spectacular Northern Lights displays. Visit the striking Arctic Cathedral with its unique architecture inspired by ice and snow. Take the Fjellheisen cable car for panoramic views of Tromsø, fjords, and surrounding mountains.
additionalInfo: Tromsø is known as the “Paris of the North” for its cultural vibrancy; local cafés and breweries are worth exploring.

itinerary.title: Fly to Tromsø
itinerary.description: Fly north to Tromsø, the gateway to the Arctic. In summer, enjoy the Midnight Sun, while winter brings spectacular Northern Lights displays. Visit the striking Arctic Cathedral with its unique architecture inspired by ice and snow. Take the Fjellheisen cable car for panoramic views of Tromsø, fjords, and surrounding mountains.
additionalInfo: Tromsø is known as the “Paris of the North” for its cultural vibrancy; local cafés and breweries are worth exploring.

itinerary.title: Arctic Adventure
itinerary.description: Spend your day immersed in Arctic nature. Join a reindeer sledding and Sámi cultural experience, hike in the Lyngen Alps, or kayak along fjords to experience the serene beauty of the region. Wildlife spotting is excellent here; you might see sea eagles, seals, and even whales, depending on the season.
additionalInfo: Guided tours are recommended for safety and local knowledge in Arctic conditions.

itinerary.title: Return to Oslo
itinerary.description: Fly back to Oslo for your departure. Take a last stroll along the Oslofjord or grab souvenirs before leaving. Your journey through Norway’s cities, fjords, mountains, and Arctic landscapes will leave lasting memories of the country’s natural beauty and cultural richness.
